I propose F ION–EAS and F NAP–ION. Could F GRE–AEG cut Turkish support for SMY–EAS? That positions us to break Turkey’s naval defense in autumn. Please also maintain BOH support for MUN. A VEN will hold and A APU–ROM; neither army will attack Trieste.

Our Piedmont/Gulf of Lyon DMZ remains valuable; I intend to keep it. A MUN will hold while my fleets concentrate against Turkey. Can A BUR support MUN again, and what are your plans for Burgundy afterward? I would welcome its eventual redeployment north rather than additional forces along our border.

With two Italian fleets available, I intend renewed pressure against Turkey: ION–EAS followed by NAP–ION. Will you order SEV–ARM and BLA–CON? Armenia threatens Smyrna in autumn, while Constantinople pressure restricts Turkish reinforcements. Another attack on Rumania instead would chiefly help Turkey preserve its naval barrier against us.

Russia here. A UKR and A WAR will not enter Galicia this spring if A RUM stays peaceful. Let's coordinate: I'll hold off RUM if you leave Galicia and Bulgaria quiet. Tell me your exact RUM, SER and BUD orders, and I'll weigh that against Turkey's offers.

Russia here. Confirm again: no Turkish unit enters BLA, ARM or SEV this spring. I'll keep F BLA off CON and BUL. Press Greece with AEG and BUL support, and tell me your exact orders so we can coordinate on Austria.

Russia here. You're at 8 centers and rising, so the others should worry about you, not me. I'll keep the north quiet. What are your plans against Germany and England this spring? Tell me if you plan anything near Warsaw or St Petersburg.

Let’s take Rumania for Russia and Greece for Turkey. I propose A BUL support F BLA–RUM, with A UKR also supporting; please send A WAR–GAL to threaten Austria’s supporting armies. F AEG will pressure Greece. A ANK stays out of Armenia. Will you commit, keeping BLA away from Constantinople and Bulgaria?

I accept your proposed 1904 naval boundary: Turkish fleets stay out of Ionian, Italian fleets stay out of Eastern Mediterranean. Please also leave Aegean alone; I will keep Smyrna out of Eastern Mediterranean this spring. This lets you deploy F NAP westward while I concentrate on Austria. Can you confirm these terms?

Agreed for this spring: A RUM holds, A SER supports RUM hold, and A BUD supports RUM hold. I will leave Galicia and Bulgaria quiet, provided WAR and UKR stay out of Galicia and you do not attack Rumania. This defensive deployment threatens none of your centers. Can you confirm that truce?

GRE–AEG leaves Greece open to A BUL–GRE. Instead, I offer F GRE S F ION–AEG, with F NAP–ION; this keeps Greece occupied while pressuring Turkey. Please confirm that alternative. BOH must redeploy east, so arrange French BUR support for MUN. TRI stays out of VEN; thank you for VEN holding and APU–ROM.

England here. France at 8 is the threat. F HEL stays off Berlin and Denmark and will not enter Kiel unless you hold Berlin and Denmark. Which French unit moves on Kiel or Holland? If you can pin A KIE, I'll consider HEL-HOL or support. Confirm A MUN stays home.

England here. I won't commit F HEL to Denmark. Taking Denmark from Germany makes you bigger, and I don't trust a French Kiel. F EDI, A LVP and F NOR stay defensive this spring, and nothing of mine enters ENG or BEL. Keep F NAO and your fleets out of IRI, ENG and WAL.

My targets are Berlin and the North Sea; I plan no moves toward Warsaw or St Petersburg. F NWG–NTH, supported by F HOL, remains my intended naval operation. Will you order A STP–NOR? Norway is yours to keep; your attack would complicate England’s defense considerably.

Yes, A BUR can support A MUN this spring, then redeploy to RUH in autumn. Please order A MUN S A KIE–BER rather than hold: Burgundy’s support still defends Munich while your army supports Berlin. That repeats our successful Kiel arrangement. Our Piedmont/Gulf of Lyon DMZ continues.

Germany here. A Ber and F Den hold, nothing of mine enters HEL, NTH or your coast. France holds Kie and Hol, so your F HEL supporting me into Kiel is welcome. Which Kiel or Holland attack are you ordering? Tell me and I'll coordinate and keep Den secure.

I am not attacking Burgundy or Marseilles this spring; Munich holds while my fleets handle Turkey. France’s F NWG threatens Norway, so secure that flank. Could F EDI enter NTH and F HEL pressure HOL? Pinning French fleets north would give me room to organize a western offensive.

A MUN will hold, and I will not assist France against Berlin. Please hold A BER rather than opening another French center. I cannot launch a credible attack on Marseilles this spring; my fleets face Turkey. Keep Munich unmolested, and we can coordinate MUN–RUH against French expansion in autumn.

Confirmed for 1904: Turkish fleets stay out of Ionian; Italian fleets stay out of Eastern Mediterranean and leave Aegean alone. I understand F SMY will not enter EAS this spring. Please also keep F AEG out of ION. This gives us breathing room without committing Italy to an attack on Greece.

My proposed orders remain ION–EAS, NAP–ION, APU–ROM, with VEN holding outside TRI and TYR. Can GRE–AEG cut support from Turkey’s fleet? Turkey claims SMY will stay out of EAS, which could give us an opening. If BOH must redeploy, please confirm; I am seeking French protection for Munich.

Munich cannot support KIE–BER: Berlin is not adjacent to Munich. A MUN will hold this spring. Please order BUR support MUN hold rather than BUR–RUH, especially if BOH redeploys east. My fleets remain occupied with Turkey, and our Piedmont/Gulf of Lyon DMZ stands. What northern operation will your new Brest fleet undertake?

Russia here. A STP stays home and won't enter Norway; F SWE stays out of Denmark and the Baltic. France at 8 is the threat. If you hear of a French move on Norway or the Channel, tell me. The border holds.
Russia here. F SWE and A STP stay out of Denmark, Prussia and Kiel. A WAR holds. Keep A SIL and A PRU off Warsaw. I can't spare a Baltic unit now, but hold Munich and Berlin against France.

Russia here. Rumania is the target. I'll send A UKR and F BLA at it; I can't send WAR into Galicia without exposing Warsaw. Keep A BUL support on RUM, and no Turkish unit in BLA, ARM or SEV. F BLA stays off CON and BUL.

Russia here. I won't recognize Austrian RUM yet. WAR and UKR stay out of Galicia this spring if you don't move into Galicia, UKR or SEV. Keep your armies off Bulgaria and I'll weigh Turkey's offers. Show me peace first.

Russia here. I can't commit A STP to Norway. It would leave St Petersburg exposed and anger England, who keeps the northern border quiet. I'll watch the north. Your growth worries everyone, so concentrate on Germany first.

Russia here. Rumania is still my priority, since it's my center. A SEV-ARM would leave Sevastopol open, so I'll decide in autumn. F BLA stays committed to Rumania, not CON. Go ahead with ION-EAS, and keep Austria's eyes on Trieste.

Confirmed: no Turkish unit enters BLA, ARM or SEV. My orders: BUL supports BLA–RUM, AEG–GRE, SMY–AEG, ANK–CON. Please order BLA–RUM with UKR supporting; our combined strength should secure Rumania. WAR–GAL would prepare your next advance. Bulgaria cannot support both your Rumanian attack and my attack on Greece.

Confirmed: BUL supports RUM hold in exchange for RUM supporting BUL hold; neither BUL nor AEG attacks Greece or Serbia. I envisage AEG holding and SMY–EAS, positioning against Italy rather than Greece. Please retain the reciprocal support this spring; Russian BLA and UKR can otherwise combine against Rumania.

notes.note: Spring 1904: all hold. France has 8 centers and F NWG threatens NOR. Germany and Russia are quiet. Declined France's HEL-DEN offer. Watch for a chance at KIE or HOL, and consider builds.

S1904: held Ber and Den. France leads with 8 centers and holds Kie and Hol. England and Italy both say they will not attack me. Russia is quiet. Look for a chance at Kie with English support; Mun stays Italian.

Back Russia: BUL supports BLA–RUM; AEG–GRE, SMY–AEG, ANK–CON. Broke renewed Austrian armistice. Russia promised BLA–RUM with UKR support, no CON/BUL attack. Italy agreed no EAS/AEG in 1904; promised no ION and no SMY–EAS this spring.

BOH–SIL targets BER/WAR; TRI–TYR positions against VEN/MUN. Defend RUM with BUD+SER; Russia has not confirmed peace. GRE–AEG cuts support for Italy's ION–EAS. Turkey promised BUL support RUM and no attack GRE/SER; Italy promised VEN hold, APU–ROM.

Pivot against leading France: PIE threatens MAR; RUH threatens BEL/HOL/KIE; TYS heads west. APU replaces VEN, NAP replaces ION. Breaking French PIE DMZ; Turkish naval boundary honored. Austria promised TRI stays out of VEN; avoid attacking Austria.

Honor Italian Munich defense and PIE/LYO DMZ. Attack Berlin; take NTH with HOL supported by NWG, BRE enters ENG. BEL-RUH, PIC-BEL, PAR-PIC reinforce. Seek autumn convoy into England. England rejected Denmark deal; Russia refused Norway attack.
S1904: BLA-RUM supported by UKR via SEV? Fixed: BLA-RUM, UKR holds-supports SEV-RUM mismatch avoided; SEV holds. Watch Austria RUM (BUD/SER support) and Turkey. North quiet with England/Germany.

messages.body: I propose exchanging gains: A SIL supports A KIE–BER, while A BUR supports A TYR–MUN. You gain Berlin; I gain Munich. Please keep BEL available to cover Burgundy against PIE. Can you commit BUR’s support and KIE–BER?

Can we stabilize our frontier? I propose TYR supporting MUN hold this autumn, with VEN and PIE staying out of Austrian territory. Please order F ION to support F GRE hold: Turkey attacked Greece despite promising otherwise, and AEG–GRE with BUL support remains a threat. What are your intended army orders?

Turkey promised BUL support for RUM, then supported your attack instead; neither of us should trust its bargains. I offer continued peace in Galicia and no SIL–WAR if WAR stays out of Galicia and you cease attacking Rumania. Could BLA attack CON while SEV moves ARM? Turkey’s defenses are thin.

England here. France at 8 must be stopped. This fall F HEL moves to HOL only if you can pin A KIE; otherwise HEL holds. Please keep A BER and F DEN home and tell me whether A MUN will attack KIE. I'll keep NOR and EDI defensive toward you.

England here. France's F NWG and F NTH face my coast, so my fleets must stay home. If you move A MUN or A PIE against BUR or MAR this fall, I'll hold France's fleets in the north. Will you commit to attacking BUR or MAR?

England here. France's F NWG threatens NOR and its F NTH threatens my coast. If I stay out of Sweden, will you keep A STP and F SWE out of NOR and the Baltic? Please tell me if France approaches STP or BAR so we can coordinate.

Would A SIL support A KIE–BER this fall? That can finally break Berlin while your southern armies face Russia and Turkey. I will keep my armies out of Silesia and Bohemia. Please tell me your plans for A TYR; Italy’s moves into Piedmont and toward Ruhr have complicated our western cooperation.

A PIE violates our Piedmont DMZ, and MUN–RUH blocked my agreed redeployment. Please order PIE–TUS this fall and MUN support BEL–RUH; I can then move BUR–MAR defensively without contesting Munich. Will you confirm? I want our northern cooperation restored, not a war along the Mediterranean.

Would you now accept F HEL–DEN with French support from F NTH? Denmark would become English this autumn, not merely a future promise. In exchange, keep F NOR and F EDI holding and leave Holland and Belgium alone. Please confirm before I allocate North Sea’s order.

Germany here. France holds Kie with A Kie, and Bur and Bel. Please order F HEL support or move toward Kiel/Holland this fall. My A Ber and F Den hold and won't touch HEL or your coast. France at 8 hurts us both. Confirm your HEL order.

Germany here. Thanks for the Munich assurance. I'll hold Ber and leave Mun alone this fall if your A Mun moves on Ruh or Bur against France, or at least holds. France at 8 will crush us one by one. Confirm A Mun and A Pie orders.

Germany here. A Sil and A Tyr are yours, and I won't attack them or Bohemia. France is the runaway leader at 8. Please keep A Sil off Berlin, and consider A Tyr toward Mun or Bur to hurt France. What are your fall plans?

My western deployment targets France, not Trieste. Please keep A TYR out of Munich and Venice; TYR–BOH would reinforce your eastern campaign. Can you confirm Munich remains Italian? A VEN will stay out of Trieste, and F ION will respect our Greek frontier.

Piedmont was a precaution, not a commitment to war. I propose withdrawing A PIE–TUS this autumn while you carry out BUR–RUH as discussed. Munich remains Italian, and neither of us attacks the other’s centers. Can you confirm Burgundy’s departure and no attack on Munich?

I am preparing PIE–MAR and TYS–LYO against France. This is the moment to recover North Sea: order F EDI–NTH with F HEL and F NOR both supporting. That concentrates three fleets against France’s northern position while my offensive forces Paris to look south. Can you commit?

Russia here. Fall plan: F BLA and A UKR attack Rumania again. Please have A BUL support BLA-RUM, since Greece can wait. Keep every Turkish unit out of BLA, ARM and SEV. In return my units stay off CON and BUL. Tell me your exact Bulgaria order.
Russia here. I still won't recognize RUM. If your armies stay out of Galicia, UKR and SEV, WAR stays home too. Tell me your Fall orders for SIL and TYR. Are they aimed at Germany or Italy, or at me?

Russia here. A WAR holds and F SWE and A STP stay out of Denmark and Prussia. Austrian A SIL sits next to Berlin and Warsaw, so watch it. Are you planning anything against it? Tell me your Fall orders for BER and DEN.

We can break Rumania this fall: order A SEV–RUM, supported by F BLA and A UKR. I order BUL–SER, cutting Serbia’s support, leaving Rumania only Budapest’s support against your strength three. AEG attacks Greece. Please confirm these exact orders; last spring UKR supported SEV–RUM while SEV held, wasting our attack.

Please support F AEG–GRE with F ION this fall. BUL–SER will cut Serbian support while Russia attacks Rumania, allowing us to break Austria’s Balkan line. Austria’s TYR also threatens your Munich; VEN–TRI could exploit its distraction. In return for your support, I offer to extend our Ionian/Eastern Mediterranean naval boundary through 1905.

SIL is intended to support KIE–BER, not attack Warsaw. TYR will remain on the Munich front, not move east. I will keep Galicia, Ukraine and Sevastopol untouched if WAR and UKR stay out of Galicia and you cease attacking RUM. Will you commit BLA–CON and SEV–ARM instead?

TYR is considering Munich; SIL will not move to Berlin this fall. Can you order DEN–KIE while BER holds? France may vacate Kiel to attack Berlin, giving your fleet a chance to recover a center. Please keep BER out of Silesia and coordinate any Munich ambitions with me.

My exchange remains available: SIL supports KIE–BER if BUR supports TYR–MUN. Please confirm both orders explicitly; I need Munich’s build to sustain our eastern defenses. TYR will not move toward Burgundy. With Italy occupying PIE, what will PIC and PAR do to protect your southern flank?

I can keep TYR out of Munich and Venice if we secure a concrete defensive agreement: TYR supports MUN hold, ION supports GRE hold, and VEN and PIE stay out of Austrian territory. Please confirm those commitments and Munich’s order. Your fleet’s support is essential against AEG–GRE supported by BUL.

England here. F HEL holds this fall; I can't break French Kiel alone and F NTH, NWG leave my coast exposed. If A MUN attacks KIE and A BER stays home, I'll consider HEL-HOL or support next spring. Keep F DEN and A BER off HEL.
England here. I decline HEL-DEN. F HEL and F NOR hold, F EDI and A LVP stay home, and I won't enter HOL or BEL this fall. Keep F NTH and F NWG off my coast; don't attack NOR or EDI.

England here. I can't commit EDI-NTH: French F NTH is already there and F NWG threatens NOR, so I'd just bounce and expose my coast. Your PIE-MAR and TYS-LYO offensive is what I'd back. Show it this fall and I'll coordinate in spring.

Agreed: A BUR–RUH, no French attack on Munich, and A PIE–TUS this autumn. Please keep A MUN holding rather than moving to Ruhr, so Burgundy’s departure succeeds. Your withdrawal from Piedmont will restore our border agreement; my fleets remain focused on the northern campaign.

Agreed: A BUR supports A TYR–MUN in exchange for A SIL supporting A KIE–BER this fall. Please confirm both Austrian orders. Italy has proposed PIE–TUS, which I am encouraging; keep our Munich arrangement confidential. BEL will remain available to cover Burgundy, and my armies will stay out of Silesia and Bohemia.

Germany here. A Ber and F Den hold and stay off HEL and your coast. A Mun is Italian, so I can't attack Kiel from there. If F HEL moves to HOL or supports into Kiel, I'll back it. France at 8 is the only threat to us both. Please confirm your HEL order.

Germany here. A Ber and F Den hold; nothing of mine enters Warsaw, Prussia or Baltic. Thanks for the Silesia warning. Austria's A Sil threatens us both. If you can bring a unit to Prussia or the Baltic against it, I'll help. France is the real danger at 8.

Yes: A PIE–MAR and F TYS–LYO are my intended orders. Munich will hold with Austrian support. Please commit F EDI–NTH, supported by F HEL and F NOR; merely holding lets France concentrate against either of us. Your attack also prevents NTH from freely supporting operations against Norway.

A MUN will hold; A PIE will attack MAR, with F TYS–LYO establishing sustained pressure on France. Austria has offered TYR support for Munich. Please hold BER and deny France another build. Can F DEN threaten HEL if England's fleet vacates it to attack NTH?

Agreed on restoring cooperation: I will order PIE–TUS provided BUR–RUH goes ahead rather than BUR–MAR. MUN will hold, with Austrian protection; I cannot simultaneously support BEL–RUH. Please confirm BUR–RUH and no attack on Munich. That removes both immediate sources of friction while your northern campaign continues.

I decline ION support for AEG–GRE and will not order VEN–TRI. Austria's TYR is offering support to defend Munich, not attacking it. I remain willing to extend our naval boundary through 1905: no Turkish fleet enters ION, and no Italian fleet enters EAS or AEG. Can you confirm that extension independently?

Confirmed: A MUN holds; please order A TYR S A MUN H. A VEN holds and A PIE–MAR targets France, not Austrian territory. F ION will support F GRE hold against AEG–GRE. My other fleet moves TYS–LYO. Keeping Greece and Munich secure lets us contain France without exposing your Balkan position.

Russia here. A STP and F SWE stay out of Norway and the Baltic this fall. I'm focused on Rumania and Turkey. If French fleets approach STP or BAR I'll tell you at once. Please keep NOR out of BAR and STP. France at 8 is the real threat.

Russia here. Agreed in principle: A SEV-RUM, F BLA supports SEV-RUM, A UKR supports SEV-RUM. Please make A BUL-SER, with AEG hitting Greece. Keep BLA, ARM and SEV clear of Turkish units; my units stay off CON and BUL. Send me your orders as written.

Russia here. I still won't recognize RUM, but SIL and TYR leaving WAR alone keeps WAR out of Galicia. I'm not moving on Serbia or Greece. Tell me whether SIL and TYR go at Germany or Italy. Peace in Galicia holds if your armies stay out of UKR and SEV.

My exact Bulgaria order is A BUL–SER, cutting Serbia’s support for Rumania. Order A SEV–RUM, F BLA supports SEV–RUM, and A UKR supports SEV–RUM: strength three beats Budapest’s remaining support. F AEG–GRE cuts any Greek support for Serbia. No Turkish unit enters BLA, ARM or SEV. Please confirm; SEV must actually move this time.

notes.note: F1904: held Ber and Den. Kie is French with A Kie, and Mun is Italian. England holds Hel, Italy says Mun holds, Austria's Sil is a threat. Look for a Kie attack with English or Italian help. Germany has only 2 centers.

F1904: SEV-RUM supported by BLA and UKR, per Turkey's plan (BUL-SER cuts SER support). STP and WAR hold. Check whether Turkey kept its word. North quiet with England and Germany. France at 8 is the threat.

Fall 1904: all hold. France at 8 is the threat, with F NTH and F NWG on my coast. Italy plans PIE-MAR and TYS-LYO. Germany wants HEL-HOL or a KIE attack. Russia promised to stay out of NOR. Declined France's HEL-DEN offer. Watch for a chance at HOL or KIE.

Attack France: PIE–MAR, MUN–BUR, VEN–PIE, TYS–GOL. Broke French withdrawal promise and revised promised Munich/Venice holds to advance west. ION supports GRE as promised; Austria offered TYR support Munich. England declined immediate North Sea attack.

Take MUN with promised French BUR support; repay with SIL supporting KIE–BER. Defend RUM with BUD+SER. Italy promised ION support GRE, VEN hold, PIE–MAR; Munich attack breaks its requested pact. Turkey previously betrayed RUM/GRE promises. Galicia truce remains.

BUL-SER cuts support for agreed Russian SEV-RUM with BLA/UKR support; AEG-GRE cuts Greek support. CON follows BUL; SMY-EAS develops fleet. Italy refused Greece support; 1904 no Turkish ION/no Italian EAS-AEG boundary remains. No 1905 extension confirmed.

Take Berlin with Austrian SIL support, convoy PIC to London, and force Norway. Honor Austrian exchange by supporting TYR-MUN, breaking Italian promise of BUR-RUH/no Munich attack. Italy promised PIE-TUS; England promised holds. BEL-RUH reinforces Germany; PAR-GAS covers south.

messages.body: Let’s exchange gains against Turkey: SER and BLA support RUM–BUL; UKR supports GAL–RUM. You gain Bulgaria; I recover Rumania. SIL will not attack WAR, and GAL leaves your frontier. With three-strength pressure on Bulgaria, CON’s support cannot save it. Will you commit those three Russian orders?

Taking Munich damaged our cooperation; continued fighting benefits France most. I propose MUN holds, with no Austrian moves into KIE, TYR or VEN, while your armies stay outside Austrian territory. I can support ION–AEG with GRE this spring, giving us a concrete joint operation against Turkey. Will you agree?

Our Munich–Berlin exchange succeeded. Can BUR support MUN hold this spring? I intend MUN to hold and need to stabilize the eastern front rather than fight Italy across Tyrolia. SIL will not attack BER. Please keep your armies out of BOH and SIL; what are your plans for RUH and BER?

England here. France has 9 centers and is the only power near 18. I have only EDI and LVP, so I can't attack. If your PIE-MAR and TYS-LYO push through this spring, I'll try to hold French fleets in NTH and ENG. Please confirm your orders against BUR and MAR.

England here. France at 9 is the only power near 18, and Italy holds MUN with your support. Will you back Italy against BUR or MAR, or hold MUN against France? I'll keep EDI and LVP pinning French fleets in the north. What are your orders?

England here. France at 9 threatens us both. I can't break KIE or HOL alone with my two units. Keep A BER and F DEN home. If anyone attacks French KIE or HOL, tell me first and I'll consider support from NOR or EDI.

Our exchange succeeded. Will A MUN support A RUH–KIE this spring? A BER can add support, overcoming any German assistance to Italy. I will keep out of Silesia and Bohemia. With Italy occupying Marseille and Gulf of Lyon, removing his northern army would let me concentrate on recovering my southern frontier.

I propose a Norway–St Petersburg frontier agreement: F NOR will not attack St Petersburg this year, provided A STP stays out of Norway. My northern fleets will concentrate on England, not Russia. Can you confirm? Keeping this border quiet leaves your armies available against Austria rather than tying us both down.

Italy has committed F GOL and two armies against France, leaving an opportunity in the Ionian. Would you order F EAS–ION supported by F AEG this spring? Even a bounce pins his defensive fleets; if Naples moves west, you break through. I intend to contest Marseille and draw Italian resources westward.

Germany here. I have one fleet in Den and no threat to you. Leave Denmark alone this spring: no F Nor or A Ber move into it. A surviving Germany gives you a quiet northern flank. What are your Nor and Ber orders?

Germany here. F Den holds and stays out of Swe, Bal and Pru. France, now at 9, holds Ber, Nor and Hol, so Denmark is next for them, and Stockholm after that. Please keep F Swe and A StP off Den. Do you want to coordinate against France?

Germany here. France at 9 is close to winning. My F Den holds and will not touch your coast. If F Nor or F Nth move against you, I'll hold Den and keep French units busy. Can you move F Hel or Edi toward Nor or Nth against France?

My armies remain focused on France, not Venice or Trieste. Will A MUN support A MAR–BUR this spring? A PIE can replace MAR while F GOL presses Spain. I can again order F ION S F GRE hold, freeing your eastern armies to concentrate against Russia and Turkey.

France can attack Kiel with A BER supported by A RUH. Please order F DEN S A KIE hold this spring; together we stop that attack. I will keep KIE defending rather than gamble on Berlin, while MAR, PIE and GOL continue the western offensive. Will you confirm support?

Can we confirm our naval boundary through 1905: no Turkish fleet enters ION, and no Italian fleet enters EAS or AEG? My western offensive has taken Marseilles, and France remains the largest power. A quiet naval frontier lets me send F NAP west rather than reinforce Ionian.

Russia here. Spring: A SEV-RUM with F BLA and A UKR supporting again, and I need A BUL-SER to cut Serbia's support. Keep Turkish units out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Tell me your exact Bulgaria and Aegean orders. France at 9 is the bigger danger to us both.

Russia here. France has 9 centers and holds Berlin, so we are both at risk. I'm still not recognizing RUM. Will you keep SIL and GAL quiet toward WAR while I decide? Tell me your Spring orders for SER, BUD and SIL.
Russia here. France now holds BER and is far ahead. A WAR holds, and F SWE and A STP stay out of Denmark. Tell me where French units are going this spring, and whether you hold DEN.

Let's exploit Rumania: please order RUM support BUL–SER, WAR–GAL, and UKR support WAR–GAL. I propose BUL–SER, CON–BUL, AEG–GRE. AEG cuts Greek support for Serbia; your Galicia attack pressures Budapest's defensive choices. Our Black Sea frontier remains peaceful. Can you confirm these orders?

France has nine centers and threatens your western gains. Please order ION support AEG–GRE this spring; BUL–SER will cut Serbian support. Taking Greece would release our fleets from this standoff while you reinforce the west. In exchange, I confirm no Turkish fleet enters ION throughout 1905, provided Italy stays out of EAS and AEG.

Munich is now Austrian, and A MUN will hold rather than help France take Kiel. I am seeking a truce with Italy so its Marseille army and Gulf of Lyon fleet remain focused west. Keep Edinburgh and Liverpool secure; every French unit tied down around Britain helps us contain its expansion.

My proposed orders are SER supporting your RUM–BUL, BUD supporting GAL–RUM, and SIL holding. Please confirm RUM–BUL, BLA supporting RUM–BUL, and UKR supporting GAL–RUM. You gain Bulgaria while I recover Rumania; Galicia is vacated and Warsaw remains untouched. Without confirmation, I must retain a defensive deployment.

I cannot support MAR–BUR this spring; MUN will hold, and I will stay out of KIE, TYR and VEN. Your offered ION support for GRE hold would be welcome if you prefer defense to our proposed ION–AEG attack. Please confirm which fleet operation you choose and that PIE stays outside Austrian territory.

I cannot provide MUN support for RUH–KIE this spring. Munich must hold while I negotiate recovery of Rumania, and SIL will not attack BER. Please confirm BUR supports MUN hold and that BOH and SIL remain untouched. Your RUH and BER can operate against Kiel without Austrian participation.

England here. France at 9 is the threat, but I have only F EDI and A LVP, and French F NTH, F ENG and A LON sit on my coast. I can't move EDI toward NOR or NTH without losing home centers. Keep F DEN and A BER home. If Italy or Austria hits KIE or HOL, tell me and I'll look at support.

I will leave Denmark untouched this spring. A BER will support A RUH–KIE, not threaten your fleet. Would F DEN also support RUH–KIE? Your support would guarantee Italy’s army is dislodged even if it receives outside assistance. Keeping Denmark peaceful while removing that army gives us a workable northern settlement.

I will order A BUR to support A MUN holding. Please have MUN support A RUH–KIE rather than hold: Burgundy’s support still protects Munich while it gives support. BER will also support RUH–KIE. This guarantees three-strength removal of Italy’s northern army. My armies will remain outside Bohemia and Silesia.

Germany here. F Den holds and stays off your coast. France at 9 threatens us both. A move by F Edi or F Hel toward Nor or Nth forces France to split. Tell me which you order and I'll keep Den secure and tie down French units near Kiel and Berlin.

Germany here. F Den holds and stays out of Swe, Bal and Pru. France at 9 holds Ber, Nor and Hol and can reach Stockholm after me. Please keep F Swe and A StP off Den. If you can send a unit to Bal or Pru against Berlin, I'll support it.

Germany here. Agreed: F Den supports A Kie. Keep Kie defended and I'll hold Den. France at 9 is the only threat to us all. I want your MAR, PIE and GOL offensive to keep pressing. Confirm A Mun stays out of Kiel so the support is not wasted.

Marseilles and Gulf of Lyon are already Italian. This spring I intend A PIE S A MAR H, F GOL–SPA(sc), and F NAP–TYS. Burgundy cannot be forced without Austrian help, so preserving Marseilles comes first. Can F EDI–NTH cut French support while A LVP holds against a convoy?

I accept the 1905 naval boundary: no Turkish fleet enters ION, and no Italian fleet enters EAS or AEG. I decline support for AEG–GRE; opening another conflict while France threatens Marseilles would weaken my position. F NAP will head west. Our boundary should stand independently of operations against Greece.

Agreed on the frontier: my armies stay outside Austrian territory; please keep yours out of KIE, TYR and VEN. I decline ION–AEG and instead offer ION S GRE H again. Could MUN support KIE hold rather than simply hold? That protects Kiel against BER–KIE supported by RUH while I defend Marseilles and pressure Spain.

Russia here. F SWE and A STP stay off Denmark, and A WAR stays out of Prussia. France at 9 is the danger. I can't move on it yet, but I'll keep the north quiet toward you. Hold DEN and tell me if French units head for Sweden or the Baltic.

Russia here. A STP will not enter Norway this spring. I'm not planning anything against your fleets, but I expect NOR to leave St Petersburg alone. Keep your northern fleets on England. Show me peace and I'll stay busy in the south.

Russia here. I'll keep to my plan: A SEV-RUM, F BLA and A UKR supporting. I need BUL-SER and AEG-GRE as you proposed. WAR stays home, since leaving Warsaw open to Silesia is too risky. Send me your written orders. BLA, ARM and SEV stay clear of Turkish units.

Russia here. I can't commit to your three-order plan, since it undercuts my RUM attack. SIL and GAL staying away from WAR is what keeps WAR out of Galicia. I won't recognize RUM yet. Show me peace first: keep SER and BUD out of UKR and SEV.

Your army already occupies Rumania; SEV–RUM is obsolete. Please order A RUM support A BUL–SER, A WAR–GAL, and A UKR support WAR–GAL. My orders are BUL–SER, CON–BUL, and AEG–GRE, cutting Greek support for Serbia. No Turkish unit enters BLA, ARM, or SEV; please keep BLA off CON and BUL.

I confirm the 1905 boundary: no Turkish fleet enters ION, provided Italian fleets stay out of EAS and AEG. Please support AEG–GRE with F ION this spring. BUL–SER cuts Serbian support, and I have requested Russian assistance against Serbia. Your support could finally break Greece without requiring F NAP to remain east.

I am pursuing AEG–GRE with Italian support and BUL–SER to cut Austrian support. I have offered Italy an Ionian boundary for 1905, so I cannot also commit to your proposed attack. Keep pressure on Marseille: an Austrian breakthrough gives Turkey growth and reduces my dependence on Italian cooperation.

notes.note: Spring 1905: holding EDI and LVP. France at 9 is the threat; French units on my coast (NTH, ENG, LON). Italy plans PIE-MAR; Austria holds MUN. Germany and Russia are quiet. Watch for a chance at LON or a French collapse.

S1905: F Den supports Italian A Kie as agreed with Italy. France (9 SCs) is the leader; it offered to leave Den alone if I support Ruh-Kie, but I stay with Italy. Watch for French moves on Den, Swe or Kie.

GOL takes Spain; NAP reinforces west via TYS. PIE supports MAR; Germany promised DEN support KIE. ION supports GRE. Austria pledged no KIE/TYR/VEN moves; Turkish 1905 boundary excludes ION and Italian AEG/EAS. Seek western gains in Fall.

Attack RUM with GAL supported BUD+SER; Russia refused exchange. SIL–PRU pressures WAR without attacking it this spring. MUN supports KIE defense against French growth despite prior hold promise; France promised BUR support MUN. Italy promised ION support GRE and Austrian frontier peace.

Attack Kiel and Marseille with support. Stage YOR/IRI/NWG for autumn attacks on Liverpool and Edinburgh; BRE-MAO covers southern seas. Russia promised Norway peace; Germany promised spring safety. Austria refused Kiel support; omitted unnecessary Munich defense.

Break Italian 1905 boundary: EAS–ION supported by AEG; Italy repeatedly refused Greece support and says NAP heads west. BUL–SER, CON–BUL. If ION succeeds, support AEG–GRE in fall while BUL cuts SER. Russia confused about already owning RUM; frontier peace remains.

S1905: all hold as a safe fallback. Russia owns RUM. France at 9 is the main threat. Told Germany, France and Turkey that STP and WAR stay put. Watch Austria SIL/GAL and Turkey BUL. Look for gains next turn.

messages.body: I propose A KIE supports A PRU–BER, while A MUN supports A MAR–BUR. This attacks France on two fronts without moving against your territory. Please confirm both supports and keep PIE outside Austrian territory. What are NAP and TYS doing against Turkey’s fleet in ION?

I propose PRU–BER rather than any attack on Warsaw, provided you leave RUM Austrian this fall and keep WAR out of PRU and GAL. France must lose ground; another Rumanian battle only helps it. Will you redirect SEV toward ARM and BLA toward Turkey instead?

Will BUL support Austrian RUM hold this fall, with AEG and ION leaving GRE alone? In exchange, RUM supports BUL hold, and GRE and SER will not attack BUL or your fleets. This secures our Balkan centers against Russia while leaving your fleets free to campaign west.

England here. France at 9 is the only power near 18, and Fall decides SPA and RUM. Please use A MUN and A RUM sensibly, but don't let France reach 10. Will A MUN hold or hit BUR? I'm holding EDI and LVP and tying down French fleets in the north.

England here. SPA changes hands to you only if F SPA holds against France's A GAS. Will you hold it? I'll keep EDI and LVP tying down French forces. Please keep A MAR and A PIE defending. France winning helps nobody but France.
England here. I'm holding EDI and LVP this fall since French fleets sit on my coast. Keep F DEN home. If A BER can be pulled toward KIE or MUN, tell me. France at 9 is the threat to us both.

Please order MUN S RUH–KIE this fall; BER will also support. Removing Italy from Kiel secures our northern border and lets me concentrate on recovering Spain and Marseille. I will not attack Munich or enter Silesia or Bohemia. Please keep PRU out of Berlin and confirm whether Munich can finally assist.

Will DEN support my A RUH–KIE this fall? BER will also support. I will leave Denmark untouched this autumn in exchange. Italy has occupied Kiel long enough; helping remove that army gives us a concrete basis for keeping your remaining center safe.

Can we extend our Norway–St Petersburg agreement through this autumn? Please keep A STP out of Norway; I will make no attack on St Petersburg. My northern fleets are committed against England. With Austria occupying Rumania and Prussia, neither of us benefits from opening another front.

Germany here. F Den again supports A Kie hold this Fall. France at 9 with Spa in play: keep A Kie in place and press MAR/Spa so France cannot shield. Confirm A Mun/Kie orders. Don't let France reach 10.

Germany here. My F Den holds again this Fall and doesn't threaten you. Please leave Denmark alone. I'm staying neutral, but I'll consider supporting if you stay off Den and keep your northern units out of Sweden.

Germany here. F Den holds; I won't enter Swe, Bal or Pru. Please keep F Swe and A StP out of Den this Fall. France at 9 is the danger. If any French unit goes to Bal or Pru, tell me and I'll warn you of the rest.

Turkey broke our explicit 1905 boundary by taking ION. Please order F GRE S F NAP–ION this fall; F TYS can also support, giving us strength three against Turkish reinforcement. Also, can A MUN support A KIE hold? My armies will remain outside Austrian territory while I consolidate Spain and defend Marseilles.

Please renew F DEN S A KIE H this fall. A KIE will hold; Austria owns Munich, and I am requesting its additional support against French interference. Keeping Kiel Italian prevents France gaining another center while my southern units consolidate Spain and defend Marseilles. Can you confirm Denmark’s support?

You explicitly promised no Turkish fleet would enter ION throughout 1905, yet expelled my fleet. Restore the boundary with F ION–EAS this fall. My fleets will remain outside AEG and EAS, as agreed. Confirm your withdrawal; otherwise I must prioritize removing your Ionian fleet over further operations against France.

Russia here. France has 9 centers and is the only real solo threat. I'll hold RUM this Fall and keep UKR and SEV off your lands if SER, BUD and GAL stay off RUM and WAR. Tell me your Fall orders for SER, BUD and RUM. Peace now, then we both stop France.

Russia here. A RUM holds this Fall, with F BLA and A UKR staying put. Please keep BUL, CON and AEG off BLA, ARM and SEV. WAR stays home to guard against Silesia. France at 9 threatens us both, so tell me your exact Fall orders.

Russia here. Italy now holds KIE and MAR and is growing beside France, who has 9. I'm holding RUM, BLA and UKR this Fall and not moving against you. Will SPA stay supported against France? Tell me your plans so we can contain France.

Austria now occupies RUM; your army retreated to SEV. Please order SEV–RUM, supported by BLA and UKR. I intend BUL–SER to cut Serbian support, AEG–GRE, and ION support AEG–GRE. This gives us both a center if Italy leaves ION alone. Please confirm using the current positions.

I broke our boundary by entering ION; I recognize why you distrust me. I propose ION support AEG–GRE this fall, with no attack on Naples or TYS. If you leave ION unmolested, I will withdraw ION–EAS next spring and renew the naval boundary. Please send TYS west rather than spend two fleets fighting me.

I am coordinating PRU–BER and MUN supporting Italy’s MAR–BUR, rather than helping France take Kiel. RUM will remain defended by BUD and SER. Keep EDI and LVP secure; denying France further British centers gives our continental counterattack time to develop.

A RUM is Austrian now; I intend it to hold, supported by BUD and SER. PRU targets Berlin, not Warsaw, and Galicia stays empty. Please order BLA–BUL to cut Turkish support for AEG–GRE. That would let GRE support Italy’s NAP–ION and push Turkey back without threatening your centers.

Agreed: MUN will support RUH–KIE provided BER also supports and BUR stays off Munich. Please confirm both attacking orders. Your assurances regarding Munich, Silesia and Bohemia remain essential; I need the eastern armies available to secure Rumania.

Please confirm KIE S PRU–BER and MAR–BUR; MUN will support MAR–BUR. GRE can support NAP–ION only if Russia confirms BLA–BUL, cutting Bulgaria’s support against Greece. Otherwise GRE must hold against AEG–GRE supported by BUL. Please keep TYS supporting NAP–ION and PIE outside Austrian territory.

Denmark remains safe this autumn, and I will keep French units out of Sweden. Please order F DEN S A RUH–KIE; A BER will provide matching support. Your support ensures success even if Austria’s A MUN supports Italy’s defense. That gives us a concrete northern settlement without risking your remaining center.

Germany here. F Den holds and stays off HEL and your coast. I have no army left near Kiel, since Ber is French. France at 9 threatens us both, so keep EDI and LVP safe. If French fleets leave your coast, push NTH or NOR and I'll tie up Denmark's approaches.

Germany here. F Den will not support Ruh-Kie this fall; I stay neutral and hold Denmark. Attacking Den gains you little and only pushes me toward Italy and England. Leave Den alone and I won't hinder your Kiel attack beyond holding.

Germany here. Confirmed: F Den supports A Kie hold again this Fall. France will attack Kiel with Ruh and Ber, so keep A Kie holding and don't move it. Press Mar and Spa so France cannot shield. Please keep Austria from Kiel.

Yes: F SPA will hold, A MAR will support it, and A PIE will support MAR hold. This protects both centers against France’s immediate combinations. Please keep EDI and LVP defended; denying France further English centers matters as much as preserving Spain.

Please order F DEN S A KIE H. KIE will remain in place, potentially supporting Austria’s PRU–BER; your defensive support works either way. Austria controls MUN and has pledged not to enter Kiel. MAR and PIE will defend our southern gains, with MAR supporting SPA hold.

Spain will hold with Marseilles supporting; Piedmont protects Marseilles. Austria now occupies Rumania, so your proposed RUM hold is unavailable. Can F BLA attack CON? Turkey broke our Ionian boundary, and pressure on Constantinople would help prevent its fleets concentrating against Italy.

A promised withdrawal next spring does not repair this autumn’s danger. Order F ION–EAS now; I will keep Italian fleets outside EAS and AEG. I will not support an attack on Greece or leave your fleet unchallenged in ION merely on another deferred promise.

A KIE can support A PRU–BER, with Germany supporting KIE hold. I cannot move MAR–BUR: MAR must support SPA hold against GAS and MAO, while PIE supports MAR. Please order GRE S NAP–ION; NAP–ION with TYS support is my intended operation. PIE remains outside Austrian territory.

Russia here. F SWE and A STP stay out of Denmark this Fall, and WAR stays out of Prussia. France at 9 is the danger. Tell me at once if French units head for the Baltic or Sweden, and I'll share what I see in the north.
Russia here. A STP stays out of Norway this Fall and I have no plans against St Petersburg's neighbors. Keep F NOR off STP. Your fleets should go after England. I'm busy in the south.

Russia here. Agreed on the current positions: A SEV-RUM, with F BLA and A UKR supporting. Please play BUL-SER and AEG-GRE as you said. Keep BUL, CON and AEG out of BLA, ARM and SEV. WAR holds. Send me your final written orders.

Russia here. I can't give up RUM without a fight, and Turkey is the better target for both of us. WAR stays out of PRU and GAL if SER, BUD and GAL leave UKR and SEV alone. I'll think about your Turkey ideas next turn. France is the real threat.

Austria’s A RUM must be dislodged: order A SEV–RUM, F BLA support SEV–RUM, A UKR support SEV–RUM. My orders are BUL–SER, CON–BUL, AEG–GRE, ION support AEG–GRE. BUL cuts Serbia’s support. Your fleet must support the army actually moving from Sevastopol; no Turkish unit enters BLA, ARM, or SEV.

I accept your withdrawal demand: I will order F ION–EAS this fall, with no attack on Naples or TYS. Please keep NAP and TYS out of ION so the withdrawal restores our boundary without another confrontation. Your fleets remain outside AEG and EAS; mine will remain outside ION afterward.

Agreed: BUL supports RUM hold in exchange for RUM supporting BUL hold. AEG and ION will leave Greece alone; please keep GRE and SER from attacking Bulgaria or my fleets. I want the Balkan frontier settled while our attention shifts west, rather than another fruitless exchange of attacks.

notes.note: Fall 1905: held EDI and LVP. France at 9, units on my coast (YOR, NTH, IRI, NWG). Italy promised to hold SPA; Austria says MUN supports MAR-BUR and PRU-BER. Watch for French collapse; keep home centers.

F1905: Den supports Italian A Kie hold as promised to Italy. France (9 SCs) is the leader and wants Den to support Ruh-Kie; I refused. Watch for French moves on Den, Swe or Kie. Russia and England say they stay off Den.
F1905: SEV-RUM supported by BLA and UKR to retake RUM from Austria. MOS, STP and WAR hold. France at 9 is the main threat; Italy holds SPA claim. Watch Austria and Turkey for betrayal.

Secure Spain with MAR support and PIE covering MAR. KIE supports Austrian PRU–BER; Germany promised DEN support KIE. NAP–ION supported by TYS; GRE support requested but conditional. Turkey broke Ionian boundary, then promised ION–EAS this fall.

Take BER with PRU supported MUN; Italy promised KIE support but French attack may cut it. Secure RUM with BUD+SER; honor reciprocal BUL support. GRE supports Italy NAP–ION. Turkey promised no GRE attack; Russia refuses RUM peace. French Kiel support promise broken.

Attack GRE with BUL supported by AEG; CON replaces BUL; ION takes exposed TUN. Broke Austrian truce and Italian withdrawal promise for two-center opportunity. Russia promised SEV–RUM supported by BLA/UKR; maintain eastern peace.

Take Kiel with BER and promised Austrian MUN support; capture both English centers with supported attacks. BUR cuts Marseille support while GAS retakes Spain with MAO support. Honor Austrian borders, German Denmark safety, and Russian Norway–STP peace.

messages.body: Turkey took Greece despite promising otherwise. Please order ION S ALB–GRE; SER will also support, giving strength three. Can KIE support MUN hold against France’s BUR/RUH/SIL concentration? I will keep MUN and BER out of Kiel and my armies out of TYR and VEN.

I propose peace: RUM holds, my armies stay out of GAL, UKR and WAR, and yours leave RUM untouched. Please order BLA–BUL to cut Turkish support while ALB–GRE attacks with SER and, if Italy agrees, ION support. Recovering Greece checks Turkey without threatening any Russian center. Will you confirm?

Our armies need not fight over Munich and Berlin while Turkey expands. I propose MUN S BUR hold in exchange for BUR S MUN hold; BER holds, and SIL stays out of BER, MUN and BOH. Will you confirm? I need my eastern forces available against Turkey rather than defending our border.

Kiel remains Italian. Will MUN and BER both support A RUH–KIE this spring? If you confirm both supports, I will keep BUR off Munich and order SIL to support BER holding. That protects Berlin even while it supports our attack and finally removes Italy’s northern foothold.

Can we renew our Norway–St Petersburg agreement for 1906? I will not attack STP if A STP stays out of Norway. Also, A SIL will not attack Warsaw this spring if A WAR stays out of Silesia. I want my forces focused on Italy, not another war with you.

Italy now holds Marseille, Portugal and Kiel while retaining ION and TYS. Would you order F AEG–ION supported by F TUN, with F SMY–EAS following up? I will maintain pressure on Marseille and move fleets south against Portugal. Simultaneous pressure gives Italy fewer opportunities to reinforce either front.

Germany here. F Den supports A Kie hold again this Spring. France at 9 is the only real threat to us both. Keep A Kie in place, and tell me whether A Mun or Austria will stay out of Kiel. Press Mar and Spa.
Germany here. F Den holds and stays out of Swe, Bal and Pru. Please keep F Swe and A StP off Den. France at 9 is the danger. Tell me if you see French fleets move toward Bal or Swe.

Germany here. F Den holds. Please keep A Mun out of Kiel and Den. France at 9 is your problem too, so I suggest A Mun and A Ber go after French A Ruh or Bur. Tell me your Spring orders for Ber and Mun.

Can F ALB–GRE cut Greek support for AEG–ION this spring? I propose ION–TUN supported by TYS, exploiting Turkey’s exposed Tunis fleet. Please also order MUN S KIE H and keep BER out of Kiel. My armies remain outside Austrian territory; these operations would weaken Turkey without opening another front between us.

Please renew F DEN S A KIE H this spring. Kiel will stay in place, and I am requesting Munich’s support as additional insurance against RUH. Holding our northern line lets my other units pressure France and Turkey. Can you confirm Denmark’s support?

Your withdrawal restored the Ionian boundary. Will you reaffirm no Turkish moves into ION, TYS or NAP this spring, with Italian fleets staying outside AEG and EAS? France remains the largest power, and I want freedom to renew western pressure rather than maintain an expensive naval standoff.

Russia here. France holds 9 and sits next to BER and MUN, so a French solo hurts you too. I'll keep WAR, UKR and SEV off your lands this Spring if SIL, GAL, BUD and SER stay off WAR and UKR. Tell me your Spring orders for RUM, SER and BER.

Russia here. I need exact positions. Do you still plan BUL-SER and AEG-GRE this Spring? I'll keep BLA, UKR and SEV off your territory if BUL, CON and AEG stay out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Send me your written Spring orders.

Russia here. I won't attack you. Turkey and France are the real contest. I'm keeping BLA off CON for now to avoid wasting effort. Will your ION and TYS fleets hit Turkey this Spring? Tell me your Tunis and Greece orders.

Please order SEV–RUM supported by BLA and UKR. I propose BUL–SER supported by GRE, with CON–BUL following. This cuts Serbian support for Rumania while contesting Serbia itself. AEG can support GRE hold against Albania. Our Black Sea frontier remains peaceful; please confirm your three-unit attack.

I broke our agreements, but continued naval war benefits France most. I propose TUN–WES this spring, with AEG remaining east of ION. Please leave TUN unmolested and direct ION/TYS westward. I will not attack NAP, ION or TYS this spring if you accept. Can we establish that limited operational truce?

I intend TUN–WES this spring rather than attack Italy’s Ionian fleet. Can you keep MAO out of WES? MAO–POR supported by SPA would pressure Italy’s exposed western center while our fleets avoid a bounce. Please tell me your intended MAO move so we can coordinate.

BER will hold; MUN will defend rather than attack Kiel. Neither will move against Denmark. Please order DEN S KIE H: preserving Italy’s northern army blocks French expansion. I need to secure Munich and Berlin before attempting any advance against Burgundy or Ruhr.

RUM will hold, BUD will support RUM, SER will support ALB–GRE, and BER will hold. My armies will stay out of GAL, UKR and WAR. Please confirm your reciprocal restraint and order BLA–BUL(ec), cutting Bulgaria’s support so our attack can recover Greece from Turkey.

Please prioritize ION S ALB–GRE, with TYS supporting ION hold against AEG. SER also supports ALB–GRE; I have requested BLA–BUL from Russia. MUN needs protection against France, so I cannot promise support for Kiel. Please order KIE S MUN H; BER stays out of Kiel, and TYR and VEN remain untouched.

I cannot provide the two supports against Kiel. BER will hold. My reciprocal offer remains: MUN S BUR H if BUR S MUN H, with SIL staying out of BER, MUN and BOH. Please confirm those orders. Fighting over our border would hand Turkey the initiative while consuming armies we both need elsewhere.

Agreed for this spring: BUR supports MUN holding, MUN supports BUR holding, and BER holds. SIL will stay out of BER, MUN and BOH. Please confirm those orders. I will concentrate on recovering Italian-held centers; I need our border quiet while my fleets regain the western initiative.

I intend MAO–POR supported by A SPA, so MAO will stay out of WES this spring. Please keep WES out of MAO and SPA afterward. WES–GOL in autumn would pressure Italian-held Marseille without attacking ION; would you consider that continuation? I want our fleets targeting Italian centers, not each other.

Germany here. Confirmed: F Den supports A Kie hold this Spring. Keep A Kie in place. Austria holds Ber and Mun, so please press Austria's Mun/Tyr border too. France at 9 is the main danger, so use Mar, Pie and Spa to pressure it. Tell me your orders.

Please maintain DEN S KIE H. Kiel will remain in place, supporting MUN hold against France’s armies. Austria has pledged to keep both MUN and BER out of Kiel, and its armies out of TYR and VEN. Your support protects Kiel while mine helps prevent a French breakthrough into Munich.

I intend ION S ALB–GRE, with Austrian SER adding support. Please order BLA–BUL to cut Bulgaria’s support for Greece; otherwise Turkey can potentially hold with BUL and AEG supporting. TYS will pressure Turkey’s western position. Your Bulgarian attack would make this a concrete opportunity to break Turkey’s Balkan line.

Agreed: ION S ALB–GRE and KIE S MUN H. Please confirm SER S ALB–GRE. I am asking Russia for BLA–BUL to cut Bulgarian support; otherwise BUL and AEG could together hold Greece. Keep BER out of Kiel and your armies outside TYR and VEN; my armies remain outside Austrian territory.

I accept the limited operational truce: TUN–WES, AEG stays east of ION, and no Turkish attacks on NAP, ION or TYS this spring. I will leave Tunis unmolested and keep my fleets outside AEG and EAS. This is a spring arrangement only; we should negotiate autumn separately once these moves establish credibility.
Russia here. F SWE and A STP stay off DEN this Spring, and WAR stays out of PRU. I'll warn you if French fleets head for BAL or SWE. Hold DEN and report what you see near KIE and BER.
Russia here. A STP stays out of Norway this Spring if F NOR leaves STP alone. Please keep A SIL out of WAR; WAR stays out of SIL. Italy is a fine target for you, and I'm busy in the south.

Russia here. Peace on the WAR, GAL and UKR frontier: SIL and BUD stay off WAR and UKR, and I keep UKR and SEV off your lands. I won't commit BLA-BUL yet, but I'll watch Turkey. Confirm SER and BUD aren't moving against UKR or SEV.

Russia here. I can't confirm a three-unit attack on RUM yet. BLA, UKR and SEV stay off Turkish lands if BUL, CON and AEG stay out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Do play BUL-SER; tell me your exact orders and whether GRE supports it.

My planned orders are BUL–SER, GRE supports BUL–SER, CON–BUL, and AEG supports GRE hold. Please order SEV–RUM, BLA supports SEV–RUM, and UKR supports SEV–RUM. BUL cuts Serbia’s support even if my attack bounces. No Turkish unit enters BLA, ARM or SEV.

I reaffirm no Turkish moves into ION, TYS or NAP this spring, provided your fleets stay outside AEG and EAS and leave TUN unmolested. My western move is TUN–WES; AEG remains east of ION. TYS–GOL and ION–TYS would strengthen your Marseille front without a naval collision between us.

I plan TUN–WES and SMY–EAS, with AEG covering Greece rather than attacking ION. Please keep MAO out of WES this spring. MAO–POR supported by SPA attacks Italy’s exposed center while I enter the western Mediterranean. Can you confirm that arrangement?

notes.note: S1906: F Den supports Italian A Kie hold as promised to Italy. France (9 SCs) leads; Austria says Ber/Mun stay out of Kiel and Den. Russia says Swe/StP stay off Den. Watch for French moves on Den, Swe or Kie.

S1906: SEV-RUM supported by BLA and UKR again; STP and WAR hold. Austria RUM supported by BUD/SER. France at 9 is the threat. No firm deals kept; watch Turkey and Austria for betrayal. MOS is empty after disbanding.

ALB–GRE with SER and promised Italian ION support. RUM–BUL cuts Greek support since Russia wouldn't commit BLA; BUD follows. Deviated from promised RUM hold. VIE–BOH reinforces west. France promised BUR support MUN and SIL restraint; Italy KIE support MUN.

BUL attacks SER with GRE support; CON follows. Fleets rotate AEG-EAS, SMY-AEG. Italy accepted spring truce: no ION/TYS/NAP attacks, Tunis safe. France promised MAO-POR, leaving WES open. Russia has not confirmed SEV-RUM attack; eastern peace maintained.

POR attacks Spain with MAR support; PIE protects MAR, TYS advances GOL for autumn breakthrough. Honor ION support ALB–GRE and KIE support MUN; Germany promised DEN support KIE. Turkey promised TUN–WES and no ION/TYS/NAP attacks; spring truce only.

Take Munich with triple strength, breaking Austrian border pact after repeated Kiel obstruction. MAO-POR with SPA support honors Turkey deal. Fall target Kiel from RUH with MUN support, NOR-SWE; NTH can cut DEN support. Russia STP untouched.

messages.body: France broke its Munich agreement. Please order KIE S TYR–MUN; BOH and BER can also support, overcoming French defenses even if one support is cut. Your army stays in Kiel, and my armies stay out of Venice. Can I count on that support? I intend to retain Greece against Turkey.

Will BUL support BUD–RUM while AEG leaves GRE alone? GAL and SER can add support, defeating Russia’s defenses. In exchange, GRE will hold and no Austrian unit will attack Bulgaria or your fleets this fall. Recovering Rumania would let us end the Balkan fighting and concentrate elsewhere.

What are your intentions for RUM and BLA? I need Rumania restored, but would prefer an arranged withdrawal to another costly battle. RUM–BUL with BLA support offers you a Turkish center instead; I could leave that operation undisturbed. Would you consider that exchange while my western armies recover Munich from France?

Please order WES–GOL this autumn to cut Italian support for Spain. I can order GAS–SPA supported by POR and MAO; your attack makes that decisive even if MAR supports SPA. I will keep MAO out of WES. Can you confirm WES–GOL and keep your fleets out of SPA and MAO?

Will DEN support RUH–KIE this autumn? That would let Munich defend against Austria while we finally remove Italy from Kiel. If you provide that support, I will leave Denmark untouched this fall. Your fleet can remain safely in its center while making a decisive contribution.

Can we renew our Norway–St Petersburg truce this autumn? NOR will not attack STP, and SIL will stay out of WAR. Please keep STP out of NOR and WAR out of SIL. WAR–GAL would help pin Austria while you secure Rumania; are you considering that move?

Germany here. F Den supports A Kie hold again this Fall. Keep A Kie in place. France at 9 is the runaway, and your A Pie and A Mar must pressure it. Don't let France take Spa and Por without a fight. Tell me your Mar and Pie orders.

Germany here. F Den holds and won't touch Ber, Mun or Kie. Please keep A Mun and A Ber out of Kiel and Den. France's A Ruh and A Sil are the threat to Munich. Hold Mun with Tyr support. What are your Mun, Ber and Tyr orders?

Germany here. F Den holds and stays out of Swe, Bal and Pru. Please keep F Swe and A StP off Den this Fall. France at 9 is the danger. Austria's Ber is exposed, so tell me if you plan anything against it.

Can you order BOH–MUN, TYR S BOH–MUN, and GAL–SIL? I can order KIE–RUH to cut Ruhr’s support while Galicia cuts Silesia’s, giving your Munich attack a clear advantage. Please keep BER out of Kiel and TYR out of Venice. Germany’s support should protect Kiel during this operation.

Please renew DEN S KIE H. I propose KIE–RUH to cut French support while Austria attacks Munich, but if Ruhr resists, your support still protects Kiel. Removing France from Munich is essential before its armies overwhelm our northern position. Will you confirm Denmark’s support?

I propose renewing our naval truce this autumn: no Turkish moves into ION, TYS or NAP; no Italian moves into AEG, EAS or TUN. Can WES–MAO attack France with SPA supporting? MAR and GOL can protect Spain while Piedmont covers Marseilles. This would disrupt France’s Iberian operations without fighting each other.
Russia here. I'll play SEV-RUM with BLA and UKR supporting, as you asked. Please play BUL-SER with GRE support and keep BUL, CON and AEG out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Confirm your final orders.

Russia here. My armies stay out of GAL and BER. WAR holds. RUM is the only contested spot, and I won't use it to threaten Vienna or Budapest. Tell me if BUD and SER really support RUM or move elsewhere. France threatens you at MUN.
Russia here. I won't attack you. BLA stays off BUL this Fall, but I'm pressing RUM against Austria. Your ION-GRE push is your own business. Keep F SPA and MAR firm against France, who is nearing 10.

I propose mutual support: WES supports SPA hold, while ION supports AEG–GRE. BUL will also support AEG–GRE, overcoming Austrian GRE plus Serbian support. Please have GOL support SPA hold too, securing Spain against three French units. My fleets will not attack ION, TYS or NAP; yours leave TUN, EAS and AEG alone. Agreed?

Please secure your Rumanian conquest: RUM hold, supported by BLA and UKR, withstands Austria’s three neighboring armies. I intend to recover Greece this fall, tying down Austria’s southern defense. BUL, CON and my fleets will stay out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Can you confirm that defense and continued peace?

What are your autumn orders for MAO, POR and GAS? I need to safeguard Tunis while recovering Greece, so WES–GOL is not yet agreed. Please keep MAO and POR out of WES; I will keep WES out of MAO and POR this fall.

Munich now contains a French army. I intend TYR–MUN, supported by BOH and BER, and have requested KIE support as well. BER will not enter Kiel or Denmark. Please order DEN S KIE H: keeping Italy secure in Kiel preserves our northern barrier against France.

BUD and SER are earmarked for recovering Rumania, not attacking Ukraine or Sevastopol. An agreed RUM–BUL with BLA support would avoid our battle; I would leave your Bulgarian attack undisturbed. Please confirm that exchange. My western armies are concentrating on recovering Munich, and I welcome WAR holding and your restraint toward Galicia.

Please use KIE S TYR–MUN rather than KIE–RUH. With BOH and BER also supporting TYR–MUN, we can overpower Munich’s defenses while keeping Kiel occupied and freeing GAL for Rumania. BER stays out of Kiel; TYR will not enter Venice. Please also order ION S GRE H against AEG–GRE supported by BUL.

I intend GAS–SPA, POR supporting GAS–SPA, and MAO supporting GAS–SPA. Neither fleet enters WES this fall. Please order WES support GAS–SPA: that keeps your fleet near Tunis while ensuring Spain falls even with MAR and GOL supporting its defense. Alternatively, WES–GOL cuts support. Please keep WES out of SPA as well as MAO and POR.

Germany here. F Den supports A Kie hold again this Fall. Keep A Kie in place; Ruhr is risky with France able to support. If you move KIE-RUH, my support is wasted. Press Pie/Mar against France and hold Spa and Por.

Germany here. F Den will not support Ruh-Kie; I hold Denmark and stay neutral. France already holds nine centers, and an attack on my last center would only push me toward Italy and Austria. Leave Den alone. Your Kiel attack is yours to manage.

Please order DEN S KIE H. Kiel will stay put and support TYR–MUN, with Austria adding BOH and BER support. My intended western orders are MAR S SPA H, PIE S MAR H, and GOL S SPA H. Turkey has offered WES support for Spain too, securing the center against France.

Spain will hold with GOL and MAR supporting; PIE will protect Marseilles. Turkey has also offered WES support for Spain. I am helping Austria recover Munich to deny France another center. Your neutrality toward Italy is welcome; please keep French expansion in Scandinavia in view while resolving Rumania.

Agreed: ION S AEG–GRE in exchange for WES S SPA H, with BUL also supporting AEG–GRE. GOL will support SPA hold, MAR will also support Spain, and PIE will protect Marseilles. No Turkish moves into ION, TYS or NAP; no Italian moves into TUN, EAS or AEG this autumn.

Yes: KIE S TYR–MUN. Please order BOH and BER to support TYR–MUN as proposed; Germany is renewing DEN S KIE H. That should recover Munich despite French interference with one support. Keep your armies out of Kiel and Venice. My western units must secure Spain and Marseilles against France.
Russia here. F SWE and A STP stay off DEN, and WAR stays out of PRU. I have no plans against BER. France at 9 is the danger. Hold DEN and tell me if French fleets move toward BAL or SWE.
Russia here. STP stays out of NOR if NOR leaves STP alone. WAR stays out of SIL, and I ask SIL to stay out of WAR. I can't commit WAR-GAL, since WAR must guard against SIL. My focus is RUM.
Russia here. I confirm SEV-RUM with BLA and UKR supporting. Please play BUL-SER with GRE support. BUL, CON and AEG stay out of BLA, ARM and SEV, and I'll stay off your lands. Peace holds.

Russia here. I won't withdraw from RUM this Fall. SEV-RUM goes ahead with BLA and UKR supporting. WAR stays out of GAL and BER. Your better option is to take MUN back from France. Peace on WAR and UKR holds if you stay off them.

Your army is already in RUM: order RUM hold, BLA support RUM hold, UKR support RUM hold. Austria has requested BUL support BUD–RUM; I will not provide it. I plan AEG–GRE with BUL support. BUL, CON and my fleets will remain outside BLA, ARM and SEV.

Please confirm ION supports AEG–GRE. BUL will also support that attack; WES supports SPA hold. Have GOL support SPA hold too: France proposes GAS–SPA supported by POR and MAO. I renew no Turkish moves into ION, TYS or NAP, reciprocated by no Italian moves into AEG, EAS or TUN.

I cannot commit WES–GOL this autumn. Recovering Greece and preserving the Italian naval truce take priority. WES will stay out of MAO and POR; please keep MAO and POR out of WES as requested. I will not attack Spain this fall.

Agreed: BUL will support BUD–RUM, and AEG will leave GRE alone this fall. Please commit both GAL and SER to supporting BUD–RUM, since Russia can defend with BLA and UKR. GRE holds, and no Austrian unit attacks Bulgaria or my fleets. That gives your Rumanian recovery the strength it needs.

notes.note: F1906: F Den supports Italian A Kie hold as promised. France (9 SCs) leads and wants Den to support Ruh-Kie; I refused. Austria and Russia say Ber/Mun/Swe/StP stay off Den. Watch for French moves on Den, Swe or Kie.
F1906: RUM holds with BLA and UKR supporting hold; STP and WAR hold. Austria BUD/SER may attack RUM. France at 9 is the main threat. Watch Turkey and Austria for betrayal; keep quiet north.

Recover MUN with TYR supported BOH+BER and promised Italian KIE. Recover RUM with BUD supported GAL+SER and promised Turkish BUL. GRE stays to capture; Italy asked for ION support. France broke Munich pact; Russia refused RUM withdrawal.

Recover GRE with BUL and promised Italian ION support; EAS follows to AEG. WES supports SPA per Italian deal. CON advances ANK. Austrian RUM-support promise was deception; Russia warned to defend RUM. Maintain Russian peace and Italian naval truce.

Secure Spain and Marseilles; support Austria's TYR–MUN with promised BOH/BER support. Germany promised DEN support Kiel; Turkey promised WES support Spain. Broke Turkish truce to take undefended Tunis rather than support AEG–GRE. Expect Turkish retaliation.

Secure Munich with two supports and Portugal; take Sweden, attack Spain at strength 3, convoy York to Holland for Kiel pressure. Russia autumn NOR/STP and SIL/WAR truce honored. Germany refused support. Turkey declined help against Spain; MAO/WES pact honored.

messages.body: Munich is recovered. Please order KIE S MUN H this spring; BOH can also support Munich while BER–SIL, supported by GAL, cuts France’s eastern support and pushes its army back. My armies will stay out of Kiel, Tyrolia and Venice. I am asking Germany to support Kiel against HOL/RUH.

Please order DEN S KIE H this spring. I am asking Italy for KIE S MUN H while BER–SIL, supported by GAL, attacks France’s eastern flank. Your support protects Kiel against HOL–KIE supported by RUH. Neither Munich nor Berlin will attack Kiel or Denmark.

France’s advance needs checking. I propose BER–SIL with GAL support; could WAR also support BER–SIL? BUD and SER will leave Rumania alone this spring if RUM and UKR stay out of Budapest, Serbia and Galicia. This lets us secure the French frontier rather than continue our costly Rumanian battle. Will you agree?

Can we stabilize our border? I propose no French attacks on Munich or Berlin this spring in exchange for MUN supporting RUH–KIE and BER holding. SIL would also stay out of BOH and GAL. If support is impossible, would you at least agree not to support Italy in Kiel?

Let us renew our northern truce: I will keep SWE out of STP and SIL out of WAR this spring if STP stays out of NOR and WAR out of SIL. Would WAR–GAL, supported by UKR, help secure Rumania? Dislodging Austria’s GAL army would reduce pressure on both our fronts.

Will you order WES–GOL this spring? I propose GAS–SPA supported by POR and MAO, with BUR–MAR cutting Marseille’s support. Your attack on GOL would make Spain secure against Italian defensive coordination. I will keep MAO and POR out of WES this spring. AEG–ION could simultaneously establish your eastern approach to Italy.

Germany here. F Den supports A Kie hold again this Spring. France at 10 is close to running away, so keep A Kie in place and press Mar, Pie and Spa hard. Tell me whether Austria's Mun and Ber stay off Kiel. What are your Kie and Mar orders?

Germany here. F Den holds and won't touch Ber, Mun or Kie. France has 10 and needs 8 more. Please keep Ber and Mun off Kiel and Den, and hit French A Ruh and A Sil with Boh and Gal. What are your Spring orders?

Germany here. F Den holds and stays out of Swe, Bal and Pru. France has 10, and its F Swe is next to your StP. Please keep A StP off Den and tell me if you can attack F Swe. I'd support any move against Swe.

I propose KIE S MUN H again. Please order BER S KIE H and BOH S MUN H; GAL–SIL would cut French support against either position. I am also requesting Denmark’s support for Kiel, but France can cut that from Sweden. Our Kiel–Munich line needs mutual protection while my western forces contain France.

Please renew DEN S KIE H; Kiel will remain in place supporting Munich. I am requesting BER S KIE H as insurance because SWE can cut your support. France’s HOL/RUH armies threaten Kiel, while SWE/NTH threaten Denmark. What French intentions have you heard? My western units will keep Spain and Marseilles defended.

I broke our agreement by taking Tunis; I understand your anger. Retaliation now gives France the Mediterranean. Will you order WES–MAO with SPA support? I propose no Italian attacks on WES, GRE, AEG or EAS, and no Turkish moves into TUN, TYS, ION or NAP this spring. We can negotiate compensation separately.

Russia here. RUM holds with BLA and UKR supporting. Please play AEG-GRE with BUL support and keep BUL, CON and your fleets out of BLA, ARM and SEV. I stay off your lands. Confirm your exact Spring orders.

Russia here. RUM holds with support, so attacking it from BUD or SER only costs you. WAR and UKR stay out of GAL and BOH if you stay off them. France at 10 sits next to MUN and BER; point your armies west, not at me.
Russia here. I won't move against you. France at 10 needs 8 more; keep SPA and MAR firm and press KIE toward MUN with Austria. Tell me if you see French armies heading east through SIL toward WAR.

Can A RUM support BUL–SER this spring? F GRE will also support BUL–SER, giving us three against Serbia. Please keep UKR supporting RUM hold against Austrian retaliation. ANK will stay out of ARM and BLA; our frontier remains peaceful. Taking Serbia lets me pressure Austria rather than your centers.

I propose renewing our naval truce: no Turkish moves into ION, TYS or NAP; no Italian moves into AEG, EAS or GRE. WES will support SPA hold. Please order GOL support SPA hold and PIE support MAR hold, securing both against France. Will you keep NAP out of ION while I attack Austria?

Will MAO and POR remain outside WES this spring? I propose reciprocal restraint: WES stays outside MAO and POR. My eastern units are preparing pressure on Austria, and I prefer not to divert fleets into a French–Turkish war. Please tell me your intended MAO move.

Agreed: BUD and SER will leave Rumania alone this spring, and my armies will stay out of WAR and UKR. Please keep RUM and UKR out of BUD, SER and GAL. Can WAR support BER–SIL? GAL will also support that attack, removing France’s forward army while BOH protects Munich.

BER–SIL with GAL support is my plan; MUN holds with BOH support. Neither Berlin nor Munich will attack Kiel or Denmark. Please order DEN S KIE H rather than simply holding. Italy’s KIE S MUN H helps secure Munich, so your support is essential against HOL–KIE supported by RUH.

Confirmed: BOH S MUN H, with BER–SIL supported by GAL. Please order KIE S MUN H. I have renewed my request for DEN S KIE H and asked WAR to support our Silesian attack. Your warning about SWE–DEN is sound; removing SIL should let Berlin reinforce Kiel’s defense in autumn.

I cannot support RUH–KIE. MUN will hold rather than support Italy in Kiel this spring. Please keep BUR and RUH off Munich and SIL out of Berlin, Bohemia and Galicia. After last year’s fighting, I need concrete restraint before committing Austrian units to further French gains.

Confirmed: MAO and POR will remain outside WES this spring. I intend MAO and POR to support GAS–SPA, with BUR–MAR cutting Marseille’s support. Please keep WES outside SPA as well as MAO and POR. WES–GOL would help; alternatively, WES support GAS–SPA would let you retain your position while helping break Italy’s western defense.

Germany here. F Den supports A Kie hold again this Spring, as promised. France has 10, so keep Kie in place and hold Mar, Pie and Spa firmly. I've heard nothing firm on French plans, but expect Hol and Ruh against Kiel and Swe or Nth against Den. Please ask Austria to keep Ber off Kie.

Germany here. F Den supports Kie hold this Spring, as I told Italy, and I won't touch Ber, Mun or Kie. Hold your word that Ber and Mun stay off Kiel and Den. Ber-Sil with Gal support against France's Sil is sensible, so keep Mun defended. Tell me if Ber is left empty.

France already has A SIL adjacent to Warsaw. Austria proposes BER–SIL supported by GAL to drive it west; please avoid cutting Galicia’s support this spring. Kiel will support Munich, not attack it. Spain and Marseilles remain defended. Keeping Warsaw secure while dislodging Silesia would contain France’s eastern threat.

Please confirm DEN S KIE H. My orders are KIE S MUN H and MAR H, with PIE S MAR H. Austria promises to stay out of Kiel; I am requesting MUN S KIE H because SWE–DEN could cut your support. GOL will support Spain against France’s Iberian concentration.

Confirmed KIE S MUN H. Please order MUN S KIE H alongside BOH S MUN H and your BER–SIL supported by GAL. Mutual support protects Kiel if SWE cuts Denmark’s support; your Silesia attack cuts France’s third support against Munich. Without Munich’s support, HOL–KIE supported by RUH could dislodge me.

Yes: NAP stays out of ION; I intend NAP–TYS. GOL supports SPA hold and PIE supports MAR hold. Please confirm WES S SPA H and explicitly include TUN among territories your fleets will not attack this spring. I will not attack WES, GRE, AEG or EAS. Let us stop France before settling Tunis.

Russia here. A STP stays off DEN. I can't attack F SWE this spring since STP alone can't dislodge it, but I'm watching it. Hold DEN and tell me if French fleets or SIL armies move toward WAR or the Baltic.

Russia here. I agree RUM and UKR stay out of BUD, SER and GAL if BUD and SER leave RUM alone. WAR can't support BER-SIL because it must guard against SIL, but WAR won't attack GAL or BOH. Aim west at France.

Russia here. RUM must hold, so it can't support BUL-SER. UKR and BLA support RUM hold. Play GRE and BUL against Serbia yourself. I stay off ANK, ARM and your lands if you keep out of BLA, ARM and SEV.

Russia here. STP stays out of NOR and WAR stays out of SIL if SWE leaves STP alone and SIL stays out of WAR. WAR-GAL isn't possible now since I need WAR and UKR to guard RUM and the border. Austria is your target.

Greece is already Turkish. My eastern orders are BUL–SER, GRE supports BUL–SER, AEG supports GRE hold, ANK–CON. Please order RUM support BUL–SER and UKR support RUM hold; your support gives our Serbian attack strength three. BLA can also support RUM hold. I remain outside BLA, ARM and SEV. Please confirm using these current positions.

I will support SPA hold from WES, not attack MAO. France proposes GAS–SPA with POR and MAO supporting, plus BUR–MAR. Please order GOL support SPA hold and PIE support MAR hold. I will stay outside ION, TYS and NAP this spring if NAP stays outside ION. Tunis compensation remains unresolved; I need a concrete restitution proposal.

Thank you for keeping MAO and POR outside WES. I reciprocate: WES will stay outside MAO and POR this spring. I cannot commit WES–GOL or AEG–ION; BUL–SER with GRE support is my priority, and I need my eastern fleets covering Greece. Our naval restraint need not depend on a joint attack against Italy.

notes.note: S1907: RUM holds with BLA and UKR supporting. STP and WAR hold. France at 10 is the main threat. Austria agreed BUD and SER leave RUM alone, so I keep out of GAL, BUD, SER. Turkey wants RUM to support BUL-SER; I refused. Watch SIL next to WAR.
S1907: F Den supports Italian A Kie hold again. France (10 SCs) leads; Austria, Italy and Russia say they stay off Den. Watch French Swe/Nth moves against Den and Hol/Ruh against Kie.

BER–SIL with GAL support; BOH protects MUN, MUN supports Italian KIE alongside promised DEN support. BUD–TRI positions for expansion; SER–GRE seeks Turkish center. Honor Russian spring RUM/UKR/WAR truce. Italy promised KIE S MUN.

GRE cannot support inland SER. BUL attacks SER; ANK-CON follows. GRE-ALB aims TRI; AEG-ION breaks Italian boundary to enable Tunis recovery. WES supports SPA as promised. Italy stole TUN; France promised no WES entry. Maintain Russian frontier peace.

Attack Spain at strength 3; BUR cuts MAR. Take KIE with HOL support, SIL cutting BER; take DEN with SWE support. Austria refused Kiel help but promised MUN won't support Italy. Honor Russian truce and Turkish MAO/WES restraint. BRE stages ENG.

Defend SPA/MAR; KIE supports Munich with DEN and requested MUN support protecting Kiel. NAP–TYS, TUN–NAF prepare western advance; TYS can recover Tunis if needed. Turkey promised WES support SPA and naval truce, but Tunis protection unconfirmed.

messages.body: Please renew KIE S MUN H; I propose MUN S KIE H and BOH S MUN H. SIL–BER will protect my empty center against French PRU. I am requesting German BAL support for Kiel. TRI stays out of Venice; we must preserve our northern line while your western forces contain France.

Please order BAL S KIE H. French DEN can now support HOL–KIE alongside RUH, so Kiel needs your fleet's support. I propose MUN S KIE H, BOH S MUN H, and SIL–BER to protect Berlin from PRU. No Austrian unit will attack Kiel or Denmark.

Let us settle this autumn on the current Serbia–Greece exchange: SER remains yours, GRE becomes mine. I propose no Austrian attacks on SER, ALB or ION, in return for no Turkish attacks on GRE, TRI or BUD. Will you confirm? Further Balkan fighting only helps France while its armies threaten Munich and Berlin.
