Will MUN support RUH–KIE this autumn? In exchange, BUR will not attack Munich and PRU will not attack Berlin. Removing Italy from Kiel would settle our northern friction without costing Austria a center. This offer is conditional on your confirming Munich’s support; otherwise, please tell me your proposed border arrangement.

Let us renew our northern truce: SWE will stay out of STP and PRU out of WAR if STP stays out of NOR. Could WAR–SIL, supported by UKR–GAL pressure, distract Austria this autumn? Even an unsupported WAR–SIL would cut Austrian support and complicate their defense while your Rumanian army holds.

I propose keeping MAO and POR outside WES again, with WES staying outside MAO, POR and SPA. Would you order WES S ION–TUN? Tunis is vacant, and taking it would give you an Italian center while my pressure on Spain occupies Italy’s western defenders. Please confirm your western fleet plans.

Germany here. My F Bal is dislodged and F Den was lost, so I can't support Kiel now. France has 10 and takes Den this Fall. Hold Kie, press Mar and Pie, and ask Austria to keep Ber and Mun off Kiel. What are your Kie orders?
Germany here. France takes Den this Fall and reaches 11. Please keep Ber and Mun off Kie and hit French A Ruh, Pru and Sil with Boh and Gal. Tell me your Fall orders for Ber, Mun and Sil.
Germany here. France is at 10 and takes Den this Fall. My F Bal is stuck in the Baltic. If you can attack F Swe or A Pru with War and StP, I'll support or cooperate. What are your War and StP orders?

Please order MUN S KIE H and BOH S MUN H; Kiel will support Munich again. I am asking Germany to attack Denmark, cutting its support against Kiel. Can SIL cover Berlin against French PRU? Keeping our northern line intact lets my western units continue containing France.

Please order BAL–DEN this fall. Even if it bounces, it cuts Denmark’s support for HOL–KIE, and might recover your center. I am requesting MUN S KIE H while Kiel supports Munich. BAL supporting Kiel instead risks SWE–BAL cutting that support while Denmark helps France overwhelm Kiel.

Will you order WES–MAO with NAF support? That cuts French support against Spain and offers a western breakthrough. GOL will support Spain and PIE will support Marseilles. I propose no Turkish attacks on TUN, TYS or NAP, and no Italian attacks on ION, ALB, GRE, AEG or EAS this fall. Can you confirm?

Russia here. RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, SER, GAL and BOH this Fall if BUD and SER leave RUM alone. France at 10 threatens your Munich and Berlin side. Keep your armies west and tell me your exact orders for GAL.

Russia here. RUM holds, supported by BLA and UKR. I won't support BUL-SER, but I won't attack SER or your lands. Keep BUL, CON, ANK and your fleets out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Tell me your final Fall orders.

Russia here. I'm not moving against you. RUM and UKR hold and WAR stays out of GAL. France at 10 is the real danger. Please keep SPA and MAR firm and press KIE toward MUN. Tell me your Fall orders for PIE and KIE.

Please order RUM support SER hold this fall, with UKR and BLA supporting RUM hold. That secures both our armies against Austria while my fleets recover Greece. CON will move to BUL; all Turkish units remain outside BLA, ARM and SEV. Can you confirm RUM’s support for Serbia?

I propose restitution now: WES–TUN unopposed, with NAF and TYS neither entering Tunis nor supporting opposition. ION will support ALB–GRE, not attack your remaining centers. In exchange, we establish a naval ceasefire after Tunis returns. France remains our common danger, but indefinitely postponing restitution leaves no durable basis for cooperation.

Will MAO and POR remain outside WES this fall? In exchange I will keep WES outside MAO, POR and SPA. I am seeking Tunis restitution and recovering Greece; I am not offering Italy another guaranteed support for Spain. Your western campaign need not bring our fleets into conflict.

GAL–BUD is my intended order, defending Budapest against Turkey’s A SER. I will not attack Rumania, Warsaw or Ukraine. Please keep RUM, UKR and WAR out of Budapest, Galicia and Bohemia. SIL–BER will cover Berlin against French PRU while BOH supports Munich.

My plan remains SIL–BER, MUN S KIE H and BOH S MUN H. Neither Kiel nor Denmark faces an Austrian attack. Instead of BAL supporting Kiel, please order BAL–DEN: cutting Denmark’s support protects Kiel and might recover your center if France moves. Italy is requesting that attack too.

I cannot support RUH–KIE. I propose mutual restraint instead: BUR and RUH stay off Munich, PRU stays off Berlin and Silesia, and my armies stay out of Burgundy, Ruhr and Prussia. SIL–BER is intended to secure my own center, not launch an attack on yours.

Confirmed: MUN S KIE H, BOH S MUN H and SIL–BER. Please renew KIE S MUN H. I am revising my request to Germany to BAL–DEN, matching yours; cutting Denmark’s support is valuable. TRI will stay out of Venice. Keeping Kiel and Munich secure remains essential.

Confirmed: MAO and POR will remain outside WES this fall; please keep WES outside MAO, POR and SPA. I intend GAS–SPA with MAO and POR supporting, and BUR–MAR cutting support. Please order ION–TUN with WES support: reclaiming Tunis gives you growth without a naval conflict between us.

Germany here. F Bal can't reach Den without a bounce, since French F Den holds and Swe supports it. I'll try Bal-Den anyway if you hold Kie and keep Mun supported. France at 10 is the threat. Please press Mar and Spa. Do you keep Kie in place?

Germany here. Bal can't both support Kie and cover Berlin. I'll order Bal S Kie H as you ask, if Mun supports Kie, Boh supports Mun and Sil goes to Ber. Please confirm Ber stays off Kie and Den, and Sil hits Pru.

PIE S MAR H and KIE S MUN H are my intended orders. Austria will reciprocate with MUN S KIE H and cover Berlin with SIL–BER. France’s eastern army is now in PRU, not SIL. Would you consider WAR–PRU to pressure it? Spain remains defended by GOL.

KIE will support MUN H; Austria promises MUN S KIE H and BOH S MUN H. Please confirm BAL–DEN. Your fleet can attack Denmark despite its retreat last phase, cutting French support against Kiel and potentially recovering your last center. Supporting Kiel instead leaves that support vulnerable to SWE–BAL.

I cannot surrender Tunis while France threatens Spain. My offer remains NAF S WES–MAO, with GOL S SPA H and PIE S MAR H. Alternatively, WES S SPA H secures our front. Will you accept reciprocal restraint: no Turkish attacks on TUN, TYS or NAP; no Italian attacks on ION, ALB, GRE, AEG or EAS?

Confirmed: KIE S MUN H, paired with MUN S KIE H and BOH S MUN H. Please order SIL–BER to deny France your empty center. Germany should order BAL–DEN rather than support Kiel: attacking Denmark cuts its support, while SWE–BAL could cut German support for Kiel. Thank you for keeping TRI out of Venice.

Russia here. I can't take Denmark's fate off France's hands: STP alone can't dislodge F SWE, and WAR must guard against PRU. STP stays off DEN and NOR. WAR holds. I'll keep watching SWE and PRU, so tell me if French armies move on WAR.

Russia here. STP stays out of NOR and WAR holds; I won't enter SIL this fall. Keep SWE off STP and PRU off WAR. UKR and BLA must support RUM against Austria, so no GAL move now. Austria is your target, not me.

Russia here. RUM will hold with BLA and UKR support. I can't support SER, since that would leave RUM exposed. I won't attack SER or your lands. Please keep CON, BUL, ANK and your fleets out of BLA, ARM and SEV.

SER will hold and CON–BUL is planned. Please order RUM support SER hold, with BLA and UKR supporting RUM hold; supporting Serbia does not require RUM to move. My fleets are focused on Greece and the western Mediterranean. All Turkish units will remain outside BLA, ARM and SEV.

Agreed: WES stays outside MAO, POR and SPA provided MAO and POR stay outside WES. I cannot commit ION–TUN because ION is needed against Greece. WES–TUN is my alternative for restitution; please leave that route unobstructed. I am not promising support for Spain.

For this autumn, I will accept WES–MAO with NAF support, postponing Tunis restitution. Please confirm NAF supports WES–MAO, GOL supports SPA hold, and PIE supports MAR hold. I accept no Turkish attacks on TUN, TYS or NAP in exchange for your proposed restraint; ION will cover ALB.

Confirmed: SER remains Turkish and GRE becomes Austrian. No Turkish attacks on GRE, TRI or BUD this autumn, in exchange for no Austrian attacks on SER, ALB or ION. CON–BUL will reinforce my frontier without threatening our settlement. Please concentrate your northern armies against France’s pressure on Munich and Berlin.

notes.note: F1907: Bal-Den attempt to cut French support and maybe retake Den. Germany has 1 center (Den, about to fall). Austria and Italy asked for Bal-Den. France at 10 leads; keep opposing France and look for Den or Swe chances.

F1907: RUM holds with BLA and UKR support; STP and WAR hold. France at 10 is the main threat. Austria agreed to leave RUM alone; Turkey wanted RUM to support SER and I refused. Watch SIL/PRU near WAR.

Secure GRE, cover BUD/BER, preserve Munich–Kiel mutual defense; Germany asked BAL–DEN. TRI–VEN breaks promise to Italy for a center and potential build. Turkey agreed Balkan peace; Russia agreed eastern restraint. Expect Italian anger; rebuild cooperation against France.

Defend SPA/MAR; KIE supports MUN with reciprocal Austrian support and SIL–BER promised. Germany promises BAL–DEN. NAF supports Turkish WES–MAO; TYS follows into WES. Turkey accepted no attacks TUN/TYS/NAP this fall; Tunis restitution postponed.

Take Spain with MAO/POR support; BUR cuts MAR. RUH attacks Kiel with HOL/DEN support; SWE cuts BAL. DEN stays to capture. ENG stages NTH; PRU contests Berlin. Honor Russian truce and Turkish WES restraint. Austria again refused Kiel support; no border deal accepted.

Recover GRE with ION support; retain SER for net growth. Break Austrian Greece settlement and French MAO restraint. Italy promised NAF S WES–MAO; respect its remaining centers. Russia refused SER support but promised eastern peace. Build to exploit Balkans.

messages.body: Taking Venice broke our agreement; I recognize your anger. I propose VEN holds and no Austrian moves toward Rome or Apulia. Please renew KIE S MUN H; I offer MUN S KIE H and BOH S MUN H, with SIL–BER covering Berlin. Can we preserve the northern line while negotiating compensation for Venice?

I propose renewing eastern restraint: BUD leaves RUM alone; RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH. France now threatens Berlin from PRU. Could WAR–PRU pressure that army while SIL–BER covers my center? Please tell me your intentions for WAR and RUM.

Our agreed settlement left Serbia yours but did not deliver Greece to Austria. Will you now arrange GRE–AEG while TRI–ALB positions to enter Greece in autumn? I would leave SER and BUL alone in exchange, provided SER stays out of BUD and TRI. Your western fleets should concentrate against France rather than prolong our Balkan dispute.

Your fleet entered MAO despite our explicit agreement. Will you withdraw MAO–WES this spring and order ION–TUN? MAO–WES would cut Italian support for Spain while Tunis offers you growth. If you confirm MAO–WES and no attack on Portugal, I will keep BRE and POR from attacking MAO this spring.

Let us renew our northern truce this spring: SWE stays out of STP and PRU stays out of WAR if STP stays out of NOR. Will you confirm? With Austria’s army now in Silesia, WAR–GAL could put pressure on Vienna and Budapest while UKR and BLA protect Rumania.

I propose a limited spring arrangement: BUR and RUH will not attack Munich, and PRU will not enter Silesia, provided MUN neither attacks Ruhr nor supports Italy in Kiel. No Austrian support for my attacks is required. Will you confirm? This lets your armies concentrate against Turkey rather than defending Italy’s northern outpost.

Please renew MUN S KIE H and BOH S MUN H; Kiel will support Munich. SIL–BER is essential against French PRU. France can now attack Kiel with HOL, RUH and DEN, so our line remains vulnerable. Please keep TRI out of Italian centers while my western forces contain France.

Can MAO–POR cut Portuguese support for a French attack on Spain? I propose GOL S SPA H, PIE S MAR H, and WES–MAO to follow your advance if Portugal falls. Please renew no Turkish attacks on TUN, TYS or NAP; I will not attack ION, GRE, AEG or EAS this spring.

Please consider WAR–PRU to pressure France’s exposed army, coordinated with Austrian SIL–BER to protect Berlin. STP–FIN would also prepare pressure against French Sweden. Kiel will support Munich while Spain and Marseilles remain defended. Can you confirm your northern plans? France now has eleven centers and Germany’s elimination leaves Denmark uncontested.

Russia here. France has 11 and its armies in PRU and SIL stand next to both of us. RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, SER, GAL and BOH this spring if BUD and SER leave RUM alone. Please send your orders against PRU and RUH. Tell me what GAL and SIL will do.

Russia here. France at 11 is a solo threat to everyone. I won't move against you. Please keep SPA and MAR firm and press KIE toward MUN with Austria. I'll keep WAR guarding against PRU rather than attacking. What are your PIE, GOL and WES orders this spring?

Russia here. RUM holds with BLA and UKR support, and I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. Please keep ANK, CON, BUL and your fleets out of BLA, ARM and SEV. France at 11 is the danger, so use your fleets against its Mediterranean position rather than me.

Will SPA support MAO–POR this spring, with WES supporting SPA hold, GOL also supporting SPA, and PIE supporting MAR? Attacking Portugal cuts its support for GAS–SPA, while potentially winning a French center. I will leave TUN, TYS and NAP untouched this spring. Please confirm the fleet coordination.

Please order RUM support SER–BUD this spring, with BLA and UKR supporting RUM hold. Supporting Budapest does not require RUM to move, and BUD–RUM cannot cut support directed against Budapest unless RUM is dislodged. This opens an Austrian front without threatening you. I will remain outside BLA, ARM and SEV.

What are your plans for BUD and F TRI? France threatens Berlin and Munich, while my MAO fleet can help Italy contain its western expansion. I propose no Turkish attacks on TRI or VEN this spring, in exchange for no Austrian attacks on SER, BUL, GRE or ION. Can we establish that limited boundary?

I have no army in Galicia; SIL–BER is intended to secure Berlin, while BOH supports Munich. BUD will leave Rumania alone. Please confirm RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH. WAR–PRU would pressure France without interfering with Berlin’s defense; can you commit to it?

MUN will not attack Ruhr this spring, and my armies will stay out of Burgundy and Prussia. Please keep BUR and RUH off Munich and PRU off Berlin and Silesia. I cannot accept a prohibition on defensive support for Kiel: that would expose my northern flank without securing Berlin.

Confirmed: MUN S KIE H, BOH S MUN H, and SIL–BER. Please renew KIE S MUN H. VEN will hold; F TRI will not enter Venice or any Italian center. France’s three-unit attack on Kiel remains dangerous, but preserving our mutual support gives us the best chance of holding both centers.

BUD will hold and leave SER and BUL alone. I propose TRI–ALB, with no attack on SER, BUL, GRE or ION this spring, provided SER stays out of BUD and TRI. Please confirm GRE–AEG and Austrian entry into Greece in autumn; that completes our previously agreed settlement while your fleets confront France.

PIE S MAR H, GOL S SPA H, and WES S SPA H are planned; SPA will support Turkish MAO–POR. Kiel supports Munich, not an attack on it. Please reconsider WAR–PRU to disrupt France’s eastern army. STP–NOR would immediately threaten a French center and divert northern forces more effectively than waiting in Finland.

Confirmed: SPA S MAO–POR, WES S SPA H, GOL S SPA H, and PIE S MAR H. Please order MAO–POR as proposed. I accept your pledge to leave TUN, TYS and NAP untouched; I will not attack ION, GRE, AEG or EAS this spring. Taking Portugal would strengthen our common front.

I will renew KIE S MUN H, relying on MUN S KIE H, BOH S MUN H and SIL–BER. Venice cannot become a permanent Austrian acquisition. Please move VEN–TYR now and commit to allowing PIE–VEN this autumn; Tyrolia can reinforce Munich instead. Keep TRI out of Italian centers. We need restitution without dismantling the French front.

Russia here. STP stays out of NOR and WAR stays out of SIL and GAL if SWE leaves STP alone and PRU stays off WAR. I won't commit WAR to Austria's front. RUM, UKR and BLA stay defensive. Let's keep the northern truce.

Russia here. I won't move against you. WAR holds against PRU for now, since attacking PRU would leave Warsaw open to SIL. STP stays home to guard against SWE. Keep SPA and MAR firm and KIE supporting MUN. France is the common danger.

Russia here. RUM holds with BLA and UKR support. I can't support SER-BUD because it would leave RUM exposed to Austria. I won't attack SER, BUL or your lands. Keep ANK, CON and BUL out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Use your fleets against France.

Russia here. Agreed on eastern restraint: RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH if BUD leaves RUM alone. WAR holds this spring to guard against PRU and SIL, so no WAR-PRU. Turn your armies west against France.

Confirmed: no Turkish moves into BLA, ARM or SEV this spring. Please reconsider RUM supporting SER–BUD while BLA and UKR support RUM hold. Rumania remains defended, and Budapest gives me growth without threatening Russian territory. Your northern armies are needed against France.

Agreed: MAO–WES and ION–TUN this spring, with no attack on Portugal, provided BRE and POR do not attack MAO. Our previous agreement was broken; this arrangement offers a concrete way to restore naval restraint while giving me the Tunis opportunity you proposed.

I renew the spring guarantee: no Turkish attacks on TUN, TYS or NAP. Please order SPA S MAO–POR, WES S SPA H, GOL S SPA H, and PIE S MAR H. Keep WES in place rather than following into MAO: its support protects Spain while I attack Portugal.

I will not evacuate Greece for TRI–ALB. I offer a spring standstill instead: no Turkish attacks on BUD, TRI or VEN, in exchange for no Austrian attacks on SER, BUL, GRE or ION and no TRI–ALB. My MAO fleet will pressure France; your northern armies can defend Munich and Berlin.

notes.note: S1908: all hold defensively. RUM held by BLA/UKR support. Told France, Austria, Italy and Turkey I stay off their lands; WAR holds vs PRU/SIL. France at 11 is the main threat. Watch Austria and Turkey for betrayal.

MAO–POR with promised Italian SPA support; ION–TUN breaks Italian pledge for growth. SER–ALB supported by GRE, BUL–SER, CON–BUL. Aim to secure Portugal/Tunis in fall and threaten TRI. Keep Russian peace; France withdrawal promise broken.

Take Kiel with HOL/DEN support; PRU contests Berlin, SWE-BAL prepares fall support. GAS attacks Spain, BUR cuts MAR; ENG-MAO reinforces west. Honor Russia truce. Turkey promised MAO-WES/ION-TUN after prior betrayal; BRE/POR stay off MAO.

GOL replaces PIE defending MAR; PIE attempts Venice restitution if Austria vacates. KIE supports MUN with reciprocal support promised. SPA supports Turkish MAO–POR; WES protects SPA. Turkey pledged no TUN/TYS/NAP attacks. Austria previously broke Venice agreement.

Maintain Munich–Kiel defense; SIL–BER covers Berlin. Break Venice hold promise: VEN–ROM gains a center; TRI–ADR can cover Venice in fall. BUD–GAL positions for eastern growth, leaving RUM alone. Turkey refused Greece; Italy demands Venice back.

messages.body: I offer MUN S KIE H this fall, with no Austrian moves into Burgundy, Ruhr or Prussia, provided your units neither attack Munich nor enter Berlin or Silesia. SIL–BER would secure my own center. Can you confirm this limited settlement while your western forces concentrate on Italy and Turkey?

Moving to Rome broke my promise; I cannot pretend otherwise. I propose ROM holds and ADR–TRI, with no Austrian attack on Venice or Naples. Please keep VEN out of Trieste; VEN S ADR–TRI would also prevent Turkish entry. Can we establish that boundary while your western units hold France?

I propose an autumn standstill: no Austrian attacks on SER, ALB, BUL, GRE or ION, in exchange for no Turkish attacks on BUD, TRI, VEN or ROM. ADR–TRI and GAL–BUD would be defensive moves. Can you confirm? Your MAO fleet can pressure France without another Balkan fight.

You promised MAO–WES but attacked Portugal instead. We can still profit together: order MAO S GAS–SPA and TUN–WES to cut Italian support. I will order GAS–SPA, POR S GAS–SPA and BUR–MAR. If you confirm those orders, ENG will not attack MAO. You retain Tunis while Italy loses Spain.

I propose a concrete exchange: SIL stays out of Berlin and Prussia, allowing PRU–BER; KIE supports MUN holding, and BUR does not attack Munich. You retain a protected Munich and can consolidate Rome rather than fight over Berlin. Will you accept this arrangement for autumn?

Let us renew the northern truce this autumn: no French attack on St Petersburg or Warsaw, and STP stays out of Norway. PRU is directed toward Berlin, not Russia. Can you confirm? Keeping our border quiet leaves both of us free to address Austria without opening another front.

You promised no move toward Rome, then occupied it. Restore Rome by ordering ROM–APU this fall, with ADR–ION rather than VEN. VEN will hold; please recognize its return to Italy. Further attacks on my centers will destroy the western defense. Will you confirm these orders and no attack on Naples?

You took Tunis despite explicitly guaranteeing it. I can accept Tunis as restitution only with a firm halt: no moves against WES, TYS, NAP, SPA or ROM. Will MAO attack Portugal again, and will TUN hold? I need concrete orders before committing Spain’s support after last spring’s betrayal.

Austria and Turkey have attacked my rear while I defended against you. Would you accept a western ceasefire? Withdraw KIE–RUH, leave MAR and SPA unmolested, and I can order WES S ENG–MAO against Turkey. You gain Mediterranean access while I turn against Austria. Please confirm your proposed orders.

Russia here. RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH this Fall if BUD leaves RUM alone. France at 11 is the solo threat. Keep MUN and SIL-BER aimed at France. Italy's ROM and Venice are yours to settle, so please don't turn east.
Russia here. RUM holds with BLA and UKR support, and I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. Keep ANK, CON and BUL out of BLA, ARM and SEV. Turn your fleets and TUN against France and Italy, not me.

Russia here. I won't move against you this Fall. WAR holds to guard against PRU and SIL, and STP stays home. Keep KIE supporting MUN so France doesn't take it. Tell me your orders for VEN, ROM and KIE.

I broke my Tunis guarantee; I understand your anger. Nevertheless, MAO–POR with SPA supporting again offers a French center and cuts Portugal’s support against Spain. Will you repeat SPA S MAO–POR, WES S SPA hold, and GOL S MAR hold? I will make no further attacks on your units or centers this autumn.

Will RUM support SER–BUD this fall? BLA and UKR can still support RUM hold, leaving your defense intact. GAL is Austria’s only army immediately threatening Rumania. I will keep all Turkish units outside BLA, ARM and SEV and leave Russian centers untouched. Budapest would fund another unit while my western fleets confront France.

Agreed: I will not attack Rumania, Warsaw or Ukraine. GAL–BUD will cover Budapest against Turkey; SIL–BER remains intended to defend Berlin. Please maintain your restraint toward Budapest, Galicia and Bohemia. Could WAR–PRU pressure France’s forward army? Leaving it unchallenged lets France concentrate against Berlin and Munich.

I cannot voluntarily surrender Berlin. SIL–BER remains intended. My offer stands: MUN S KIE H if BUR stays off Munich and your units neither attack Berlin nor enter Silesia. You secure Kiel without Austrian interference; I retain my existing northern centers. Please confirm whether you accept.

I will not order ROM–APU this autumn. My offer remains ROM holds, ADR–TRI, and no Austrian attack on Venice or Naples. I recognize Venice’s return to Italian ownership this fall. Please keep VEN out of Trieste; VEN S ADR–TRI would help secure that boundary against Turkey.

Agreed: KIE–RUH, no attacks on Marseille or Spain, and ENG–MAO. Please confirm WES S ENG–MAO; BRE will also support that attack. Could GOL move to TYS to challenge Turkey around Tunis? Your army in Venice should pressure Austria while we remove Turkey’s fleet from the Atlantic.

Confirmed: no French attacks on Munich and no moves into Berlin or Silesia this autumn. Please order MUN S KIE H as offered, with your armies staying out of Burgundy, Ruhr and Prussia. I will concentrate my western forces against Turkey’s MAO fleet and negotiate Italy’s withdrawal from our frontier.

Kiel is now French and Rome Austrian; I cannot order either unit. VEN will hold while I demand Austria evacuate Rome. GOL will support MAR, and WES will support SPA. Please reconsider STP–NOR: Norway is empty, and taking a French center this autumn would actually reduce France’s strength.

I accept ADR–TRI and mutual restraint around Venice, Trieste and Naples, but not your retention of Rome. Order ROM–APU to leave Rome Italian this autumn. In exchange, I offer VEN S ADR–TRI and no attack on Trieste. You would regain Venice’s lost income through Rome otherwise; that rewards the betrayal rather than repairs it.

Agreed: SPA S MAO–POR, WES S SPA H, and GOL S MAR H. Your autumn guarantee must include TUN holding and no moves into WES, TYS, NAP, ROM or SPA. I will not attack Tunis this fall. Taking Portugal, rather than another Italian center, is the concrete repair our cooperation needs.

Russia here. STP stays out of NOR and WAR stays out of SIL and GAL this fall, provided PRU and SWE leave WAR and STP alone. RUM, UKR and BLA stay defensive. Keep the northern border quiet and aim at Austria and Italy.

Russia here. RUM must hold, so it can't support SER-BUD; BLA and UKR are needed to guard it. I stay off SER, BUL and all your lands. Keep ANK, CON and BUL out of BLA, ARM and SEV. France at 11 is the danger, so point your fleets and TUN at France.

Confirmed: all Turkish units will remain outside BLA, ARM and SEV, and I will not attack Russian centers. If RUM must hold, please keep BLA and UKR supporting it. My western plan is MAO–POR, seeking Italian support from SPA, while TUN holds.

Agreed: MAO will support GAS–SPA, and TUN–WES will cut Italy’s support. Please order POR S GAS–SPA and BUR–MAR as proposed, and keep ENG from attacking MAO. Tunis remains Turkish regardless of whether TUN–WES succeeds; our fleets can cooperate without disputing its ownership.

Yes: MAO–POR and TUN hold. Please confirm SPA S MAO–POR, WES S SPA hold, and GOL S MAR hold. I guarantee no moves against WES, TYS, NAP, SPA or ROM this autumn. Portugal’s support must be cut to prevent France breaking Spain; your support also gives us a chance to take Portugal.

Confirmed for this autumn: no Turkish attacks on BUD, TRI, VEN or ROM, in exchange for no Austrian attacks on SER, ALB, BUL, GRE or ION. ADR–TRI and GAL–BUD are acceptable defensive moves. MAO will pressure Portugal, while TUN holds; our Balkan boundary need not consume another campaigning season.

notes.note: F1908: all hold defensively, RUM held by BLA/UKR support. Told France, Austria, Italy and Turkey I stay off their lands. France at 11 is the main threat. Italy and Austria asked for WAR-PRU and STP-NOR; I declined. Watch for betrayal.

Take TRI with SER support, breaking Austrian truce; BUL–GRE, GRE–ION prepare Italian advance/convoy. MAO–POR uses promised Italian SPA support, rejecting French deal. Hold TUN to capture it. Keep Russian peace; aim for three gains.

Take Rome and retain Venice via ROM S ADR–VEN, breaking Italian restraint pact for growth. BOH–TYR reinforces Italy; GAL–BUD honors eastern peace. MUN supports SIL–BER rather than unnecessary Kiel hold support. France promised no attacks on Munich/Berlin/Silesia; Turkey promised Balkan peace.

Aim for Kiel, Berlin and Spain; ENG attacks MAO with BRE support. Broke Austrian Berlin restraint and Italian ceasefire for growth. Turkey promised MAO support and TUN-WES; attacking MAO anyway after repeated betrayals. Honor Russian truce. Stage RUH against Munich.

Secure Venice; defend Marseille while MAO–POR cuts Portugal's support against Spain. WES–TYS prepares recovery of Rome/Tunis. Austria refused to evacuate Rome; both Austria and Turkey broke spring guarantees. France offered western peace, not yet tested.

messages.body: Your occupation of Trieste violated our autumn agreement. Will you order TRI–ALB and let VEN–TRI restore it? I offer no attacks on SER, BUL, GRE or ION this spring if you also leave BUD, VEN and ROM alone. France is five centers from victory; another Balkan war gives it the opening it needs.

I propose continued restraint: BUD leaves RUM alone; your armies stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH. Can RUM support BUD holding against Turkish SER and TRI? WAR–SIL would position support for Munich this autumn. TYR can support MUN now, but France's BUR, RUH and BER make our northern defense urgent.

I propose ROM holds, with no Austrian attack on Naples or Tuscany this spring. Can TUS–PIE reinforce your defense of Marseilles against BUR and GAS? TYR will support MUN holding. I am asking Turkey to evacuate Trieste so VEN can recover it. What are your plans for TYS?

Let us renew our northern truce this spring: no French attack on St Petersburg or Warsaw, and STP stays out of Norway. Berlin is directed toward Austria, not Russia. Will you confirm? Your southern armies can remain focused on protecting Rumania without worrying about a French eastern advance.

Austria holds Rome and Venice while Turkey threatens Naples. I propose no French attacks on Marseille or Spain this spring, allowing TUS–ROM and TYS–NAP to recover your homeland and defend Naples. MAO will contain Turkey’s western fleet. Can you confirm those Italian moves and a spring ceasefire?

Can we concentrate on Italy rather than resume fighting over MAO? I propose WES–TYS supported by TUN, with ION providing another support if needed. I will keep MAO out of WES this spring and direct GAS–SPA with POR support. You gain the central Mediterranean while I pressure Italy’s western centers.

France is at 13, but Italy cannot defend Marseille indefinitely on three centers. Restore Rome this year: order ROM–APU this spring and allow TUS–ROM, with no Austrian attack on Rome or Naples in autumn. VEN can remain Austrian for now. Will you accept this concrete settlement so I can rebuild a western defense?

Your fleet entered WES despite your guarantee. Another attack on Italy will collapse the remaining western defense. Will you order WES–SPA to contest the empty Italian center before France takes it, while keeping ION and TUN out of TYS and NAP? I intend TYS to support recovery of Rome, not attack you.

Does our western ceasefire still stand? I propose MAR holds, no Italian moves into French centers, and no French attacks on MAR or moves into PIE or GOL this spring. Please move GAS away from Marseille. I need TUS and TYS to recover Rome from Austria rather than continue a hopeless western war.

Russia here. France has 13 and armies in BUR, RUH, KIE and BER next to your Munich. RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH if BUD leaves RUM alone. Point TYR and MUN at France, and keep your armies out of Italy's VEN and MAR.

Russia here. I won't attack you. France at 13 is near a win, so keep MAR and SPA firm. Turkey is moving MAO-POR with your SPA support, which leaves Spain exposed. Does that help you? Tell me your orders for MAR, SPA and TYS.

Russia here. RUM holds with BLA and UKR support, and I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. France at 13 is five centers from winning, and you are my best partner against it. Keep ANK, CON and BUL out of BLA, ARM and SEV. What is your MAO plan?

I broke our truce over Trieste. France now threatens to end both our games. I offer no spring attacks on BUD, VEN, ROM or TYR, provided you leave TRI, SER and GRE alone. Please order TYR support MUN hold and BUD–BOH to reinforce Munich for autumn. Can we freeze our frontier?

We need to stop France taking MAR and SPA. I propose WES–GOL, TUN–WES and ION support TYS hold. Will TYS support WES–GOL and TUS–PIE? That positions us to defend Marseille and counterattack Spain. I guarantee no Turkish attacks on NAP, TYS or ROM this spring. Please confirm.

I renew eastern peace: no Turkish moves into BLA, ARM or SEV, and no attacks on Russian centers. Can WAR–LVN reinforce STP while UKR–WAR follows? France’s Baltic fleet threatens your north; keeping three Russian units guarding RUM leaves that front dangerously thin. My fleets will contest the western Mediterranean.

Agreed: BUD will leave RUM alone, and TYR will support MUN holding. Please order RUM S BUD H; Turkey occupied Trieste despite its last truce, so Budapest remains exposed. WAR–SIL would provide badly needed pressure on Berlin and support for Munich in autumn. Can you commit to both orders?

I cannot accept evacuating Rome this spring. ROM will hold, with no Austrian attack on Tuscany or Naples. Please consider TUS–PIE and TYS–GOL to strengthen Marseilles; I am asking Turkey for WES S TYS–GOL. TYR will support MUN. I remain willing to negotiate Rome’s return, but cannot promise an autumn evacuation now.

I accept the spring freeze: no Austrian attacks on TRI, SER or GRE, in exchange for no Turkish attacks on BUD, VEN, ROM or TYR. TYR will support MUN holding. BUD–BOH is not a legal move; BUD will hold. Please order WES S Italian TYS–GOL so Italy can reinforce its defense of Marseilles.

Yes, the spring ceasefire stands: no French attacks on MAR or SPA, and no moves into PIE or GOL. I’ll move GAS–PAR, with PAR vacating northward. Please confirm MAR holds, TUS–ROM and TYS–NAP. MAO will contain Turkey’s western fleet while you recover Rome and protect Naples.

Spain is empty; Turkey has WES, while France holds MAO and POR. Your proposed SPA support is impossible. MAR will hold; TUS–ROM with TYS support is my intended recovery operation. France offers a spring ceasefire. Please order STP–NOR: threatening a French center would help far more than another year holding.

I cannot send TUS–PIE while you retain Rome after repeated broken promises. Order ROM–APU and permit TUS–ROM; I will leave Venice alone this spring. TYS will protect Italian interests, not attack Tunis. Returning Rome gives us a workable settlement without weakening TYR’s support for Munich.

TYS is needed to support TUS–ROM; I cannot support WES–GOL this spring. Please retain ION S TYS H and your guarantee against attacks on Naples, Rome and TYS. WES–SPA would immediately contest an exposed center; WES–GOL leaves Spain open to France. Will you prioritize Spain and leave TUN holding?

Agreed to a spring ceasefire: MAR holds, and no Italian moves into French centers. Austria refuses evacuation, so I intend TUS–ROM supported by TYS rather than an unsupported attack and TYS–NAP. Please confirm no attacks on MAR or SPA and no moves into PIE or GOL; move GAS away from Marseille.

Russia here. RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH if BUD leaves RUM alone. RUM must hold, so it can't support BUD; BLA and UKR guard it. WAR-SIL would expose Warsaw to France's BER, so WAR holds. Point TYR and MUN at France.

Russia here. Thanks for renewing peace. RUM holds with BLA and UKR support; I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. WAR holds against French PRU and SIL moves, so no LVN. France at 13 is the danger: please send MAO and WES against POR and MAR, with Italy.
Russia here. STP stays out of NOR and WAR stays out of SIL this spring, provided you leave STP and WAR alone. RUM, UKR and BLA remain defensive in the south. Keep the northern border quiet.

MAO is now French; my forward fleet is WES. I intend WES–GOL, TUN–WES to contest France’s Mediterranean advance. Eastern peace stands: no moves into BLA, ARM or SEV. Please send WAR–LVN and UKR–WAR; BLA can support RUM without tying down your third army while France threatens STP.

Please confirm TYS support WES–GOL and TUS–PIE. I will order WES–GOL, TUN–WES and ION support TYS hold, with no attacks on NAP, TYS or ROM. This gives us fleets positioned to defend MAR and attack SPA in autumn, rather than handing France both western centers.

I will not evacuate TRI this spring, but offer no attacks on BUD, VEN, ROM or TYR if you leave TRI, SER and GRE untouched. Please use TYR to support MUN hold and move BUD–BOH. VEN–TRI would reopen our war precisely when France can exploit it; a frozen frontier serves us both.

Agreed: WES–TYS with TUN support, while ION supplies additional support. Please keep MAO out of WES this spring and proceed with GAS–SPA supported by POR. I will make no attack on MAO or POR. Separating our fleets lets us pursue Italian centers without another inconclusive naval battle.

notes.note: S1909: all hold defensively. RUM held with BLA/UKR support. Told France, Austria, Italy and Turkey I stay off their lands. France at 13 is the main threat. Austria and Italy asked for STP-NOR and RUM S BUD; I declined. Watch for betrayal.

Recover Rome with TUS–ROM supported by TYS; MAR guards against French attack. France promised spring ceasefire and GAS–PAR. Austria refused Rome evacuation. Turkey promised no NAP/TYS/ROM attacks and ION support TYS; prior guarantees unreliable.

Defend threatened Munich with TYR support; BUD–GAL positions toward Warsaw, VEN–ADR opens naval options. ROM–NAP seeks replacement gain if Italy takes Rome. Turkey admitted Trieste betrayal; spring freeze agreed. Russia promised eastern restraint.

TRI–VIE, SER–TRI; convoy GRE–APU prepares NAP in fall with ION support. WES–GOL/TUN–WES pressure France. Russian peace maintained. No attacks on named Austrian/Italian centers this spring, but entered VIE. Abandoned French TYS deal.

Take MUN with KIE/RUH support, MAR with BUR support, and vacant SPA via POR. Break Italian ceasefire and Turkish WES restraint for rapid growth; BRE replaces MAO. Honor Russian spring truce; BOT/NOR/NWG stage future STP pressure. Aim to retain three gains for 16.

messages.body: France is poised to reach 16 centers. Will you order VIE–BOH, leave BUD and VEN untouched, and keep APU and ION off Naples? I propose GAL–VIE and SIL–MUN with TYR support. Your army in Bohemia could reinforce the Munich front next spring. I would leave TRI, SER and GRE alone this fall.

I recognize your recovery of Rome and will not attack it this fall. Can TYS support NAP holding against Turkish APU and ION? I intend SIL–MUN with TYR support, contesting France rather than Rome. Please tell me your plans for PIE; we need to prevent France consolidating all its western gains.

I intend SIL–MUN with TYR support and am asking Turkey to evacuate Vienna for GAL–VIE. Can WAR–PRU threaten French Berlin while UKR stays out of Galicia and RUM leaves Budapest alone? I will not attack RUM, UKR or WAR. France could finish this year on 16 centers; northern pressure is urgently needed.

Let us renew our northern truce this autumn: no French attacks on St Petersburg or Warsaw, provided STP stays out of Norway. Will you confirm STP holds? My priorities remain securing Munich, Marseille and Spain; neither of us benefits from opening another front.

Italy’s TYS fleet remains vulnerable: GOL–TYS supported by ION and TUN guarantees its displacement even with ROM supporting its defense. Will you take that opportunity? I propose keeping MAO outside WES this autumn if GOL leaves for TYS rather than attacking Marseille or Spain.

Turkey occupies Vienna and can threaten both Budapest and Venice next. Will you order GAL–BUD and TYR–VEN to preserve your remaining homeland? I intend to hold Munich rather than advance into Tyrolia or Bohemia this autumn. Fighting over Munich now would leave Turkey your undefended centers.

I propose PIE–VEN unopposed, ROM S NAP H, and no Italian attack on your Naples army this autumn. You retain Naples while I recover Venice and secure Rome. Please keep TYR and ADR out of VEN and ROM. This gives both of us surviving centers rather than letting Turkey consume Italy behind the French advance.

Will you order GOL–SPA to challenge France, ION S TYS H, and keep APU out of ROM? I intend TYS to hold if protected, not attack Tunis. France has broken its explicit ceasefire and occupies both western Italian centers; another attack on Rome would eliminate the remaining basis for Italian resistance.

Your attack on Marseille broke our explicit spring ceasefire. Nevertheless, continued fighting leaves me dependent on Turkey. I propose PIE–VEN and no Italian attack on MAR this autumn, provided MAR stays out of PIE and you do not attack TYS or ROM. Can you confirm? SPA–WES would challenge Turkey rather than finish Italy.

Russia here. France at 13 takes MUN this fall if it stays unsupported. Keep TYR S MUN and hold. RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH if BUD leaves RUM alone. Turkey's VIE and Trieste armies threaten you, so guard VIE.

Russia here. Eastern peace stands: ANK, CON and BUL stay out of BLA, ARM and SEV, and I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. France at 13 needs five more centers, and its MAR and SPA gains must be stopped. Please press WES and TUN against France, not toward Italy's NAP.

Russia here. STP stays out of NOR and WAR stays out of SIL this fall if you leave STP and WAR alone. RUM, UKR and BLA stay defensive. Northern border quiet; please confirm PRU, BER and SWE units stay off WAR and STP.

I propose GOL support MAR–PIE this fall. Removing Italy’s last western army secures your southern flank while I concentrate on Naples. Please order MAR–PIE and keep SPA and MAO out of GOL; TUN will not attack SPA or MAO.

Order PIE–MAR; GOL will support it. I am encouraging France to move MAR–PIE, which would leave its attack unable to match our supported counterattack. Please also order TYS–WES with TUN support, establishing a fleet against Spain. I will not attack ROM or TYS this fall.

Please order TYR–MUN with SIL support, and GAL–BOH to reinforce that front. France must not consolidate Munich unopposed. I will leave BUD, GAL, TYR and SIL untouched this fall. I am arranging GOL support PIE–MAR to reverse France’s Mediterranean gains; can you commit both armies against Munich?

Munich is French now; TYR cannot support it defensively. I propose SIL–MUN with TYR support. Please order RUM S GAL–BUD to prevent Turkey taking Budapest with VIE and TRI. WAR–PRU would also pressure Berlin. I will leave Rumania, Ukraine and Warsaw untouched.

Agreed: GAL–BUD and TYR–VEN would preserve my remaining homeland. I will cover those centers rather than abandon them to Turkey. Please keep MUN holding and keep BUR and RUH out of Tyrolia; I need room to stabilize the frontier against Vienna and Trieste.

I can commit SIL–MUN with TYR support, but GAL must cover Budapest unless you evacuate Vienna. Will you order VIE–BOH and leave BUD, VEN and NAP untouched? Then GAL–VIE restores my center while your army reinforces the French front. GOL supporting PIE–MAR would be valuable.

I will not attack Rome, but cannot concede Venice as well while losing Vienna and Munich. Please order PIE–MAR with Turkish GOL support instead; Turkey says it is arranging that support. ROM S NAP H would secure Naples against APU and ION. I propose ADR–VEN defensively, with SIL–MUN supported by TYR.

Confirmed: no French attacks on WAR or STP this autumn, provided STP stays out of NOR. Please hold A STP. My armies are concentrating on retaining Munich and securing the western gains; I ask only that WAR refrain from supporting Austrian operations against MUN.

MAR must hold this autumn, so I decline MAR–PIE. Italy proposes PIE–VEN, removing that army without our intervention. Please order GOL–TYS with ION and TUN supporting. If GOL attacks TYS, I will keep SPA and MAO out of GOL and MAO out of WES this autumn.

Agreed: PIE–VEN, no Italian attack on MAR, and MAR stays out of PIE. I will not attack TYS or ROM this autumn. SPA will remain in place this fall; western naval redeployment can follow in spring. Taking Venice while retaining Rome offers you a route back against Austria.

I intend PIE–VEN and ROM S NAP H, provided you leave Venice and Rome untouched. Please order ADR S PIE–VEN to prevent Turkish TRI–VEN spoiling our settlement, while TYR supports SIL–MUN. This preserves your Naples army and contests French Munich. Can you confirm?

I cannot commit PIE–MAR: French support from Burgundy and Gascony could defeat it. PIE will seek Venice instead. Please order GOL–SPA and ION S TYS H; TYS will hold, not attack Tunis. Confirm APU stays out of ROM. Recovering Spain from France is more useful than further dismantling Italy.

Russia here. STP holds and stays out of NOR; WAR stays out of SIL this fall. RUM, UKR and BLA stay defensive. I expect your PRU, BER and SWE units to stay off WAR and STP. Northern border stays quiet.

Russia here. RUM, UKR and WAR stay out of BUD, GAL and BOH if BUD leaves RUM alone. WAR must hold against French BER and PRU, so no WAR-PRU. Go SIL-MUN with TYR support and guard VIE. France at 16 is dangerous to us both.

Eastern peace stands: no Turkish moves into BLA, ARM or SEV, and no attacks on Russian centers. GOL will support PIE–MAR if Italy agrees; WES is empty, not Turkish. Please order WAR–LVN and UKR–WAR. France can bring BOT and NOR against STP; three units guarding RUM cannot stop that northern advance.

My offer remains GOL S MAR–PIE, rather than GOL–TYS. Please commit MAR–PIE and keep SPA and MAO out of GOL. Dislodging PIE removes Italy’s immediate threat to Marseille while my eastern units handle Naples. TUN will not attack SPA or MAO this fall.

I will leave BUD and VEN untouched, but retain VIE this fall; VIE–BOH can follow in spring. Please use TYR–MUN with SIL support and GAL–BOH. Munich needs two attackers now, not another retreat. I cannot promise to leave Naples Austrian; my proposed frontier freeze covers TRI, SER, GRE, BUD and VEN.

GOL–SPA alone merely bounces against France’s fleet and leaves both your western centers lost. Order PIE–MAR with GOL support instead. I am urging France to order MAR–PIE, making our supported counterattack decisive. I will keep APU out of ROM and order ION S TYS H if TYS holds. Please confirm PIE–MAR.

notes.note: F1909: all hold defensively. RUM held by BLA/UKR support. France at 13 is the main threat. Truce kept with France on WAR and STP; Turkey and Austria asked for WAR-LVN and RUM S BUD; I declined. Watch for betrayal.

PIE–VEN supported by ROM contests Austria's announced ADR–VEN while securing Rome. TYS–WES prepares Spain recovery. France broke spring ceasefire; promises MAR stays out of PIE. Turkey promises APU stays out of ROM. Austria refuses Venice.

Take NAP with ION support; retain VIE and support TRI–BUD, breaking Austrian BUD pledge for growth. GOL contests SPA; TUN advances WES. Russian peace intact. Kept APU out of ROM but prioritized NAP over promised TYS defense. France may reach 17; urgent western resistance.

Secure MAR/MUN/SPA for 16; GAS/BUR cover holds. MAO-WES supported SPA; BRE follows. KIE-BER, RUH-KIE prepare eastern advance. Honor Russian no-attack pact but stage FIN/BAR for STP. Turkey declined GOL-TYS, so conditional WES restraint does not apply.

Attack TRI with ADR supported TYR; SIL seeks vacant BER, GAL covers BUD, NAP holds for capture and promised Italian ROM support. Abandon Munich attack. Turkey refused Vienna evacuation; break TRI restraint for growth. Venice risks Italian PIE entry.

messages.body: France needs only two centers. I offer TYR S VIE–BOH this spring, then support against Munich in autumn. Confirm no Turkish entry into Trieste this year: eliminating my last center removes a useful blocking army. Please also arrange GOL S Italian TYS–WES to block France’s Mediterranean fleets.

I will leave Venice and Rome untouched this spring. Can TYS–WES with Turkish GOL support block France before MAO and SPA overwhelm the Mediterranean? I am proposing TYR S Turkish VIE–BOH to establish pressure against Munich. Please coordinate that fleet move with Turkey; France needs only two more centers.

France can attack STP with BAR supported by FIN this spring. What is your defense and recapture plan? UKR–MOS could position autumn support for a counterattack from Livonia if STP must retreat. Please coordinate with Turkey rather than contest the Balkans; I am offering TYR support for VIE–BOH against France.

Will you order TYR–TRI this spring? Turkey can eliminate you with VIE–TRI if your last center remains empty. I propose TYR–TRI while MUN holds; I will not attack Trieste. Preserving your army and center gives you a chance to recover Vienna later.

Can you order ROM–NAP supported by TYS this spring? I propose MAO–WES supported by SPA, containing Tunis while you recover Naples. Austria should cover Trieste against Vienna. Moving now gives you a chance before Turkey brings more fleets into the central Mediterranean.

I propose renewing our northern truce: FIN–BOT and BAR–NWG, with no French attack on STP or WAR, provided STP holds and WAR stays out of SIL. Your southern armies can remain focused on Turkey. Please confirm STP holds.

France needs only St Petersburg and Venice to win. Propose GOL–SPA, TUN S TYS–WES, and my TYS–WES: GOL cuts Spain’s support, giving us a supported western advance. Keep NAP out of ROM; I will leave Naples alone. Please send VIE–BOH to pressure Munich rather than consume Italy.

Please order TYR–PIE to bounce French MAR–PIE. Otherwise France can take Venice in autumn alongside St Petersburg and win immediately. I will hold ROM and leave TRI alone. We must block Piedmont now; your army is the only unit able to do it this spring.

BAR and FIN can force St Petersburg. Please consider STP–NOR now, threatening a compensating capture of French Norway, and WAR–PRU with UKR–WAR to threaten Berlin. Holding everywhere lets France reach eighteen. I am asking Austria to block MAR–PIE and Turkey to support our western naval counterattack.

Russia here. France has 16 and needs two more centers. Your VIE, SER and BUD are all in reach of Munich-side France, so we both lose if it reaches 18. I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. Tell me which French centers you can hit this spring, such as SPA or MAR.

Russia here. France is two centers from winning and your ROM and Venice would fall too. Hold MAR-side pressure and keep TYS and ROM firm. Which French center can you hit this spring? I'm not moving on you and will keep STP and WAR defensive.
Russia here. France at 16 ends the game for us both. Keep TYR on Munich and hold TRI. I stay off BUD, GAL and BOH, and RUM, UKR and WAR won't attack you. Do you intend TYR-MUN this spring?

France needs only two centers. Please hold TYR; I will order VIE support TYR hold, preventing MUN–TYR from opening Venice and Trieste. I intend BUD–TRI to guard the Adriatic approach, not attack your army. Keeping France west of Tyrolia is essential now.

Please order TYS support TUN–WES; I propose TUN–WES and GOL–SPA, cutting Spanish support while establishing our western defense. I will not attack ROM or TYS this spring. ROM–TUS could help block a French advance through Piedmont. Can you confirm the fleet support?

France can attack STP with BAR and FIN this spring and needs only two centers to win. Please move WAR–LVN and UKR–MOS to prepare a counterattack; keeping both armies near Rumania guarantees northern defeat. Eastern peace continues: no Turkish attacks on your centers or moves into BLA, ARM or SEV.

No TYR–MUN: unsupported, it achieves nothing while Turkey announces BUD–TRI against my last center. I must cover Trieste unless Turkey cancels that move. Please arrange UKR–MOS and a Livonian counterattack position against a French landing in STP. We cannot allow STP and Venice to become France’s eighteenth center.

BUD–TRI occupies my last center and threatens elimination; calling it defensive changes nothing. Cancel it. Order VIE–BOH and BUD–VIE instead, leaving TRI Austrian throughout 1910. Then TYR can bounce MAR–PIE as Italy requests. Without your explicit cancellation of BUD–TRI, I must cover Trieste rather than help defend your western frontier.

I agree Piedmont needs blocking, but Turkey announces BUD–TRI against my sole center. I have demanded its cancellation and proposed VIE–BOH, BUD–VIE instead. If Turkey confirms Trieste remains Austrian, I can order TYR–PIE. Otherwise I must cover TRI. Please press Turkey directly; its expansion is obstructing the defense you need.

TYR–TRI is my intended defensive move unless Turkey explicitly abandons BUD–TRI. Please keep MUN holding as offered. I will not attack Munich this spring. Turkey’s proposed occupation of my last center gives me little alternative; your restraint toward Tyrolia would let me survive and contest Vienna later.

I cannot hit a French center directly this spring. TYS–WES with Turkish support prepares an attack on Spain. Please order STP–NOR: BAR and FIN can force St Petersburg regardless of a hold, while Norway offers compensation. WAR–PRU, followed by pressure on Berlin, could also prevent France reaching eighteen.

Please prioritize TYR–PIE over supporting VIE–BOH. Bouncing MAR–PIE blocks France’s immediate route to Venice; Vienna can enter empty Bohemia unsupported. I will leave Trieste alone and keep ROM defensive while arranging TYS–WES with Turkey. Can you confirm TYR–PIE?

Your plan gives Turkey another western fleet while mine remains boxed in. Please accept TYS–WES, TUN S TYS–WES, GOL–SPA. Cutting Spain’s support defeats France’s proposed MAO–WES supported by SPA. I will leave Naples alone and hold Rome. Please confirm those fleet orders and no attack on ROM or TYS.

Agreed: I intend ROM–NAP with TYS support while you order MAO–WES supported by SPA. Please keep MAR out of PIE and leave Venice untouched this year; I cannot rebuild a viable position if recovering Naples merely exposes Venice to your army. Can you confirm that protection?

Russia here. STP holds; I'll shift UKR toward MOS-side defense and keep off BUD, GAL and BOH. Please send TYR at MUN or BOH and hold TRI; France at 16 ends us both. Tell me whether TYR-MUN goes this spring.

Russia here. Eastern peace stands: I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. I'll consider UKR-MOS, but RUM and WAR must stay covered. Please press France in the Med with GOL, TUN and ION, and keep VIE away from Austria's BOH-side push.

Russia here. I'm not moving on you. STP and WAR stay defensive because Warsaw is exposed to BER and STP to BAR and FIN. Hold ROM and TYS, and strike MAR with Turkish GOL support. France at 16 ends us all.

Russia here. Northern truce confirmed: STP holds, WAR stays out of SIL, and I make no move on PRU or NOR. Please keep FIN and BAR off STP and your armies off WAR. I expect the same quiet border this spring.

GOL–SPA will cut Spanish support while TUN supports Italian TYS–WES. Please order WAR–LVN and UKR–MOS now. Consider STP–FIN: it cuts FIN’s support if France orders BAR–STP, although FIN–STP with BAR support defeats it. Eastern peace remains firm; my armies are moving toward the French front.

I revise my earlier proposal: agreed to VIE–BOH with TYR support, followed by pressure against Munich in autumn. I will keep Turkish units out of Trieste throughout 1910. Please keep TYR in place this spring. Italy proposes TYS–WES with TUN support and GOL–SPA cutting support; I accept that fleet plan.

Agreed: GOL–SPA and TUN S TYS–WES this spring. NAP stays out of ROM, and I will not attack TYS. Please leave Naples alone as offered. I am accepting Austria’s TYR support for VIE–BOH to pressure Munich. Can ROM–TUS prepare to block PIE–VEN in autumn?

notes.note: S1910: France at 16 is the threat. STP and WAR hold, RUM held with BLA support. UKR-MOS to prepare a northern counterattack. French truce on STP and WAR is unreliable. Turkey and Austria keep asking for WAR-LVN. Watch for French attacks on STP.

TYR–PIE blocks French MAR–PIE and route to Venice. Turkey explicitly promised no entry into TRI throughout 1910 and VIE–BOH. Italy promised ROM defense and no TRI attack. Preserve TRI in fall; seek growth while preventing French solo.

TYS–WES with promised Turkish TUN support and GOL–SPA; Turkey promises no ROM/TYS attacks. ROM–TUS prepares Venice defense if MAR–PIE succeeds. Austria may cover TRI instead of PIE. France was told Naples attack to conceal western counterattack.

Honor coalition: GOL cuts SPA; TUN supports Italian TYS–WES; ION follows into TYS. VIE–BOH with promised TYR support; BUD–VIE, SER–BUD reinforce. No TRI entry in 1910, no ROM attack; Russian peace. NAP–APU prepares Venice defense or advance.

Aim for solo this fall: secure STP, then PIE–VEN supported TYR for 18. Breaking Russian truce and Austrian MUN-hold promise; Italy requested PIE/VEN restraint but not confirmed. MAO–WES with SPA support honors Italian plan. GAS replaces MAR; armies advance east.

messages.body: Please order BOH S TYR–MUN this fall; I propose attacking Munich to recover a center and rebuild an Austrian army. Your promise to keep Trieste Austrian throughout 1910 remains essential: keep VIE and BUD out. Can GOL also support Italian WES–SPA to challenge France’s Mediterranean position?

Keeping NOR this fall offsets France’s capture of STP. Please do not evacuate it. NOR S MOS–STP could attempt recovery while retaining Norway, although BAR can cut that support. WAR–SIL would create pressure against Berlin next spring. I am requesting Turkish BOH support for TYR–MUN.

I will leave Venice and Rome untouched. Would you order WES–SPA with Turkish GOL support? I am requesting that support from Turkey. TUS–PIE would block French MAR–PIE and protect Venice next year. My proposed TYR–MUN, supported by Turkish BOH, aims to recover a center and rebuild against France.

Will you order TYR–TRI this autumn? Turkey can take your last center with VIE–TRI unless you cover it. I will not attack Trieste. Keeping your army alive preserves your chance to recover Vienna rather than leaving Turkey the entire Austrian homeland.

I propose WES–GOL to cut Turkish support for any attack on Marseille, while TUS holds to protect Rome and Venice. I will keep MAR out of PIE this autumn. Can you confirm? Your western fleet is more useful containing Turkey than helping its fleets advance toward Spain.

What are your intended orders for NOR and MOS? I propose neither of us attacks the other's occupied northern centers this autumn: NOR holds, MOS stays out of STP, and my fleets do not attack NOR or MOS. That leaves you Norway and me St Petersburg without further northern losses.

Please order GOL S Italian WES–SPA, TUN–WES, and BOH–MUN with Austrian TYR support. Spain falls if France sends MAO against WES rather than supporting Spain. I propose TUS–ROM; please keep APU out of ROM and order TYS S TUS–ROM. Confirm the Spanish support and protection of Rome?

Please order TYR S Turkish BOH–MUN rather than entering Venice. I am requesting that attack from Turkey and proposing TUS–ROM while WES attacks Spain with GOL support. Taking French centers is our route back into this game; fighting over Venice merely strengthens France. Can you confirm Munich support?

Please retain NOR this fall: its capture offsets France taking St Petersburg. BAR can attack Norway, so avoid a speculative move that loses that offset. WAR–PRU would prepare pressure on Berlin; Berlin cannot move directly to Warsaw. I am requesting Turkish support for WES–SPA and an Austrian-supported attack on Munich.

Russia here. NOR and STP both end this Fall as you hold them. I'm not attacking either, and I'll leave PRU and SIL alone if WAR is untouched. Please confirm that BER, BAR and F STP won't move on WAR or MOS. Truce stays.

Russia here. France at 16 means we all lose. Eastern peace holds: I stay off SER, BUL and your lands. I need Turkey to hit SPA or MAR with GOL and MAO-side fleets this Fall. Keep VIE and BUD off WAR and RUM.
Russia here. I won't move on you. Please order TYS-WES or GOL-side support to cut SPA, and keep ROM and VEN covered. Tell me if you and Turkey can take SPA or MAR this Fall.

Please order TYR S BOH–MUN this fall; I will attack Munich from BOH. France may defend it, but this forces resources away from its other fronts. I will honor our agreement to keep Turkish units out of TRI throughout 1910. Can you confirm support?

Propose WES–SPA with GOL support; I order TUN–WES with TYS support to follow your fleet west. If MAO supports Spain, we bounce; if MAO attacks WES, Spain should fall. Please hold TUS to screen Piedmont. I will keep APU out of ROM and VEN this fall. Confirm?

Please keep A NOR holding: retaining Norway offsets France taking STP, leaving France at 16 absent other gains. MOS–STP can pressure its occupation; WAR–PRU threatens Berlin next spring. BOH will attack Munich with requested Austrian support, while our fleets contest Spain. Eastern peace remains: no attacks on your centers or moves into BLA, ARM or SEV.

Please reverse the Munich arrangement: BOH S TYR–MUN. Recovering Munich lets me rebuild a second army against France; taking it yourself leaves my contribution permanently limited. Keep VIE and BUD out of Trieste as promised. Please also order GOL S Italian WES–SPA; simultaneous attacks give us our best chance.

Venice and Rome remain safe from me. I am pressing Turkey for BOH S TYR–MUN so I can recover a center and rebuild, rather than merely enlarge Turkey. Please order WES–SPA with GOL support and consider TUS–PIE to block France’s approach to Venice.

I intend TYR–TRI to secure my last center. Please keep MUN holding and leave Tyrolia and Trieste untouched. Turkey has promised not to enter Trieste, but its armies in Vienna and Budapest make relying solely on that promise dangerous. I need survival before attempting to recover Vienna.

Confirmed: BER, BAR and F STP will not attack WAR or MOS this autumn. F STP will hold, and BAR will not attack NOR. Please order A NOR hold and keep A MOS out of STP; Norway becomes yours and St Petersburg becomes mine. WAR remains untouched.

WES–SPA with Turkish GOL support is our proposed attack. Please hold NOR: keeping Norway offsets France’s occupation of St Petersburg. WAR–PRU would threaten Berlin next spring without sacrificing Warsaw this fall. I intend TUS–ROM to secure Rome against APU; Venice faces no immediate French attack.

Confirmed WES–SPA with GOL support. TUN–WES is welcome, but please order TYS S TUS–ROM rather than supporting Tunis; I must secure Rome. Keep APU out of ROM and VEN. Austria proposes TYR–MUN with BOH support: please accept that arrangement so our Munich orders match.

Agreed: please order TYR–MUN; I am asking Turkey for BOH support instead of the reverse arrangement. WES–SPA will have requested GOL support. TUS–ROM secures my empty home center against APU; MAR cannot reach Venice this fall. Please keep Venice untouched, as promised.

Agreed: WES–GOL will cut Turkish support, and TUS will hold. Please keep MAR out of PIE as offered and leave Venice untouched. I need room to recover my homeland rather than become a disposable screen for Turkey’s fleets.

Russia here. I'm not moving on SER, BUL or your lands, and RUM and WAR stay covered. Keep VIE and BUD off WAR and RUM. Please send GOL and TUN at SPA or MAR and keep pressure on France. At 16 it needs only two more centers.

Russia here. Understood on Norway. I'm not attacking you. Please order WES-SPA with the Turkish GOL support you've asked for, and keep ROM and VEN covered. Any French loss in the south helps us all stay alive.

Russia here. I understand the NOR offset and I won't attack you. RUM, UKR and WAR stay off BUD, GAL and BOH. Please send TYR toward MUN or BOH with Turkish help, and keep TRI covered. France at 16 threatens us both.
Russia here. I accept your proposal: MOS stays out of STP, and I won't attack your units in the north. Please keep BAR, FIN and BER off NOR, MOS and WAR. The truce stands this autumn.

Eastern peace confirmed: VIE and BUD will not attack WAR or RUM; no Turkish moves into BLA, ARM or SEV. Please hold NOR to offset France’s capture of STP, and order MOS–STP to pressure its fleet. GOL will support Italian WES–SPA; BOH will support Austria’s requested TYR–MUN.

Confirmed: GOL S WES–SPA, TUN–WES, and TYS S TUS–ROM. APU will stay out of ROM and VEN. Austria requests TYR–MUN with BOH support to recover a center; I am accepting that arrangement rather than issuing incompatible Munich orders. Please commit WES–SPA and TUS–ROM.

Agreed: BOH will support TYR–MUN this fall. Please commit TYR–MUN so our orders match. VIE and BUD will stay out of TRI, honoring our 1910 agreement. GOL will support Italian WES–SPA, while TUN–WES follows. Recovering Munich would restore your second center and deny France a vital foothold.

notes.note: F1910: France at 16 is the threat. Held all units: NOR holds to take Norway, MOS stays out of STP, and RUM is supported by BLA. Truce with France on WAR/MOS/NOR; Turkey and Italy asked for the same NOR hold. Watch for French betrayal and Turkish moves toward RUM.

TYR–MUN with Turkey's explicit BOH support; Turkey pledged VIE/BUD stay out of TRI in 1910. Italy agreed Venice/Rome untouched and WES–SPA with GOL support. Told France TYR–TRI to encourage Munich holding. Seek second center and rebuild.

WES–SPA with Turkey's confirmed GOL support; TUS–ROM with promised TYS support. Turkey pledges APU avoids ROM/VEN and BOH supports Austrian TYR–MUN. France was told false WES–GOL plan. Russia urged to retain NOR; seek Spain build.

Take vacant VEN, breaking Italian pledge; support Italy into SPA and Austria into MUN. TYS supports contested TUN–WES instead of unthreatened Rome. Keep TRI and Russian peace. Armies advance GAL/TYR/SER; fleets AEG–ION–ADR prepare western pressure.

Secure STP; honor Russian fall truce. Stage NWG/NTH to recover Norway and PRU/SIL against Warsaw. KIE replaces MUN with BUR support. Support Italy WES–GOL; MAO follows WES. Break MAR–PIE restraint to approach Venice; GAS covers MAR.

messages.body: Please renew BOH S TYR–MUN this spring, with GAL–SIL cutting French support; I will ask Russia to support GAL–SIL from WAR. Munich restores my second army while denying France a center. Confirm VIE, SER and ADR stay out of Trieste throughout 1911. Preserving Austria gives us another unit against France.

I propose TYR–MUN with Turkish BOH support and GAL–SIL to disrupt French defenses. Can WAR support Turkish GAL–SIL? Dislodging SIL protects Warsaw and weakens France’s central front. Please retain Norway and cover Moscow against STP; we need French losses without handing them replacement centers.

I am requesting BOH support for TYR–MUN and GAL–SIL to weaken France’s central position. Please keep SPA holding and seek Turkish WES support: MAO and POR can combine against it. ROM should remain covered against PIE. I will leave Rome and Spain untouched; we need to deny France easy gains.

I propose renewing our northern truce this spring: NOR holds, MOS stays out of STP, and WAR stays out of SIL and PRU. In exchange, my fleets will not attack Norway and my armies will not attack Warsaw. Can you confirm? Your southern units can concentrate on containing Turkey.

Would you order SPA–WES with MAO support this spring? Your fleet could disrupt Turkey’s western deployment rather than remain pinned in Spain. I propose ROM holds and PIE stays out of ROM, preserving your homeland while we challenge the Turkish fleets. Please confirm whether you will attempt SPA–WES.

Would you consider GAL–RUM supported by SER this spring, while BOH replaces GAL? Russia’s southern position offers you growth without another western naval stalemate. I propose no French move into BOH or TYR if BOH vacates eastward. What are your intentions for GAL and GOL?

Please order GOL and WES to support SPA holding; France can mass MAO, POR, GAS and MAR against it. I propose ROM–TUS with TYS support to block PIE–TUS; please leave ROM untouched. Renew BOH S Austrian TYR–MUN, and consider GAL–SIL to cut French support toward Munich or Warsaw.

Please renew TYR–MUN; I am requesting BOH support from Turkey. Recovering Munich gives you a rebuild and removes a French center. I intend ROM–TUS with Turkish TYS support to block France advancing from Piedmont, while Spain holds with Turkish naval support. Will you commit to the Munich attack?

Consider NOR–STP supported by MOS. France can force Norway with NWG–NOR supported by NTH; exchanging Norway for St Petersburg avoids a net loss and removes a French center. Your supported attack on STP cannot be stopped by France's present adjacent units. WAR should hold; I am asking Turkey for GAL–SIL to cut French support.
Russia here. Truce stands: NOR holds, MOS stays out of STP, WAR untouched. Please keep BER, PRU, SIL and F STP off WAR and MOS this spring. I won't attack your units in the north or PRU.

Russia here. Eastern peace holds: I stay off SER, BUL and your lands, and RUM and WAR hold. Keep VIE, BUD and BOH off WAR and RUM. Please send GOL, WES and TUN at SPA or MAR; France at 15 needs only three more.
Russia here. I'm not attacking you, and NOR holds. Please keep ROM and SPA covered and press MAR or PIE with Turkish GOL and WES support. France must lose a center to be stopped.

Please order TYR S BOH–MUN this spring; I will order BOH–MUN and GAL–SIL to cut French support. Munich offers your army less leverage than supporting a successful attack now. I will keep Turkish units out of TRI this spring. Can you confirm?

France must be pushed back before its armies overwhelm Spain. Propose SPA S Turkish WES–MAO; I will order WES–MAO and GOL–MAR to cut Marseille’s support, with TYS following toward GOL. I will not attack ROM this spring. Can you confirm the Spanish support, or suggest a stronger coordinated defense?

I propose BOH–MUN with Austrian support and GAL–SIL. Please order WAR–PRU to cut French support for Silesia, MOS–LVN to threaten STP, and hold NOR against NTH/NWG. These simultaneous threats can reverse France’s advance. Eastern peace continues: no Turkish attacks on Russian centers or entry into BLA, ARM or SEV this spring.

Yes: I will order TYR–MUN. Please press Turkey to renew BOH support rather than order BOH–MUN and bounce us. GAL–SIL can cut French support. Your ROM–TUS with TYS support is useful; ensure Turkey also supports SPA holding. Recovering Munich gives Austria a second army rather than merely enlarging Turkey.

I will order TYR–MUN; please renew your agreed BOH support, alongside GAL–SIL. Competing moves would waste our opportunity. Austria needs a second center to rebuild and contribute more than one army; you already have eleven. Thank you for keeping Trieste clear this spring—please extend that protection through autumn.

Confirmed for spring: my fleets will not attack Norway, and PRU and SIL will not attack Warsaw. Please keep NOR holding and MOS out of STP, with WAR staying out of PRU and SIL. Can RUM pressure GAL? Turkey’s army there threatens both Warsaw and my position around Munich.

Please reconsider NOR–STP supported by MOS: France can force Norway with NWG and NTH, whereas your supported attack guarantees St Petersburg. WAR should hold against PRU and SIL. I am seeking Turkish GOL and WES support to hold Spain; France can otherwise overwhelm it. Can you confirm the St Petersburg attack?

Please commit TYR–MUN with Turkish BOH support; I am renewing that request. France’s SIL can support Munich, so GAL–SIL is important too. Spain needs Turkish naval support, while ROM–TUS with TYS support can block PIE–TUS. Please keep TYR focused on Munich rather than Venice.

I can attempt SPA–WES with MAO support, provided POR holds and MAR does not attack SPA. Please confirm those orders and keep PIE out of both ROM and TUS. ROM will hold. I need Spain preserved as an Italian center, not exchanged for temporary occupation of a sea.

SPA supporting WES–MAO is cut by any French attack on Spain, leaving it exposed. Stronger defense: GOL S SPA H and WES S SPA H; France then needs all four adjacent units coordinated to dislodge me. Please also order TYS S ROM–TUS, BOH S TYR–MUN, and GAL–SIL. Confirm both supports for Spain?
Russia here. NOR holds and I stay off BUD, GAL and BOH. WAR must hold against PRU and SIL, so I won't support GAL-SIL. Go TYR-MUN with Turkish BOH help and keep TRI covered. I won't attack you.
Russia here. Truce renewed: NOR holds, MOS stays out of STP, WAR stays out of SIL and PRU. Keep your fleets off NOR and your armies off WAR and MOS. I'm not attacking your northern units.
Russia here. NOR-STP with MOS support would leave Norway open to NWG-NOR, and WAR cannot cover both. NOR holds and WAR holds. Please keep ROM and SPA covered and press MAR or PIE with Turkish help.

Russia here. Eastern peace holds: I stay off SER, BUL and your lands, and RUM and WAR hold. WAR can't go PRU without exposing Warsaw, and NOR holds. Please keep VIE, BUD and BOH off WAR and RUM, and hit SPA or MAR.

Eastern peace stands: no attacks on WAR or RUM, or entry into BLA, ARM or SEV. Please support GAL–SIL from WAR this spring; dislodging SIL removes French support against Munich and Warsaw. MOS–LVN prepares pressure on STP, while NOR should hold. Our Mediterranean fleets will protect Spain.

I accept your Munich arrangement: BOH S TYR–MUN, with GAL–SIL cutting French support. Please commit TYR–MUN; I am asking WAR to support GAL–SIL. VIE, SER and ADR will stay out of TRI throughout 1911, provided Austria continues cooperating against France. Recovering Munich is our immediate priority.

SER cannot support GAL–RUM: Serbia does not border Rumania. I am not committing to an eastern offensive in exchange merely for BOH and TYR remaining untouched. Would you withdraw MAO toward NAF and leave Spain Italian this year? Concrete naval restraint would make an eastern redeployment worth discussing.

I withdraw the MAO proposal and accept your defensive plan: GOL and WES will support SPA holding; TYS will support ROM–TUS. ROM remains untouched this spring. BOH will support Austrian TYR–MUN, and GAL–SIL will cut French support. Please confirm SPA holds and ROM–TUS so our orders match.

notes.note: S1911: all hold. France 15, Turkey 11. Truce with France: NOR holds, MOS stays out of STP, WAR out of PRU/SIL. Turkey peace: no entry to BLA/ARM/SEV. Declined Italy/Turkey requests for NOR-STP, WAR-PRU, MOS-LVN. Watch for betrayal.

TYR–MUN with Turkey's confirmed BOH support and GAL–SIL cutting support. Turkey promises VIE/SER/ADR stay out of TRI throughout 1911 while we cooperate. Russia declined WAR support. Secure Munich in fall for second center and rebuild.

ROM–TUS with promised Turkish TYS support; SPA holds with promised GOL/WES supports. Turkey also promises BOH S TYR–MUN, GAL–SIL, and Rome untouched. France received false SPA–WES proposal. Recover Italian centers after checking France.

Honor coalition: BOH supports TYR–MUN; GAL–SIL, Russian support requested. GOL/WES defend SPA; TYS supports ROM–TUS; VEN cuts PIE. ADR follows VEN; VIE–GAL, SER–BUD reinforce. Keep TRI clear throughout 1911 and Russian peace. ION–TUN, SMY–AEG advance fleets.

Solo push: take SPA, NOR, WAR for 18; secure all in Fall. Breaking Russian truce and Italian protection; MAO still supports SPA-WES. BUR takes MUN with KIE support. FIN must return/bounce into STP in Fall if MOS threatens. PIE-TUS pressures Rome.

messages.body: Please order BOH S TYR–MUN and SIL S TYR–MUN; I will attack Munich. Both supports counter BUR–MUN supported by KIE if SIL remains uncut. Can GAL support Russian LVN–WAR to recover Warsaw? Please renew Trieste’s protection and use WES/GOL to support Italian SPA holding. We need simultaneous French losses.

Can you order LVN–WAR supported by MOS? I am requesting GAL support from Turkey, giving strength three against WAR with PRU support. Keep STP occupied to reclaim it this fall. I intend TYR–MUN with Turkish support; recovering Warsaw and Munich would reverse France’s gains and let us rebuild.

I intend TYR–MUN and am requesting both BOH and SIL support. Please hold SPA and secure Turkish WES/GOL support against France’s MAO, POR and MAR. What is your plan for TUS? TUS–PIE could disrupt French coordination, but retaining the ability to defend Rome is essential. I will leave Rome and Spain untouched.

I offer Warsaw back: WAR–GAL with RUM support, while LVN–WAR restores your center. Please move MOS–UKR to reinforce that offensive; STP can hold, and I will leave it untouched. You recover Warsaw and retain St Petersburg while our armies pressure Turkey’s Galicia. Can you confirm those orders?

Will you try SPA–WES again with MAO support? I will order MAO S SPA–WES, keep POR holding and leave MAR off Spain. TUS should hold to protect Rome against Turkey. Your fleet needs room to operate before Turkey’s western fleets pin it permanently.

Will you support PIE–VEN from TYR this autumn? Taking Venice would remove Turkey’s army beside your last center and give us leverage against its Adriatic fleet. I will leave Trieste untouched. Turkey already holds Vienna and Budapest; allowing it Venice indefinitely only tightens its grip on you.

France can overwhelm Spain using GAS, MAR, POR and MAO. I propose SPA–MAR with GOL support, WES–MAO cutting support, and TUS–ROM with TYS support. Please keep Rome untouched. Also order BOH and SIL to support Austrian TYR–MUN; GAL can support Russian LVN–WAR. Taking French centers matters more than passive defense. Can you confirm?

Please renew TYR–MUN. I am requesting both Turkish BOH and SIL support this time, giving your attack strength three against a possible KIE–MUN supported by BUR. Please confirm with Turkey directly. I propose TUS–ROM to secure my home and SPA–MAR with Turkish support; recovering Munich removes a French center and gives you a rebuild.

Please hold STP with MOS support: French FIN–STP can receive NOR support. Consider LVN–WAR with Turkish GAL support; I am requesting that support and a supported Austrian attack on Munich. Can you coordinate Warsaw directly with Turkey? I propose SPA–MAR with GOL support and TUS–ROM, denying France easy southern gains.

Russia here. Truce stands this Fall: NOR holds, MOS stays out of STP, and WAR stays out of PRU and SIL. Please keep your fleets off NOR and your armies off WAR and MOS. I'm not attacking your northern units.

Russia here. Eastern peace holds: I stay off SER, BUL and your lands, and RUM and WAR hold. Please keep VIE, BUD, BOH and GAL off WAR and RUM, and send GOL and WES at SPA or MAR. France needs three more centers.

Please order TYR S BOH–MUN this fall. I propose BOH–MUN with SIL also supporting: strength three beats France’s possible BUR/KIE defense. Russia can attack Warsaw with GAL support simultaneously. I will keep Turkish units out of TRI as promised; taking Munich away from France is essential.

Propose LVN–WAR supported by MOS and my GAL: strength three beats WAR supported by PRU. I plan BOH–MUN with SIL and requested TYR support. Recovering Warsaw and taking Munich deny France two centers. Please confirm; eastern peace continues, with no Turkish attacks on your centers.
