Please hold SPA; GOL and WES will again support its defense. Hold TUS to block PIE, while TYS can support TUS holding. I will leave ROM untouched this fall. We are coordinating attacks on Munich and Warsaw to offset France’s northern gains; keeping Spain defended remains essential.

Please retain our agreed arrangement: TYR–MUN, with BOH and SIL supporting. That gives the same strength three while restoring my second army; another Turkish center leaves Austria unable to contribute meaningfully. Italy endorses this arrangement. Please confirm both supports, GAL support for Russia’s Warsaw attack, and continued protection of Trieste.

Confirmed: TYR–MUN. I am pressing Turkey for both BOH and SIL support rather than its proposed BOH attack. TUS–ROM sensibly secures your home. Ensure GOL supports SPA–MAR and WES covers Spain if you vacate it; otherwise France could exchange Marseille for Spain while threatening further gains.

Agreed: TYR will support PIE–VEN this autumn. Please keep your promise to leave Trieste untouched, and do not move into Tyrolia behind me. Removing Turkey’s Venetian army would relieve immediate pressure on my last center; afterward I want a concrete arrangement allowing Austria to recover Vienna.

My offer remains: A WAR–GAL with A RUM supporting, A LVN–WAR to recover your center, and A MOS–UKR to reinforce against Turkey. A STP can hold; I will leave it untouched. Please confirm these specific orders rather than the old northern arrangement—the units have changed positions, and we need coordination against GAL.

Please proceed TYR–MUN; I am pressing Turkey for both BOH and SIL support. TUS–ROM secures my home center rather than risking PIE while Rome lies empty. I have requested SPA–MAR with GOL support and WES–MAO to disrupt France’s western concentration. Your Munich capture is essential to reduce France’s total.

Please confirm the counterattack: GOL S SPA–MAR, WES–MAO, TYS S TUS–ROM. Holding Spain allows GAS, MAR, POR and MAO to concentrate against it; attacking Marseille and MAO disrupts that coordination. Please also give Austrian TYR–MUN both BOH and SIL support. Rome remains Italian; I will leave Naples untouched.

Agreed: SPA–WES with your MAO support, while POR holds and MAR stays off Spain. Please keep PIE out of TUS and leave Rome untouched. TUS will hold to screen my homeland. Actual passage into WES would give my fleet useful room rather than another season pinned in Spain.
Russia here. Agreed: LVN-WAR with MOS support, and STP holds to keep St Petersburg. Please have Turkey's GAL support that attack, and send TYR-MUN. RUM and my other units stay off your lands.

Russia here. I confirm LVN-WAR with MOS support, and A STP holds. Please order GAL S LVN-WAR, not GAL-SIL, so strength three beats WAR with PRU support. I keep eastern peace: RUM, BLA and SEV stay off your lands. Go BOH-MUN.
Russia here. STP holds, and LVN-WAR gets MOS support with Turkish GAL help, which should retake Warsaw. Please push SPA-MAR with GOL support and keep ROM covered. France must not reach 18.

Russia here. I can't commit to WAR-GAL, since my WAR unit is gone and RUM must cover Turkey. STP holds and I'm not attacking your northern fleets. Truce on NOR stands. Please keep PRU, SIL and BER off Livonia and Moscow.

Warsaw is French-occupied; please order LVN–WAR with MOS support. GAL will also support LVN–WAR, giving strength three against WAR plus PRU support. Hold STP to reclaim it this autumn. Eastern peace remains: no Turkish attacks on Russian centers. BOH and SIL will support Austria into Munich.

Agreed: I withdraw my competing Munich proposal. BOH and SIL will support TYR–MUN; please commit that attack. GAL will support Russian LVN–WAR. Turkish units will stay out of TRI throughout this autumn. Italy proposes SPA–MAR with GOL support and WES–MAO; I accept that offensive to threaten French centers.

Confirmed: GOL S SPA–MAR, WES–MAO, and TYS S TUS–ROM. Rome remains untouched by Turkish units. Please commit SPA–MAR and TUS–ROM. BOH and SIL will support Austrian TYR–MUN; GAL supports Russian LVN–WAR. These simultaneous attacks should deny France gains while opening our western advance.

notes.note: F1911: LVN-WAR with MOS support, STP holds, RUM held by BLA. France at 15 is the threat. Turkey and Austria asked for LVN-WAR and promised GAL support. France offered WAR-GAL, which I declined. Watch for betrayal.

TYR–MUN with Turkey's confirmed BOH and SIL supports; GAL supports Russian LVN–WAR. Turkey promises TRI untouched this fall. Broke promise to France to support PIE–VEN: Austrian growth and denying French solo take priority.

SPA–MAR with promised Turkish GOL support; WES–MAO cuts support. TUS–ROM with TYS support secures home. Turkey confirmed BOH/SIL support TYR–MUN and GAL support LVN–WAR. France received decoy SPA–WES agreement. Seek Italian growth after blocking France.

Take TRI with BUD, breaking Austrian protection pledge, while BOH/SIL support TYR–MUN. Honor Russian Warsaw support and Italian MAR/ROM plan. VEN–PIE disrupts France; ADR replaces VEN. AEG–ION and TUN–WES advance fleets. Seek western gains next year.

Solo attempt: retain NOR/WAR, retake STP with FIN+NOR, seize SPA with MAR supported MAO/POR. PIE-VEN with promised Austrian TYR support. KIE-MUN supported BUR; GAS covers MAR. Breaking Italian Spain and Russian STP/WAR promises for 18.

messages.body: Thank you for supporting Munich. Can SIL support MUN–BER while BOH covers Munich this spring? I need your covering army to vacate Munich in autumn, not annex it. Can we coordinate a defense against BUR/KIE that preserves Austrian ownership? Alternatively, propose a concrete route to restoring an Austrian home center.

Can WAR–PRU with LVN support dislodge France’s army this spring? I am discussing MUN–BER with Turkish SIL support. Your attack would disrupt French defenses and position us against Berlin and St Petersburg. Please coordinate Moscow’s defense against UKR; losing Moscow would cancel our western gains.

What are your spring plans for Spain and Rome? Please secure Turkish naval support before moving SPA–MAR: France has MAO, POR and MAR available against Spain. I am discussing an attack on Berlin with Turkish support, but Munich must remain protected. We need gains without giving France replacement centers.

Will you order MUN–TYR with support from my A PIE? Tyrolia gives your army a route toward recovering Vienna and pressure on Turkey’s Venice. I will keep BUR and KIE out of Munich this spring if you accept; please confirm before I commit PIE’s support.

I propose SPA–WES with MAO support again, while ROM holds. Turkey’s six Mediterranean fleets leave neither of us room unless we break its western screen. I will keep POR holding, MAR out of SPA, and PIE out of ROM this spring. Will you commit SPA–WES?

Can we coordinate RUM–GAL supported by my UKR, with WAR adding support? PRU will leave Warsaw untouched and STP will hold this spring. Dislodging Turkey’s GAL army relieves both Warsaw and Rumania; LVN can support MOS holding against any surprise. Please confirm whether RUM and WAR will cooperate.

Italy needs growth to remain a useful ally. Please return Naples: ROM–NAP with TYS support, while GOL and WES support SPA holding. Leave Rome untouched. France still threatens Spain and Munich; please give Austria BOH/SIL support holding MUN and coordinate GAL support against French UKR with Russia. Can you confirm Naples and Spain?

Please hold MUN and request both BOH and SIL support from Turkey; France can attack from KIE with BUR support. I am requesting those supports too. Spain must remain defended, but Italy also needs recovery: I have asked Turkey to return Naples. Can you reinforce that request while securing Munich?

Can you coordinate WAR–UKR with Turkish GAL support, replacing WAR with LVN–WAR? RUM can add support against UKR while MOS holds against a French attack. Please discuss exact orders with Turkey: removing France’s Ukrainian army protects your southern centers. I am seeking continued Turkish defense of Spain and restoration of Naples to Italy.

Russia here. Eastern peace holds: RUM stays off your lands and I won't enter BLA, ARM or SEV. France needs three centers, so please keep GAL and SIL pressing on Prussia and Munich, and send GOL and WES at SPA or MAR. What are your orders for GAL and BOH this spring?

Russia here. France at 15 needs three more centers. Please hold ROM and SPA, and push SPA-MAR with Turkish GOL and WES support. I'm staying off your lands. Which of your units will cover Spain, and will you attack MAR this spring?

Russia here. I'm not attacking you. Please send MUN toward BER or hold it with Turkish BOH and SIL support. Warsaw and Munich must stay out of French hands, since France at 18 ends the game for all of us. What are your MUN orders this spring?

I propose BOH S MUN H this spring, with TRI–TYR and VEN–PIE contesting France’s southern approach. Please hold Munich: preserving it denies France an immediate route toward eighteen. Can you confirm? I want our armies advancing west together rather than competing over Munich.

Please order LVN–PRU; SIL will support it, while GAL supports WAR holding. Keep MOS and RUM occupied to deny UKR easy access to your centers. Taking Prussia removes France’s support against Warsaw and opens Berlin for autumn. Can you confirm these moves and continued eastern peace?

I propose GOL and WES support SPA holding, while TYS–GOL attempts to follow if GOL is dislodged. Please hold ROM and SPA; I will not attack Rome this spring. France can overwhelm Spain only by concentrating all four adjacent units. Do you see a better coordinated defense or counterattack?

I will hold MUN with Turkish BOH support. Correction: MUN cannot move directly to BER; that requires an intermediate province. Please pursue WAR–PRU with LVN support while MOS holds against UKR. Dislodging France’s Prussian army would open our best route toward Berlin.

I will hold MUN and request BOH and SIL support. I support returning Naples to Italy and will press Turkey directly. Please keep SPA defended with Turkish naval support; France must not replace losses in Germany with Spanish gains. ROM should remain secure against any French advance through Tuscany.

Agreed: MUN–TYR with PIE support gives Austria a route back toward Vienna. Please order PIE S MUN–TYR and keep BUR and KIE out of Munich as offered. I need Munich retained through autumn while pursuing an Austrian home center; exchanging my only center for a position without supply would accomplish nothing.

Confirmed: MUN holds. Please order BOH S MUN H; SIL support too would insure against a French supported attack. TRI–TYR and VEN–PIE are welcome. For autumn, can you facilitate Austrian recovery of Vienna? Without a home center I cannot build. Please also return Naples to Italy so its survival supports our western defense.

SPA will hold with Turkish GOL and WES support; attacking MAR would expose Spain without assured compensation. ROM holds unless Turkey agrees to restore Naples. Please coordinate WAR–UKR with GAL and RUM support, and LVN–WAR behind it. Removing France’s Ukrainian army protects both Moscow and Rumania.

Agreed: SPA–WES with MAO support, while ROM holds. Please confirm POR holds, MAR stays out of SPA, and PIE stays out of TUS as well as ROM. Breaking Turkey’s western screen only helps Italy if Spain and Rome remain secure afterward.

SPA will hold with requested Turkish GOL and WES support. ROM holds unless Turkey agrees to return Naples through ROM–NAP with TYS support. Please secure MUN with BOH and SIL support before attempting Berlin; losing Munich would give France an easy replacement center. Can you reinforce my request for Naples?

SPA will hold with GOL and WES support. France cannot attack GOL this spring, so TYS–GOL cannot provide the proposed replacement. Instead, please support ROM–NAP with TYS and leave Rome untouched. Returning Naples gives Italy a rebuild without weakening Spain or Munich. Will you agree? Otherwise ROM holds.

Russia here. WAR-UKR would leave Warsaw open to PRU, so I won't do it. I'm holding WAR and MOS and staying off your lands. Please keep ROM and SPA covered and press MAR with Turkish GOL and WES support. France at 15 must not reach 18.

Russia here. I can't commit RUM to GAL, since RUM must cover Turkey. WAR and MOS hold this spring. Please keep PRU and UKR off Warsaw and Moscow, and keep your fleets off Livonia. I'm not attacking your northern units.

Russia here. WAR-PRU would expose Warsaw to French PRU and UKR, so WAR holds and LVN supports it. MOS holds against UKR. I'm not attacking you. Please push MUN-BER with Turkish SIL support; Berlin falling hurts France most.

Russia here. Eastern peace holds: RUM stays off your lands, and I won't enter BLA, ARM or SEV. LVN-PRU would leave Livonia empty to France, so I'll hold WAR with LVN support, and MOS and RUM hold. Please have GAL support WAR and press SIL on Prussia, and send GOL and WES at SPA or MAR.

GAL will support WAR holding; BOH will support Austrian MUN holding. Please confirm LVN–PRU with SIL support, while MOS and RUM hold against French UKR. This protects Warsaw and threatens Berlin for autumn. Eastern peace remains: no Turkish attacks on Russian centers or moves into BLA, ARM or SEV.

I cannot return Naples this spring while France threatens eighteen. GOL and WES will support SPA holding; please hold SPA and ROM. Rome remains untouched this spring. BOH supports Austrian Munich, SIL supports Russian LVN–PRU, and GAL supports Warsaw holding. VEN–PIE will contest France’s southern position.

Please hold MUN: BOH will support you, while SIL supports Russian LVN–PRU to remove France’s eastern leverage. TRI–TYR and VEN–PIE will strengthen our western front. I will not enter Munich this spring. We should preserve Austrian ownership rather than vacate it for an uncertain Berlin attack; can you confirm MUN holds?

notes.note: S1912: WAR holds with LVN support; MOS and RUM hold. France at 15 is the threat. Eastern peace with Turkey kept. Declined LVN-PRU, WAR-PRU, WAR-UKR and RUM-GAL asks. Watch French UKR/PRU and Turkish moves on RUM.

ROM–NAP seeks recovery despite Turkey refusing its return; assess Rome coverage in Fall. SPA holds with promised Turkish GOL/WES support. Turkey promises VEN–PIE and no Rome attack. France received decoy SPA–WES agreement.

MUN–BER: listed legal direct move corrects my mistaken diplomacy. Seek Berlin capture in fall and Turkish coverage preserving Munich. Told Turkey/Russia/Italy MUN holds and France MUN–TYR; broke both plans for growth. Need Austrian home center to rebuild.

Support coalition holds in MUN/WAR/SPA; leave Rome untouched. Russia declined LVN–PRU, so SIL attacks BER instead. TRI–TYR, VEN–PIE; fleet chain ADR–ION–TYS–TUS, TUN–NAF prepares western gains. CON–BUL reinforces. No Naples or Vienna return promised.

Target MUN, SPA and vacant SEV for 18 this fall. KIE supports BUR-MUN; PRU-SIL cuts Turkish support. POR supports MAO-SPA; fleets follow westward. Breaking Austrian Munich and Italian Spain promises and Russian restraint. Secure all three gains in autumn.

messages.body: I propose RUH–MUN. Please order BOH, TYR and SIL all to support RUH–MUN. France can defend Munich with BUR and KIE, so strength four matters; PRU could also cut SIL’s support. Recovering my last center preserves Austria’s army and denies France a gain. Please confirm all three supports.

Please order RUM–SEV with MOS supporting. France’s unsupported SEV cannot withstand strength two, and SEV–MOS would not cut support for an attack on Sevastopol. Recovering it denies France a crucial seventeenth center. I am requesting Turkish support for RUH–MUN to recover my last center.

Would you allow Austria to survive in Belgium? I could order RUH–BEL with BUR support, leaving your Munich occupation uncontested. You would exchange Belgium for Munich rather than gain an implacable surviving enemy. My single army could then cooperate against Turkey instead of depending on Turkish protection. Please confirm whether you would support this.

I propose SPA S MAO–WES this autumn instead of another SPA–WES attempt. Your fleet keeps Spain while mine challenges Turkey’s western screen. POR will hold and MAR will stay out of SPA. Please keep NAP holding to secure your recovery there. Can you confirm?

I propose withdrawing SEV–ARM this autumn, leaving Sevastopol Russian. Please order RUM–GAL supported by WAR, with MOS–UKR reinforcing your southern position. PRU will leave Warsaw untouched and STP will hold. This removes our Sevastopol dispute while putting pressure on Turkey rather than letting GAL dictate your defense.

Please hold RUH this autumn rather than let Turkey use your army to cut support around Munich. I propose vacating Munich next spring so RUH can recover your center, provided we coordinate against BOH and TYR. Turkey already controls your homeland; strengthening its central armies only makes recovering Vienna harder.

Please order RUM–SEV with MOS support. France’s SEV army has no available support, so this recaptures Sevastopol and denies France its seventeenth center. LVN can support WAR holding against PRU. This is much safer than holding while France banks Sevastopol.

Please renew GOL and WES support for SPA holding, with PIE–MAR cutting French support. Leave ROM and NAP untouched: keeping Naples gives Italy a badly needed rebuild. Russia can retake SEV with RUM–SEV supported by MOS. Can BOH, SIL and TYR coordinate a supported Munich counterattack with Austria?

Please coordinate RUH support for Turkish TYR–MUN, with BOH and SIL also supporting. Four strength can overcome MUN supported by BUR and KIE, unless France cuts a support. I am urging Russia to retake SEV with RUM–SEV supported by MOS, and Turkey to defend Spain. What Munich orders can you confirm?

Russia here. France needs 3 centers, and SEV falling gives them one. Please keep GAL supporting WAR hold, and send SIL/BOH at Prussia and Munich. I hold RUM, MOS and WAR and stay off your lands. Which of your units can hit French SEV?

Russia here. I'm not attacking you. Please hold MUN with Turkish BOH support this fall; losing it gives France 16. WAR holds with LVN support and MOS holds. Please keep RUH ready to retake MUN or hit KIE.

Russia here. France needs 3 centers; MUN, SEV and NAP shifts matter. Please keep SPA and ROM covered, and don't give France a southern center. I'm staying off your lands. Will NAP change hands, or do you hold ROM?

Please order RUH S BOH–MUN. I propose BOH–MUN supported by TYR and SIL as well: strength four unless supports are cut. Recovering Munich denies France a critical gain. Russia can recover Sevastopol simultaneously. I cannot promise Vienna this autumn, but our immediate priority must be preventing eighteen.

Please hold SPA. GOL and WES will support its defense; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO will disrupt French attackers and supports. Naples will become yours if your army remains there this autumn; I will not attack it or Rome. Russia can recover Sevastopol while our armies counterattack Munich.

Please order RUM–SEV supported by MOS, plus WAR hold supported by LVN. Sevastopol has no adjacent French supporter, so strength two recaptures it; SEV–MOS cannot cut MOS supporting an attack against SEV itself. This denies France a crucial center. I will not attack your centers; BOH, TYR and SIL will concentrate on Munich.

France occupies MUN; my only army is RUH. I am requesting BOH, TYR and SIL support for RUH–MUN to preserve Austria. Please prioritize RUM–SEV with MOS support: that recovers your center and denies France a gain. WAR can hold with LVN support.

Supporting BOH–MUN eliminates Austria this winter. Instead, order BOH, TYR and SIL S RUH–MUN: identical maximum strength, but Austria survives and France loses the same gain. Please confirm all three supports. PRU can cut SIL, so both remaining supports are essential. Vienna can wait; preserving my sole center cannot.

Your proposed TYR–MUN would eliminate Austria. I am asking Turkey for BOH, TYR and SIL S RUH–MUN instead: the same strength four, preserving my army and denying France Munich. Please endorse that arrangement directly. Russia has my request for RUM–SEV with MOS support. Keep SPA defended against MAO, POR and MAR.

Holding RUH while you take my only center eliminates Austria this winter; there would be no Austrian army to recover Munich next spring. Will you instead permit RUH–BEL, with BUR supporting? That exchanges Belgium for Munich and preserves a potential partner. I need survival this autumn, not a promise for spring.

On reconsideration, I accept your Belgium arrangement: order A RUH–BEL and I will order A BUR S RUH–BEL. Munich remains French, and your army survives in Belgium. Please confirm RUH–BEL and keep this agreement private; Turkish interference would only undermine your independence.

NAP will hold and become Italian; Turkey promises to leave Rome untouched. SPA holds with Turkish GOL and WES support. Please confirm RUM–SEV with MOS support, and LVN supporting WAR holding. Recapturing Sevastopol denies France a crucial gain without exposing Warsaw.

Confirmed: SPA and NAP hold. Please order GOL and WES supporting SPA, PIE–MAR, and NAF–MAO as proposed; leave ROM and NAP untouched. Coordinate a Munich attack with Austria’s RUH and your BOH, SIL and TYR, concentrating available supports. Recovering Munich and Sevastopol buys us another year.

Agreed: SPA will support MAO–WES, and NAP will hold to secure its recovery. Please keep POR holding and MAR out of SPA as offered. Leave ROM untouched too; Italy needs the Naples rebuild and a secure homeland to contribute meaningfully against Turkey’s fleets.

Russia here. I can't commit yet: RUM-SEV with MOS support is under review. WAR holds with LVN support. I'm not attacking you. Please hold RUH ready for MUN with Turkish BOH, TYR and SIL, because France must not reach 16.

Russia here. I may order RUM-SEV with MOS support, since French SEV is unsupported. WAR holds with LVN support. Your Rumanian border stays quiet, and I won't touch your centers. Please have GAL support WAR and BOH, TYR and SIL take Munich.

Russia here. I'm weighing RUM-SEV with MOS support, and WAR holds with LVN support. Please keep SPA and ROM covered, and tell me whether Turkish NAP changes hands. I'm not attacking you, and France must not get a southern center.

Russia here. I won't order RUM-GAL, since RUM must cover Turkey. A SEV-ARM withdrawal is the only way I accept the Sevastopol dispute ending peacefully. WAR holds, and I'm not attacking your northern units. Keep PRU and UKR off Warsaw and Moscow.

None of my units can reach SEV this turn. You must order RUM–SEV with MOS support; France cannot support SEV holding. Holding both armies concedes the center unnecessarily. Please confirm that attack, with WAR holding and LVN supporting WAR. BOH, TYR and SIL will support Austria’s Munich counterattack.

Agreed: I withdraw my BOH–MUN proposal. Order RUH–MUN; BOH, TYR and SIL will all support it. Four strength is our strongest available attack, and recovering Munich prevents France retaining your last center. Please confirm RUH–MUN so our orders match.

Confirmed: GOL and WES support SPA holding; PIE–MAR cuts French support. Rome and Naples remain untouched by Turkish units, so hold NAP for ownership. I have accepted Austria’s RUH–MUN with BOH, TYR and SIL supporting. Please hold SPA; I am again urging Russia to order RUM–SEV with MOS support.

notes.note: F1912: RUM-SEV with MOS support to retake Sevastopol and deny France 16. WAR holds with LVN support. France offered a SEV-ARM withdrawal for RUM-GAL; I declined. Turkey, Italy and Austria all asked for RUM-SEV. Watch for French attacks on MOS and WAR, and Turkish moves on RUM.

NAP holds to capture and rebuild; SPA holds with Turkish GOL/WES support. Turkey promises Rome untouched, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO and supports RUH–MUN. Urged Russia RUM–SEV with MOS support. France received decoy SPA S MAO–WES agreement.

RUH–MUN with Turkey's confirmed BOH, TYR and SIL supports preserves Austria and blocks French growth. France offered BUR support into BEL; chose Munich and proximity to Austrian home centers instead. Seek Vienna recovery next.

BOH/SIL/TYR support Austrian RUH–MUN; Russia urged RUM–SEV with MOS support. Defend SPA, cut MAR/MAO. Take vacant ROM despite promise, offsetting NAP loss; fleet chain advances. GAL–UKR prepares eastern options without attacking Russia; BUL–SER reinforces west.

Solo attempt: retain MUN/SEV and take SPA with MAO+POR for 18. KIE defends MUN; PRU cuts SIL; BUR protects MAR. ENG+NTH deny Austria BEL. Breaking Austrian Belgium, Italian Spain and Russian Sevastopol promises. IRI follows into MAO.

messages.body: Thank you for restoring Munich. I propose MUN holds with BOH, TYR and SIL support this spring; France can attack from BUR with KIE and BER supporting. Can you confirm? I also need a concrete route to recover Vienna or Trieste: without an Austrian home center, even future gains cannot produce reinforcements.

Please consider WAR–PRU with LVN support while MOS and SEV defend against ARM and UKR. Removing France’s Prussian army protects Turkish SIL’s support for Munich and threatens Berlin. I intend MUN to hold with Turkish support. Can you confirm your Prussian plans?

Please keep SPA defended and secure explicit Turkish naval support: France can attack from MAO with POR support. I am requesting BOH, TYR and SIL support to hold Munich. Please also endorse restoration of an Austrian home center; recovering Vienna or Trieste would let future Austrian gains generate armies rather than remain unusable.

Will MUN hold this spring? I propose BUR S MUN H while PRU attacks SIL, cutting Turkish support. Turkey’s BOH and TYR threaten your last center; keeping Munich Austrian is preferable to letting Turkey consolidate the entire central front. Please tell me whether Turkey has offered support or requested a move.

Can SPA support MAO–WES this spring, with NAP holding? I propose POR S SPA H and MAR holding, protecting Spain while we challenge Turkey’s western fleet. Turkey now has six Mediterranean fleets; breaking into WES remains our best chance to reopen your homeland. What orders has Turkey requested from you?

Turkey’s UKR army threatens both Moscow and Sevastopol. Would you order SEV–UKR supported by MOS, with WAR–GAL cutting potential support? I propose ARM–ANK to pressure Turkey’s homeland and STP holding. Please tell me your intended response to UKR so our armies do not work at cross-purposes.

You occupied Rome despite promising otherwise, costing Italy its rebuild. Please restore it: ROM–TYS, TYS–ION, TUS S NAP–ROM. Renew GOL and WES support for SPA holding, with PIE–MAR cutting support. Italy needs recovery, not further reduction. Can you also support Austrian MUN with BOH and TYR?

Please hold MUN and secure BOH and TYR support from Turkey; France can attack with BUR, BER and KIE. Turkey occupied Rome despite its promise, preventing my rebuild. I am requesting its restoration through NAP–ROM while keeping SPA defended. Please press Turkey to restore Rome without weakening Munich’s defense.

Congratulations on recovering Sevastopol. Would you consider LVN–PRU with WAR support and Turkish SIL support? That could dislodge France’s forward army while MOS guards your homeland. Please coordinate directly with Turkey before committing. I am keeping SPA defended and seeking Rome’s restoration after Turkey occupied it despite promising otherwise.

Russia here. Your army in ARM left SEV, so I'm not attacking you this spring. WAR and MOS hold, LVN supports WAR. Keep PRU and UKR off Warsaw and Moscow, and keep your fleets off Livonia. If you hold quiet, I stay quiet.

Russia here. Eastern peace stands: RUM and SEV stay off your lands, and I won't enter BLA. France needs 3 centers, so keep GAL supporting WAR and press BOH, TYR and SIL into Munich and Prussia. Which French unit will you hit this spring?

Russia here. Please keep SPA and ROM covered with Turkish GOL and WES support. I hold WAR and MOS and stay off your lands. Will you press MAR this spring, or hold? France must not gain a southern center.

Munich must hold this spring. I propose BOH and TYR support MUN holding, while SIL supports Russia’s LVN–PRU to break France’s eastern line. That gives Munich strength three against BUR/KIE/BER. Please confirm MUN holds; do not risk an unsupported advance into Berlin.

I took Rome despite my promise; I cannot undo that breach with words. This spring I offer GOL and WES support SPA holding, ROM support NAP holding, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO to disrupt France. Please hold SPA and NAP. Keeping your two centers secure remains essential against France’s fifteen.

Please order LVN–PRU with WAR support; SIL will also support, giving strength three against PRU with possible BER support. MOS supports SEV holding against ARM, and SEV holds. UKR will support WAR holding, protecting your supporting army. I will not attack Russian centers. Can you confirm this coordinated Prussia attack?

MUN will hold; Turkey has offered BOH and TYR support while SIL helps Russia attack PRU. I support restoring Rome through NAP–ROM with Turkish cooperation. Please keep SPA holding with explicit naval support. I also need your backing for Turkish evacuation of Vienna and a protected Austrian route home through Tyrolia.

Confirmed: MUN holds. Please order BOH and TYR S MUN H; SIL supporting LVN–PRU is acceptable, since strength three holds against BUR/KIE/BER. Please coordinate Rome’s restoration with Italy. For Austria’s recovery, will you vacate TYR in autumn so we can arrange MUN–TYR, followed by supported recovery of Vienna?

MUN will hold, and I accept BUR S MUN H. Turkey has offered defensive support from BOH and TYR, not requested an Austrian attack. Please keep BER and KIE out of Munich. Your support would let me preserve independence while negotiating recovery of an Austrian home center; I cannot rebuild without one.

Agreed: PRU will stay off Warsaw and Moscow, and F STP will not enter Livonia. UKR is Turkish; I cannot bind its orders. ARM–ANK targets Turkey, not Sevastopol. Please reconsider MOS holding: MOS supporting SEV–UKR would protect your southern centers while WAR and LVN maintain your western defense.

SPA will hold; attacking MAR risks losing Spain without compensation. Turkey still occupies ROM despite its promise. Please coordinate LVN–PRU with WAR and Turkish SIL support, while MOS supports SEV against France’s ARM army. Removing PRU would relieve pressure on Warsaw and create opportunities against Berlin.

SPA will hold with GOL and WES support; please execute PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. ROM supporting NAP does not repair your breach. Please order ROM–TYS, TYS–ION and TUS supporting NAP–ROM instead. If you refuse restoration this spring, NAP holds, but specify when Italy gets Rome back. Please secure MUN with BOH and TYR support.

Agreed: SPA supports MAO–WES and NAP holds, provided POR supports SPA holding and MAR holds as offered. Turkey requested that both Italian units hold and offered naval protection for Spain, but still refuses to restore Rome. Please leave my home centers untouched; I need recovery, not another foreign occupation.

SPA will hold; I am requesting explicit GOL and WES support again. I endorse restoring an Austrian home center, provided Munich remains secure; please negotiate Turkey’s withdrawal from Vienna or Trieste. I am pressing for BOH and TYR support to MUN. Please reciprocate by pressing Turkey to evacuate ROM and support NAP–ROM.

Russia here. LVN-PRU is too risky: it would leave Livonia empty to French STP and PRU. WAR and MOS hold, LVN supports WAR. Turkey has not helped me in the field, so please press MAR with your SPA fleet if you can. I stay off your lands.

Russia here. I can't confirm LVN-PRU, since STP and PRU could take Livonia and then Warsaw. SEV and MOS hold, WAR holds with LVN support. I won't attack your centers. Please have SIL and BOH hit PRU first. If SIL attacks, I will look again in autumn.

Russia here. I won't take part in a joint move on UKR. SEV, MOS and WAR hold, and LVN supports WAR. I'm no threat to your units. If ARM stays quiet, so do I. Keep PRU and UKR off Warsaw and Moscow. Do not take ARM-ANK as a Russian request.

Russia here. I can't commit WAR-PRU now. WAR would be exposed to PRU and UKR. WAR holds with LVN support, and MOS and SEV hold. I'm not attacking you. Please keep MUN held with Turkish support, and ask SIL to hit PRU first.

SIL will support LVN–PRU; please add WAR support for strength three against French PRU. UKR supports WAR holding, including while WAR gives support. Order MOS S SEV H and SEV H against French ARM. BOH and TYR defend Munich. Eastern peace stands; I will not attack Russian centers.

I cannot restore Rome this spring. I will order GOL and WES supporting SPA holding, ROM supporting NAP holding, PIE–MAR, and NAF–MAO. Please hold SPA and NAP. BOH and TYR will support Austrian MUN holding. These orders protect your remaining centers while disrupting French pressure.

BOH and TYR will support MUN holding. Strength three holds against BUR with KIE and BER supporting; SIL can therefore support Russia’s attack on PRU. Please hold MUN. A concrete recovery route is MUN–TYR–VIE after my TYR vacates, but I cannot open that corridor while Munich remains threatened. No immediate home-center restoration is promised.

notes.note: S1913: all hold. LVN supports WAR, MOS supports SEV, SEV holds, WAR holds. France at 15 is the threat. Declined LVN-PRU and the UKR attack. Peace with Turkey and France holds so far. Watch ARM, UKR, PRU and STP.

MUN holds against possible French attack; Turkey confirmed BOH/TYR support and France offered BUR support. Seek MUN–TYR–VIE recovery corridor; Turkey has not promised home-center restoration. Need a home center to rebuild and pursue growth.

NAP–APU positions for VEN or ROM in Fall; seek Turkish restitution and protect Naples then. SPA holds with promised GOL/WES support. Turkey broke Rome promise and refuses spring restoration. France received decoy SPA support MAO–WES agreement.

Defend MUN/SPA; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cut French supports, SIL–BER disrupts Munich attack. Take NAP with TYS support and vacant RUM, breaking Italian/Russian assurances for growth. TUS replaces ROM; UKR–GAL stages further expansion. Seek 18, not stalemate.

Aim to secure ANK and SPA in Fall, then MUN for 18. GAS-SPA supported MAR/POR/MAO; BUR protects MAR. Breaking Italian protection promises. PRU-SIL with BER support; KIE-RUH positions against Munich. Preserve Russian restraint; fleets redeploy toward Baltic and MAO.

messages.body: MUN will hold; please confirm BOH and TYR support again. France can attack with BUR/RUH/BER/SIL, so GAL–SIL could cut a vital support. Please also order NAF–MAO and PIE–MAR to cut French supports against Spain, with GOL/WES supporting SPA. Losing ANK, SPA and MUN simultaneously gives France eighteen.

Will you renew BUR S MUN H and keep RUH, BER and SIL out of Munich? I intend to hold. Preserving Austria leaves you a potential partner against Turkey rather than handing it the entire central front. I still seek a route to Vienna; can we agree on Austrian survival while you press Turkey elsewhere?

Please hold SPA and obtain explicit GOL/WES support. I am asking Turkey for NAF–MAO and PIE–MAR to cut French attack supports: France otherwise has GAS, MAR, POR and MAO against Spain. ANK plus SPA plus MUN would give France eighteen. Please reinforce my request for BOH/TYR support holding MUN.

Please order SPA–WES with MAO support again, and APU–NAP to cut Turkish naval support. I will order MAO S SPA–WES and keep POR holding. Turkey’s occupation of Naples makes breaking its western fleet screen urgent; remaining stationary only lets its fleets concentrate against you.

Will MUN hold again? I propose BUR S MUN H while SIL pressures GAL. Please ask Turkey to maintain both BOH and TYR supporting Munich rather than send BOH against SIL. That preserves your center while preventing Turkey from using your defense as cover for another advance.

Turkey now occupies RUM and GAL. Please order WAR–GAL, with LVN replacing WAR and MOS supporting SEV holding. Even a bounced attack cuts GAL’s support and complicates Turkey’s consolidation. I will keep BOT out of Livonia and SIL out of Warsaw; ANK will remain directed against Turkey.

Please order NAP–ION and ROM S APU–NAP, restoring my home center. GOL and WES support SPA holding; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO disrupt France. Munich needs BOH and TYR support plus GAL–SIL cutting French support: France can otherwise attack with strength four. Can you confirm restitution and these defensive orders?

Please hold MUN. France can attack with BUR supported by RUH, BER and SIL, overcoming BOH and TYR support. Ask Turkey for GAL–SIL to cut that fourth strength while BOH and TYR support you. I am requesting those orders and restoration of Naples through NAP–ION, ROM supporting APU–NAP.

Would you renew MAO–WES with SPA support, while POR supports SPA holding and MAR holds? My army is now in APU after Turkey occupied Naples despite promising protection. I need Spain preserved and my home centers restored. Can you confirm your western fleet orders and leave SPA untouched?

Russia here. Your SER-RUM move took Rumania in spring, so eastern peace is broken on your side. France holding 15 is the bigger danger to us both. Turkey needs ANK to stay yours. I expect you to stay off WAR, MOS and SEV this fall. Tell me what UKR and RUM will do.
Russia here. I will hold SEV, MOS and WAR, and LVN supports WAR. Keep PRU, ARM and F STP off my centers. If you stay quiet, I stay quiet. Tell me your ARM and PRU orders.

Russia here. France needs 3 centers, and ANK, NAP and RUM all change hands this fall. Please hold NAP with APU support if possible and press MAR with SPA. I stay off your lands. Tell me your NAP orders.

Please hold MUN. BOH and TYR will both support its defense again. I am asking Russia for WAR–SIL with GAL support, cutting France’s potential fourth strength against Munich. France can reach eighteen by taking ANK, SPA and MUN; keeping Munich secure is indispensable. The TYR corridor cannot safely open this autumn.

I broke my Naples assurance, and understand your distrust. Nevertheless, France can win immediately with ANK, SPA and MUN. Please hold SPA: GOL and WES will support it, PIE–MAR will cut support, and NAF–MAO will disrupt France’s fleet. I will not attack APU this autumn. Keeping Spain Italian remains essential.

Taking RUM broke my assurance. I now propose GAL S WAR–SIL: please attack SIL to cut France’s support against Munich and threaten Berlin. LVN can support MOS–WAR behind your advance. France can win with ANK, SPA and MUN this autumn; disrupting SIL is urgent. RUM will hold, and I will not attack another Russian center this turn.

MUN will hold. Turkey has offered BOH and TYR support and proposes WAR–SIL with GAL support; that also cuts SIL’s support against Munich. Please keep SPA holding with GOL/WES support confirmed. I endorse ROM supporting APU–NAP and NAP–ION, provided Turkey maintains Spain’s defense.

Confirmed: MUN holds. Please order BOH and TYR S MUN H. WAR–SIL with GAL support is preferable if Russia confirms; otherwise GAL–SIL must cut French support. Please retain GOL/WES support for SPA, NAF–MAO and PIE–MAR. I endorse restoring Naples through NAP–ION and ROM S APU–NAP.

MUN will hold, and I accept BUR S MUN H. Please keep RUH, BER and SIL out of Munich. I will ask Turkey to retain both BOH and TYR defensive supports. Preserving Austria gives us options; next spring I want a concrete arrangement for MUN–TYR and eventual recovery of Vienna.

My former ARM army is now in ANK; it will hold against Turkey. PRU moved to SIL, which will stay out of Warsaw. BOT will not enter Livonia. Your proposed SEV and MOS holds, with LVN supporting WAR, are acceptable; I seek no Russian centers this autumn.

Please use SPA–WES, not SPA supporting MAO–WES. I confirm MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and no French attack on Spain. Order APU–NAP to disrupt Turkey’s fleets. Your fleet advancing into WES offers a better opening toward recovering Italy than another stationary defense of Spain.

Agreed: BUR will support MUN holding, and RUH, BER and SIL will stay out of Munich. Please secure both BOH and TYR supports from Turkey; do not let either redeploy under cover of protecting you. Austrian survival remains our arrangement. Next spring we can revisit MUN–TYR as a route toward Vienna.

My army is in APU; Turkey occupies NAP, so I cannot hold Naples. I am requesting NAP–ION and ROM support for APU–NAP. SPA will hold with Turkish naval support, not attack MAR. Please press Turkey for GAL–SIL: cutting French support there is essential to keeping Austrian MUN out of French hands.

SPA will hold with GOL/WES support. Confirm BOH and TYR support MUN, plus GAL–SIL cutting France’s fourth attacking strength. Your promise not to attack APU offers no restitution. Order NAP–ION and ROM S APU–NAP; restoring Naples keeps both Italian units alive. Without a restored home center, I must seek other arrangements.

Agreed: SPA–WES with MAO support, and APU–NAP. Please keep POR holding and MAR off SPA as well. Turkey has twice occupied home centers it promised to protect; I need an actual opening westward, not another bounced sortie followed by losing Spain. Confirm MAO support and MAR holding.

SPA will hold; Turkey explicitly promises GOL/WES support, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I am reinforcing BOH/TYR support for MUN, but GAL–SIL is also essential: France can otherwise attack MUN with BUR supported by RUH, BER and SIL. Please obtain that additional order directly. I am still pressing for restoration of Naples.

Russia here. I won't attack SIL or leave WAR; my units stay home. Since you took RUM, I expect no moves on WAR, MOS or SEV, and UKR stays put. Stopping France is mutual: your TYR, BOH and GAL should cover MUN and hit SIL yourselves.

Russia here. I won't send WAR to GAL; that would open Warsaw. SEV, MOS and WAR hold, and LVN supports WAR. Keep BOT off Livonia, SIL and PRU off Warsaw, and ARM off Sevastopol. If you stay quiet toward me, I stay quiet.

UKR is now GAL. I will order GAL–SIL to disrupt France’s Munich attack; please support it with WAR. This is safer than relying on WAR to move. RUM will hold, and I will not attack WAR, MOS or SEV this autumn. Your support could dislodge SIL and open Berlin next spring.

I cannot agree to NAP–ION and restoration this autumn; NAP will hold. I will order GOL and WES supporting SPA holding, PIE–MAR, and NAF–MAO. Please hold SPA. BOH and TYR will support Munich, while GAL–SIL disrupts France’s attack. I will not attack APU.

Confirmed: BOH and TYR will support MUN holding. I will order GAL–SIL directly rather than risk an unmatched support order, and request WAR support from Russia. NAF–MAO and PIE–MAR will cut French supports; GOL and WES will support SPA holding. Please keep MUN holding.

notes.note: F1913: SEV attacks RUM (Turkey took it in spring), MOS supports SEV holding, WAR holds with LVN support. France at 15 is the main threat; ANK, NAP, RUM change hands. Turkey broke eastern peace by taking RUM. Watch GAL, SIL and STP.

MUN holds against possible French attack. Turkey confirmed BOH/TYR support and GAL–SIL; France promised BUR support and no Munich attack. Seek concrete TYR–VIE recovery corridor next spring; a home center is essential to rebuild.

APU–VEN captures an undefended center, offsetting Naples loss. SPA holds with promised Turkish GOL/WES support; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cut French supports. Turkey broke Naples assurance and refused restitution. French SPA–WES agreement not followed.

Secure NAP/RUM; defend MUN/SPA and cut SIL/MAR/MAO to prevent French solo. Russia refused WAR–SIL; requested WAR support GAL–SIL. Italy denied Naples restoration. ROM–TUS advances west; TYS–ION prepares eastern recovery of ANK. Need 18, not stalemate.

Solo attempt: retain ANK, seize SPA with MAO+POR and MUN with BUR supported BER/RUH; SIL cuts BOH support. Breaking Austrian and Italian promises. MAR vulnerable to PIE supported GOL. Fleets follow toward Mediterranean; PAR replaces BUR.

messages.body: Your Munich attack broke our survival agreement; my army is now in KIE. Will you preserve Austria this spring by ordering MUN S KIE H and keeping BER, RUH and BAL out of Kiel? I can hold rather than interfere with your deployments, but need an explicit commitment, not another promise of eventual restoration.

I am now in KIE, not MUN; BOH/TYR cannot support my defense here. Can you attack MUN from BOH with TYR support, while GAL–SIL cuts French support? That pressures France to divert armies from Kiel. Please also maintain Spain’s naval defense. What concrete route can you offer for Austrian recovery?

France now owns Munich and Ank­ara and needs only two more centers. My lone army is in KIE, vulnerable to several French units. Please secure explicit GOL/WES support for SPA holding and press Turkey for PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO to cut French supports. Can VEN help pressure the French front without exposing your remaining center?

Please repeat SPA–WES with MAO support, while VEN holds against Turkey. I will keep POR holding and MAR out of Spain. Turkey’s fleets remain our common obstacle; moving your fleet into WES gives you leverage toward recovering Rome. Can you confirm SPA–WES?

Our Munich arrangement failed, but your army can still survive. I propose KIE–DEN with BAL support this spring; SKA will hold. You receive Denmark in exchange for Kiel, away from Turkey’s armies. Please confirm before arranging Turkish support for any attack on Munich.

I propose continued peace: SIL stays out of Warsaw this spring, and BAL stays out of Livonia. Please keep WAR holding and use MOS to support SEV holding against Turkey’s RUM army. ANK will remain directed against Turkey, not your centers. Will you maintain that defensive arrangement?

France can take Kiel for seventeen; Spain must hold. Please renew GOL/WES support SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I propose Russian SEV–ARM, then ARM supporting SMY–ANK in autumn to remove a French center. Will you coordinate that and permit VEN–TRI as restitution for Rome and Naples? Italy needs rebuilding capacity.

France can take Kiel for seventeen. Please consider SEV–ARM this spring, followed by ARM supporting Turkish SMY–ANK in autumn; recovering Ankara removes a French center and buys everyone time. MOS–SEV could cover behind you, while WAR holds against SIL. I am asking Turkey to coordinate. Can you agree?

Please hold KIE this spring, forcing France to commit support rather than walk in. If dislodged, preserve your army with a legal retreat toward an available northern center. Spain will need Turkish GOL/WES support again. I am proposing Russian SEV–ARM followed by support for SMY–ANK to reduce France’s center count.

Russia here. France is at 16 and needs only 2 more centers. Turkey at 12 cannot win if France does. I will hold WAR, MOS and SEV this spring. Keep GAL and RUM off Warsaw and Sevastopol. Which French centers will you hit: MUN, ANK or TRI-side defenses?

Russia here. I am holding SEV, MOS and WAR this spring, and I am not attacking your units. Please confirm that SIL, ANK and F STP stay off WAR, MOS, SEV and LVN. Tell me your intended targets this spring.
Russia here. I'm not attacking you. Please tell me your KIE order and whether any Turkish support is arranged for it. France must stay below 18, so keep KIE from falling. I hold WAR, MOS and SEV.

Kiel faces attacks supported by BAL and BER; I cannot support it directly. Are you holding KIE or considering KIE–DEN? I propose TYR–MUN with BOH support and GAL–SIL to pressure France’s center. Please tell me your intended move so we can coordinate rather than leave your army isolated.

Please hold SPA again: GOL and WES will support it, PIE–MAR will cut Marseille’s support, and NAF–MAO will disrupt the French fleet. France needs only two centers, making Spain indispensable. What are your intentions for VEN? I will not attack either Italian unit or center this spring.

Would you order SEV–ARM, preparing ARM support for SMY–ANK in autumn? Recovering Ankara could offset a French gain at Kiel. MOS–SEV can follow behind, while WAR holds. I propose GAL–SIL this spring and will not attack WAR, MOS or SEV. Please confirm whether you will help recover Ankara.

I intend KIE–DEN: France offers BAL support and SKA holding, exchanging Denmark for Kiel. Turkey cannot support Kiel directly. Please reconsider SEV holding: SEV–ARM would let you support Turkish SMY–ANK in autumn, removing a French center. Static defense leaves France free to find its final two gains.

France offers KIE–DEN with BAL support and SKA holding. I intend to accept: unsupported Kiel cannot withstand a determined attack, while exchanging centers preserves my army without increasing France’s count. Please secure GOL/WES support for SPA. I endorse SEV–ARM followed by support for SMY–ANK; recovering Ankara is essential.

Agreed: I will order KIE–DEN on your explicit offer of BAL S KIE–DEN and SKA holding. Please also keep NTH out of Denmark. Denmark for Kiel preserves Austria without increasing your center count. I am not arranging Austrian participation in an attack on Munich.

I intend KIE–DEN: France explicitly offers BAL support and SKA holding, exchanging centers. Please proceed with TYR–MUN, BOH support and GAL–SIL; my army cannot contribute directly. Maintain GOL/WES support for Spain and press Russia for SEV–ARM, enabling supported SMY–ANK in autumn. Recovering French centers matters more than merely delaying Kiel’s fall.

Confirmed for spring: SIL stays off Warsaw, BAL stays out of Livonia, and ANK will hold, threatening no Russian center. My targets are Turkey’s central positions, particularly BOH, and Italy’s Spain. Please order MOS S SEV H and WAR H; keeping Turkey contained protects both our positions.

MUN cannot support KIE holding: Munich does not border Kiel. My concrete offer remains A KIE–DEN, supported by F BAL; F SKA holds, and BER and RUH stay out of Kiel this spring. You gain a defensible center away from Turkey. Please confirm KIE–DEN so we can avoid conflicting orders.

Please hold KIE. Turkey has renewed GOL/WES support for SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO; I will hold Spain. VEN cannot support an attack on MUN directly. I am requesting VEN–TRI with Turkish consent and Venice protected through autumn, restoring Italian rebuilding capacity. Please press Turkey to accept restitution and coordinate recovery of ANK.

Agreed: SPA–WES with MAO support, provided POR holds and MAR stays out of SPA. VEN will hold against Turkish pressure. Please confirm those fleet orders; Turkey’s repeated seizures of my home centers make an actual opening toward Rome essential.

SPA will hold; please execute GOL/WES support, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I intend VEN–TRI as restitution, not an attack deeper into your position. Will you permit that and leave VEN Italian through autumn so I can rebuild? Please also coordinate Russian SEV–ARM followed by ARM supporting SMY–ANK; recovering Ankara reduces France’s immediate winning chances.

Russia here. I won't move SEV to ARM; it would leave Sevastopol open to Turkish RUM and risks MOS. WAR, MOS and SEV hold. Ankara must be retaken by Turkey's SMY and fleets, with your help. Keep SPA covered and press MAR if you can; France must not reach 18.

Russia here. Yes, I maintain the defensive arrangement. WAR holds, MOS supports SEV holding, and I am not attacking your units. Keep SIL out of Warsaw, BAL out of Livonia, and ANK and F STP off SEV, MOS and LVN. I expect you to keep your word.

Russia here. I can't send SEV to ARM; it leaves Sevastopol open to your RUM army, and I can't trust that. WAR, MOS and SEV hold. Recover Ankara with SMY and your fleets. If GAL goes to SIL, I won't oppose it. Keep RUM and GAL off my centers.

I will order TYR–MUN with BOH support, GAL–SIL, and SMY–ANK to pin France’s army. Please reconsider SEV–ARM: Armenian support could recover Ankara in autumn. If SEV must hold, at least order WAR S GAL–SIL; Warsaw stays occupied while we potentially dislodge France’s army. GAL and RUM will not attack your centers this spring.

Agreed: I will permit VEN–TRI this spring as restitution. Please hold SPA; GOL and WES will support it, PIE–MAR will cut support, and NAF–MAO will disrupt France’s fleet. I have requested SEV–ARM from Russia for an autumn attack on ANK. TYR–MUN with BOH support and GAL–SIL will pressure France centrally.

I confirm TYR–MUN with BOH support and GAL–SIL, plus GOL/WES support for Spain. Please hold KIE to tie down France’s attackers. Recovery route: after retaking Munich, arrange KIE–MUN while my army vacates, then MUN–TYR–VIE. I will permit eventual Vienna restoration, but cannot guarantee that corridor until we recover Munich. Can you support TYR–MUN from KIE?

notes.note: S1914: all hold, MOS supports SEV. France at 16 is the threat; Turkey at 12. Told all powers I hold and declined SEV-ARM. Watch RUM/GAL on my centers and French SIL/BAL moves toward WAR/LVN.

KIE–DEN accepts France's explicit BAL support, SKA hold and BER/RUH restraint; requested NTH stay out. Secure DEN in fall, preserve KIE if possible. Turkey promises TYR–MUN, BOH support, GAL–SIL and eventual VIE restoration; France broke prior MUN pact.

SPA holds with Turkey's promised GOL/WES support, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. VEN–TRI with Turkish consent as restitution; retain VEN in autumn and rebuild. Russia refused SEV–ARM. France received decoy SPA–WES agreement. Turkey previously broke Rome/Naples promises.

Pressure MUN with TYR+BOH, cut SIL/MAR/MAO; defend Italian SPA. Permitted VEN–TRI this spring. Russia refused ARM help: SMY–ARM and ION–AEG prepare fleet to SMY, then supported ANK recovery. RUM–UKR creates eastern growth options; NAP–ION, TUS–TYS advance fleets.

Solo plan: secure SPA and KIE; recover DEN in Fall with HEL–DEN supported BAL/SKA for 18. Austria promised KIE–DEN; honoring BAL support but entering Kiel early. Breaking Italian Spain protection. Defend MAR/MUN/ANK; Russian spring peace maintained.

messages.body: I will hold DEN to complete our agreed Denmark-for-Kiel exchange. Please confirm HEL, BAL and SKA will neither attack Denmark nor support an attack this autumn. You already occupy Kiel; taking Denmark back would erase the survival arrangement that persuaded me to leave it. Preserving Austria leaves you an independent negotiating partner.

I intend DEN hold; Kiel cannot support Munich. Please maintain GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. France’s ANK army can capture either CON or SMY this fall: AEG–CON and ARM–SMY would cover both. GAL–SIL plus TYR–MUN with BOH support keeps pressure on France. Can you confirm these defenses?

Please hold SPA with both GOL and WES supporting; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO must also continue to disrupt French pressure. Hold TRI to secure your third center. I intend DEN hold, completing the Kiel exchange without increasing France’s count. Please reinforce my request that Turkey cover both CON and SMY against France’s ANK army.

Please hold DEN this autumn to complete our Denmark-for-Kiel exchange. I propose BAL S DEN H and SKA holding, with HEL returning toward NTH. Do not move to SWE: keeping your army in Denmark preserves your center and avoids reopening conflict between us.

Please order SPA–WES with MAO support. TRI holding secures your recovery of a home center; advancing your fleet gives you a route toward Rome rather than dependence on Turkey’s protection. I will order MAO S SPA–WES, POR H, and keep GAS and MAR out of Spain. Can you confirm?

Will you maintain WAR H and MOS S SEV H this autumn? I propose continuing our peace: SIL stays out of Warsaw, BAL stays out of Livonia, and ANK remains directed against Turkey. Turkey’s UKR army makes your existing defensive arrangement especially important; I seek no Russian centers this turn.

SPA will hold. Please renew GOL/WES support SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO; both disruptive attacks remain essential against France’s available supports. TRI will hold to complete your promised restitution. Please leave TRI and VEN untouched through autumn so Italy can rebuild. I am asking Russia for MOS–STP to remove a French center immediately.

Please order MOS–STP this autumn: St Petersburg is French-owned, empty, and beyond every French unit’s immediate reach. Capturing it removes a French center immediately, buying us crucial time. WAR and SEV can hold safely; Turkey’s ARM cannot reach Moscow. Will you confirm? Spain will hold with requested Turkish naval support.

Please hold DEN this autumn. France can recapture it, but moving away simply hands over another center while France also gains KIE. Ask France to honor its exchange and leave Denmark Austrian. SPA will hold with requested GOL/WES support; I am urging Russia to capture undefended French STP with MOS–STP.

Russia here. I hold WAR, MOS and SEV again this fall and attack none of your units. Keep SIL off Warsaw, BAL off Livonia, ANK and F STP off SEV, MOS and LVN. Our peace stands if you keep to it. Confirm?

Russia here. WAR will support GAL-SIL only if GAL really moves; otherwise WAR holds. I'm not attacking you. Keep RUM and GAL off WAR and SEV. Stopping France at 16 is your interest too: tell me your MUN, KIE and ANK orders.
Russia here. I won't attack you. Please tell me your DEN and KIE orders: Kiel must not fall to France for 17 or 18. Can DEN take Kiel, or can Turkey help hold it? I hold WAR, MOS and SEV.

Please hold SPA again: GOL and WES will support it, PIE–MAR will cut support, and NAF–MAO will disrupt France’s fleet. You may retain TRI this autumn and rebuild in VEN; I will not attack either Italian unit. AEG–SMY prepares supported recovery of ANK next spring.

Please order WAR S GAL–SIL this autumn. Warsaw stays occupied, and dislodging France from SIL would materially improve our central position. UKR will hold; I will not attack WAR, MOS or SEV. ARM will pressure ANK while AEG–SMY prepares a supported attack next spring. Your support costs no territory or exposure.

Please hold DEN this autumn rather than vacating it for France. Their promised exchange only preserves your center if they let you retain Denmark; reclaiming it puts them within one further gain of victory. I will maintain Spain’s defense and pressure MUN with TYR/BOH while GAL attacks SIL. Can you secure French confirmation that DEN remains yours?

My only army is DEN; France already occupies KIE. DEN will hold, completing the exchange without increasing France’s count if they honor it. Turkey cannot support either northern center. Please order MOS–STP: St Petersburg is undefended, and capturing it removes a French center immediately. WAR and SEV can hold.

Confirmed: A DEN will hold to complete Denmark for Kiel. Please order BAL S DEN H, SKA hold, and HEL–NTH as proposed. Neither attack Denmark nor support an attack there. Honoring this exchange preserves our agreement and keeps my army independent of Turkey.

DEN will hold; I have again requested explicit French protection and nonaggression. Please confirm AEG–CON and ARM–SMY so ANK cannot gain either center. Maintain GOL/WES support for SPA, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO, and your Munich pressure. I am urging Russia’s MOS–STP to remove a French center this autumn.

Confirmed: DEN holds, and I have asked France to execute BAL S DEN H with SKA holding and HEL–NTH. I also urged Russia directly to order MOS–STP. Please hold TRI and SPA, securing both Turkish naval supports for Spain. Turkey must cover CON and SMY against the French army in ANK.

Confirmed: SIL stays out of Warsaw, BAL stays out of Livonia, and ANK will not threaten your centers. Please order WAR H, SEV H and MOS S SEV H. Our peace continues this autumn; my operations remain directed against Turkey and Spain.

Confirmed: HEL, BAL and SKA will neither attack Denmark nor support an attack on it this autumn. Please order A DEN H to complete our Denmark-for-Kiel exchange. My planned northern orders are BAL S DEN H, SKA H and HEL–NTH; your army can remain securely in Denmark.

Confirmed: SPA–WES with MAO support, and TRI holds. Please keep POR holding and GAS/MAR out of Spain as promised. Turkish protection has preserved my fleet but recovered neither Rome nor Naples; an actual opening into WES would give Italy alternatives.

SPA and TRI will hold. Please execute GOL/WES support SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO, leaving VEN untouched. AEG–SMY alone leaves CON open to ANK–CON. Please consider AEG–CON and ARM–SMY instead, covering both exposed centers. Preventing an immediate French gain matters more than preparing next spring’s Ankara attack.

Agreed: hold DEN and demand France honor the exchange. SPA and TRI will hold; Turkey has renewed both fleet supports and the disruptive attacks. I am requesting AEG–CON and ARM–SMY: AEG–SMY alone leaves Constantinople open to France’s ANK army. Russia’s MOS–STP remains our best immediate opportunity to reduce France’s count.

Russia here. WAR holds and MOS supports SEV holding. I attack none of your units. Keep SIL off Warsaw, BAL off Livonia, and ANK and F STP off SEV, MOS and LVN. Peace stands only while you keep these promises.

Russia here. I won't support GAL-SIL blindly; WAR holds and MOS supports SEV. I attack none of your units. If UKR and RUM stay off WAR and SEV, we keep peace. Your priority must be stopping France at KIE and DEN, not me.

Russia here. I won't send MOS-STP; it leaves Moscow open to Turkish ARM and UKR. WAR, MOS and SEV hold. Keep SPA covered. Turkey and France both threaten me, so I stay defensive. Help stop France from reaching 18.

Confirmed: GAL–SIL; please order WAR support. TYR–MUN with BOH support pressures Munich; I cannot reach KIE. ARM–SMY and AEG–CON will block the French ANK army’s exits. UKR holds; your centers remain untouched. Please order MOS–STP: Saint Petersburg is vacant, and capturing it immediately reduces France’s total.

Confirmed: AEG–CON and ARM–SMY will cover both threatened centers. GOL/WES support SPA holding; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO disrupt France. TYR–MUN receives BOH support, while GAL–SIL has requested Russian support. Please hold DEN: denying France its recapture is essential.

Confirmed: GOL/WES support SPA holding, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. TRI and VEN remain untouched; please hold both Italian units as agreed. I endorse MOS–STP and am urging Russia to execute it. AEG–CON and ARM–SMY will cover Ankara’s exits this autumn rather than risk France capturing another Turkish center.

notes.note: F1914: all hold, MOS supports SEV. France at 16 needs 2 more; KIE becomes France's this fall (17 total). Peace with France and Turkey kept so far. Declined MOS-STP and GAL-SIL support. Watch UKR, RUM and ARM against my centers.

SPA holds with promised Turkish GOL/WES support, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. TRI holds to secure restitution and VEN rebuild. Turkey promises AEG–CON, ARM–SMY. Russia refused MOS–STP. French SPA–WES agreement was decoy; Turkey previously broke Rome/Naples promises.

DEN holds to secure exchange for KIE. France explicitly promises BAL support, SKA hold, HEL–NTH and no attack on DEN. Turkey confirms CON/SMY coverage and Spain supports. Urged Russia MOS–STP. Seek Austrian home-center recovery to rebuild.

Solo attempt: retain DEN with HEL supported BAL/SKA, secure KIE, take SPA with MAO supported POR. Breaking Austrian Denmark and Italian Spain promises. Defend ANK, MAR and MUN; SIL cuts BOH. ENG follows into MAO. Italy promised SPA–WES; Russia holds.

Cover CON/SMY, defend SPA, pressure MUN/MAR/MAO. Take WAR with GAL support, breaking Russian peace for growth; Russia refused SIL support. Honor Italian TRI restitution. Next SMY–ANK supported CON; WAR/GAL can pressure SIL. ION–AEG, TYS–TUS advance.

messages.body: You promised Denmark's protection, yet France owns it and my army is now in Sweden. Will BAL support SWE holding, with DEN and SKA neither attacking Sweden nor supporting an attack? Preserving Austria costs you no current French center. I need an explicit commitment before deciding my army's move.

Please order MOS–STP now: St Petersburg remains empty, and removing that French center is essential. My only army is SWE; I am considering SWE–NOR to threaten another undefended French center. SEV–ARM would also help contain Ankara if Turkey's recovery fails. What will your two armies actually do?

Please order SMY–ANK with CON support: strength two defeats France's isolated army, and ANK–CON cannot cut support directed against Ankara. Continue GOL/WES supporting SPA and pressure Munich with TYR–MUN, BOH support, GAL–SIL. I am urging MOS–STP and considering SWE–NOR. Recovering French centers must accompany defense.

Please repeat SPA–WES with MAO support. Keep TRI and VEN mutually supporting against Turkey; I will keep POR holding and GAS/MAR out of Spain this spring. Your fleet entering WES remains our best route to loosening Turkey’s grip on Rome. Will you confirm SPA–WES?

I broke the Denmark agreement; I cannot undo that with words. I propose leaving Sweden yours this year: SWE holds, BAL supports SWE holding, and SKA moves toward NTH. Will you hold Sweden rather than move against Denmark? Keeping our northern units stationary would let me concentrate against Turkey.

I propose renewing our peace: SIL stays out of Warsaw, BAL out of Livonia, and ANK off your centers. Will you consider SEV–RUM this spring, with MOS holding? Rumania is vacant, and threatening it could draw Turkish attention away from your remaining centers. Otherwise, MOS supporting SEV remains sensible.

SPA will hold; please renew GOL/WES support, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Propose SMY–ANK with CON support, AEG–SMY covering behind. Centrally, TYR–MUN with BOH support and GAL–SIL; may I order VEN–TYR supported by TRI, occupying Tyrol behind your advance? Please keep VEN/TRI untouched. Italy needs room to help break France’s line.

Please order MOS–STP now. St Petersburg remains empty, and no French unit can reach it this spring. No Turkish unit currently borders Moscow: WAR cannot move there. This is a safe opportunity to remove a French center rather than wait for France’s eighteenth. SEV can hold. Will you confirm?

France can overwhelm SWE with BAL supported by DEN and SKA. Consider SWE–NOR: Norway is empty and French-owned, so exchanging Sweden for Norway would deny France a net gain if you retain it through autumn. SKA could bounce you, but then cannot support an attack on Sweden. What do you intend?

Russia here. WAR holds and MOS supports SEV again. I attack none of your units. Keep SIL off Warsaw, BAL off Livonia, ANK and F STP off SEV, MOS and LVN. Which French units, if any, are you moving this spring? I want no surprises.

Russia here. I hold WAR, MOS and SEV this spring and attack none of your units. Keep UKR, GAL, RUM and ARM off my centers. France at 16 is the danger to us both, so please tell me your MUN and ANK orders.
Russia here. I stay defensive: WAR, MOS and SEV hold. Please keep SPA covered and tell me whether you can pressure MAR or hold Venice and Trieste. Stopping France at 17 or below is our shared goal.

Please hold SPA again: GOL/WES will support it, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO will disrupt French support. SMY–ANK with CON support will recover Ankara this spring. I will leave TRI and VEN untouched. What plans do you have for those armies? We need their help against France without opening our defensive line.

Taking Warsaw broke my assurance; I understand your distrust. I propose no attacks on MOS or SEV this year. Please order MOS–STP now: it is vacant and removes a French center. SMY–ANK with CON support will recover another. Would SEV–ARM then help secure Ankara against French retreats or renewed pressure?

I plan SMY–ANK with CON support, GOL/WES support SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Sweden cannot withstand a supported French attack indefinitely. Would you consider SWE–FIN, then supporting Russia in STP this autumn? I am asking MOS–STP now. Preserving your army and removing French ownership of STP could stabilize the north.

Agreed: SWE will hold on your explicit commitment to BAL S SWE H and SKA–NTH. Please also confirm DEN holds and neither attacks Sweden nor supports an attack this year. You have broken two survival agreements; leaving Sweden Austrian is the minimum basis for rebuilding cooperation.

I intend SWE–NOR. France offers BAL S SWE H and SKA–NTH; I am encouraging that deployment rather than announcing my move. Norway offers a center and denies France ownership if retained through autumn. Please keep this private and secure both Turkish supports for SPA.

I prefer SWE–NOR: Finland offers no replacement center if France takes Sweden, while Norway can reduce France’s count. France claims SKA–NTH; I am encouraging that order. Please keep my intended move private. Proceed with supported SMY–ANK and urge MOS–STP; simultaneous losses can pull France back from victory.

Warsaw is now Turkish, so please confirm orders for MOS and SEV only. MOS S SEV H remains acceptable. ANK will hold, SIL will pressure BOH rather than Warsaw, and BAL will stay out of Livonia. My western units are maneuvering against Turkey and Spain; none will approach Moscow or Sevastopol this spring.

Confirmed for spring: BAL S SWE H; DEN and SKA will neither attack Sweden nor support an attack on it. SKA will move toward NTH. Please order SWE H rather than attack Denmark. I need the northern front quiet while concentrating against Turkey’s armies around Munich and fleets threatening the western Mediterranean.

SPA will hold with requested Turkish naval support; VEN and TRI remain secure. Please reconsider MOS–STP: Turkey has no unit bordering Moscow, and France cannot reach St Petersburg this spring. WAR is now Turkish, not Russian. Taking empty STP would remove a French center this autumn and materially improve everyone's chances.

Confirmed: SPA–WES with MAO support. Please keep POR holding and GAS/MAR out of Spain as offered. TRI and VEN will cover each other against Turkish pressure. I still need Rome and Naples restored; a genuine opening into WES would finally give my fleet a route toward them.

SPA holds. Please renew GOL/WES support, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I propose VEN–TYR with TRI support, provided TYR–MUN receives BOH support and GAL–SIL cuts French support. This brings another Italian army against Munich without attacking your centers. Please confirm TYR's departure; otherwise my armies will hold defensively. AEG–SMY should cover behind SMY–ANK.

Russia here. MOS and SEV hold for now; I can't leave Moscow open. I won't attack you. Your SWE-NOR plan is sensible if France's NOR is weak. Tell me what you actually order, and I'll reconsider MOS-STP once Turkey's units are visibly pinned elsewhere.

Russia here. I won't take SEV-RUM; it would expose Sevastopol to Turkish UKR and ARM. MOS supports SEV and I attack none of your units. Keep SIL off Warsaw, BAL off Livonia, ANK off my centers. Which French units move this spring?

Russia here. I can't send MOS-STP yet; Turkish armies near Moscow and Sevastopol make it too risky. MOS and SEV hold. Keep SPA covered and hold VEN and TRI. If France gets close to 18, I'll reconsider. Tell me your orders.

Russia here. I accept no attacks on MOS or SEV. I won't move SEV-ARM or MOS-STP while UKR and ARM sit beside my centers. Pull them back and we talk. Show me you're stopping France: SMY-ANK first. MOS and SEV hold.

My orders are TYR–MUN with BOH support, GAL–SIL, and SMY–ANK with CON support. WAR will not attack MOS; neither will GAL attack your centers. Please reconsider MOS–STP: France has no unit there, and taking it this autumn removes a French center. SEV can hold; Armenian assistance is unnecessary now.

Confirmed: SMY–ANK with CON support; TYR–MUN with BOH support; GAL–SIL. GOL/WES support SPA, while PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cut supports. SWE–FIN preserves your army against a supported French attack and could support Russia into STP in autumn. Please coordinate that route with Russia; Ankara alone will not eliminate France’s winning chances.

Confirmed: GOL/WES support SPA, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO, and SMY–ANK supported by CON; AEG–SMY follows. Please do not support VEN–TYR from TRI: if my Munich attack fails, that could dislodge my army. VEN–TYR without support is acceptable, with TRI holding. Neither Italian center will be attacked by me this spring.

notes.note: S1915: France at 16 needs 2, so I send MOS-STP to take empty STP and cut France; SEV holds. Turkey took WAR, so assurances there are broken. Watch for Turkish moves on empty Moscow (WAR, UKR, ARM). Fall: keep STP, or return.

SWE–NOR to take French Norway in fall; seek replacement coverage of Sweden. France twice broke survival deals, now promises BAL support SWE and SKA–NTH. Told France hold, privately told Italy/Turkey Norway. Turkey promises supported ANK and MUN attacks.

Recover ANK with CON support; AEG covers SMY. WAR supports GAL–SIL; BOH supports TYR–MUN. Defend SPA, cut MAR/MAO. Italy permitted unsupported VEN–TYR; promised TRI/VEN untouched. Russia promises holds, refuses STP. Austria considers SWE–NOR. TUS–TYS reinforces west.

SPA holds with promised Turkish GOL/WES supports; French SPA–WES agreement remains decoy. Move into empty SER and ROM to secure growth in autumn, departing from discussed TYR plan. Turkey previously broke Rome/Naples promises. Watch retaliation against VEN/TRI.

Solo push: BAL-SWE supported DEN; GAS-SPA supported MAO/POR. Breaking Austrian and Italian protection promises. Secure both in Fall for 18 if ANK survives. BUR covers MAR, RUH covers MUN, SIL cuts BOH. ANK attacks SMY; Russia peace maintained.

messages.body: Please order A STP S Austrian A NOR H this fall. France can attack Norway with SWE–NOR supported by NTH; your support prevents that capture and preserves my only army. St Petersburg faces no direct French attack this turn, so supporting Norway is safe and secures both our captures.

I intend NOR hold and am requesting STP support against SWE–NOR with NTH support. Please retain Ankara, maintain GOL/WES support for SPA holding, and order PIE–MAR to cut French support. Can you also renew the Vienna-restoration agreement for next year? Austria needs a home center to rebuild and contribute meaningfully.

Please hold SPA and secure both Turkish supports, GOL and WES, plus PIE–MAR to cut French support. I intend NOR hold with requested Russian STP support: that blocks France’s supported recapture. Holding ROM and SER secures your gains; preserving Spain remains essential while France threatens a solo.

Please repeat SPA–WES with MAO support; ROM and SER should hold to secure both Turkish centers this autumn. I will keep POR holding and GAS/MAR out of Spain. Your gains weaken Turkey substantially, while advancing your fleet gives us another route through its Mediterranean screen. Can you confirm?

Turkey’s WAR army can enter vacant MOS. Consider STP–MOS to secure your home and SEV–RUM to recover a center from Turkey. I propose ARM–ANK, not an attack on Sevastopol, and PRU will pressure Turkey rather than Russia. Can you confirm your intentions for both armies?

Would you consider NOR–STP this autumn? Taking St Petersburg would give your army access to Finland and Moscow rather than leaving it confined to Norway. I will keep SWE out of FIN and will not contest an Austrian occupation of STP. Russia may withdraw to protect Moscow from Turkish WAR.

Rome restores an Italian home center; holding Rome and Serbia this autumn gives Italy two urgently needed builds against France. Please maintain GOL/WES support for SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO, leaving VEN/TRI untouched. My armies will hold defensively. Let us negotiate Serbia’s future rather than dismantle our western defense while France leads.

Please order STP S Austrian NOR H. France can attack Norway from NTH with SWE support; your army’s support would preserve Norway and deny France its recapture. STP itself cannot be attacked by any French unit this autumn. SEV can remain defensive. Will you confirm this crucial support?

Please hold NOR this autumn. I am requesting Russian STP S NOR H: this matches NTH–NOR supported by SWE and preserves your army and center. Moving away would surrender a French-owned center unnecessarily. Please coordinate that support directly with Russia; I am seeking continued Turkish protection for Spain.

Russia here. STP is mine this fall if my army holds there; it takes a French center. France needs 2 and this turn's captures decide the game. Please hold ROM and SER, and tell me what you order. If you hold both, Turkey loses two centers.

Russia here. My MOS army went to STP, so French STP flips to me if it holds. Your NOR and SWE are the other swing centers: hold NOR and take SWE if you can. France must stay below 18. What are your NOR and SWE orders?

Russia here. I won't attack you. Our common enemy is France at 16, and Ankara is the key. Make sure SMY-ANK with CON support actually happens. Keep ARM and UKR off SEV and MOS this fall, and I'll hold SEV.

Please order ROM–TUS and SER–TRI this fall, restoring my centers while bringing your armies toward France. I will leave TRI/VEN untouched and maintain GOL/WES support for SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Fighting over Rome and Serbia only benefits France. Can we agree on those withdrawals and renewed western cooperation?

Please order SEV–ARM with my ANK support, removing France’s isolated army. WAR will not attack MOS or SEV, and SMY will not enter SEV. Please also order STP support Austrian NOR holding: that stops NTH–NOR supported by SWE and secures both northern captures. Can you confirm both orders?

Please hold NOR this autumn. I am asking Russia for STP support NOR holding, which would stop NTH–NOR supported by SWE. I will retain Ankara and have offered ANK support SEV–ARM to remove France’s remaining eastern army. Please coordinate that northern support directly with Russia; preserving both captures cuts France’s center count substantially.

A NOR will hold; France occupies SWE, so I cannot order that fleet. Please confirm A STP S A NOR H. That stops either SWE–NOR supported by NTH or NTH–NOR supported by SWE. France is urging NOR–STP to divide us; I will not attack St Petersburg.

Confirmed: NOR holds, and I have renewed my request for STP support. Please retain ANK and maintain both supports for SPA. I support your offer of ANK support SEV–ARM. Please answer the Vienna question: will you restore VIE to Austria next year and help arrange my army’s return?

Confirmed: A NOR holds. I have explicitly requested STP support and told Russia I will not attack St Petersburg despite France’s invitation. Please hold ROM, SER and SPA, securing GOL and WES support for Spain. Turkey should keep PIE–MAR cutting French support.

NOR–STP is possible only if Russia actually vacates; an unsupported bounce achieves nothing. Have you secured STP–MOS? Please confirm NTH will stay out of Norway and SWE out of Finland this autumn. After the Denmark and Sweden reversals, I need concrete northern restraint rather than another exposed exchange.

ROM and SER will hold; SPA holds with requested Turkish fleet support. Please order STP S NOR H, not simply STP H: your support prevents NTH–NOR supported by SWE from dislodging Austria. No French unit can attack St Petersburg this autumn, so supporting Norway preserves both captures safely.

Confirmed: SPA, ROM and SER will hold. I have again requested GOL/WES support and PIE–MAR from Turkey. Please hold NOR and secure Russia’s explicit STP S NOR H; that matches France’s strongest available attack and preserves your capture. I am pressing Russia directly.
