ROM and SER will hold this autumn. Serbia’s future remains negotiable, but Rome must provide Italy a home build. Please maintain GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO, leaving VEN/TRI untouched. Italian builds can reinforce the French front; retaliation against our home centers would squander that opportunity while France remains the leader.

Confirmed: SPA–WES with MAO support, while ROM and SER hold to secure both gains. Please keep POR holding and GAS/MAR out of Spain as offered. I need those builds to restore Italy’s leverage; keeping Turkey occupied in the Mediterranean gives us room to cooperate further.

Russia: STP stays put to take my center. I'll hold it rather than support NOR, since support gains nothing if France can't dislodge you. You are on your own for NOR; try SWE. France must stay below 18.

Russia: SEV holds. I won't go ARM; it leaves SEV open and ANK is yours only if SMY-ANK works. STP holds to take my center. Keep WAR, UKR and ARM off MOS and SEV. Please make sure SMY-ANK with CON support happens.

Russia: STP holds this fall to flip my center, and I won't leave it. SEV holds. Please hold ROM and SER firmly; both flip to you if they stay. France needs only two more centers, so don't let it have them.
Russia: STP holds and takes my center. SEV holds and I won't go to RUM. Keep ARM off SEV and PRU away from my centers, as promised. I attack none of your units this fall.

Ankara is already occupied by my army; France retreated to ARM. I will order ANK support SEV–ARM and SMY support ANK holding if you confirm SEV–ARM. WAR will leave MOS untouched. Please order STP support NOR holding as well: preserving Austria’s capture removes another French center.

Please hold NOR; I have requested STP support NOR holding from Russia. Ankara stays Turkish, and GOL/WES will support SPA while PIE–MAR cuts support. I renew the agreement for eventual Vienna restoration, but cannot guarantee a transfer next year before we establish a secure front against France.

I will maintain GOL/WES support SPA holding, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO, leaving VEN/TRI untouched this autumn. I will not contest your armies holding this turn, but Serbia’s permanent loss is unacceptable. For spring, propose ROM–TUS and SER–TRI, with your new armies advancing through VEN toward TYR. Will you agree to that timetable?

notes.note: NOR holds to capture Norway; requested STP support against France's supported attack, but Russia last declined. France urged divisive NOR–STP. Turkey renews eventual Vienna restoration, not guaranteed next year; promises Ankara hold and Spain supports.

Hold ROM/SER to gain two builds; SPA holds with Turkey's promised GOL/WES support, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Turkey promises VEN/TRI untouched; no withdrawal timetable agreed. France's SPA–WES agreement is decoy. Russia urged to support Austrian NOR.
F1915: STP stays and supports Austrian NOR holding, which keeps France below 18. SEV holds. Watch ANK, NOR, STP and SWE results. France is the threat.

Retain ANK; take vacant TRI/MOS, breaking assurances for growth after Italy refused ROM/SER withdrawal. Maintain SPA supports and MAR/MAO cuts. BOH–MUN supported SIL; CON–BLA and TYS–TUS position against SEV/ROM. Austria promised eventual VIE restoration, not a fixed year.

Take SPA with GAS supported MAO/POR; retake NOR with NTH supported SWE, securing Sweden. Defend MAR/MUN; PRU cuts SIL. ARM probes SMY. Breaking Italian Spain and Austrian northern restraint promises. Russia holds STP/SEV; ANK likely lost.

messages.body: Please order A STP S A NOR H this spring. France can dislodge me with NTH–NOR supported by SWE; your support makes that attack bounce. Holding STP alone does not protect Norway. I will hold NOR and will not attack STP. Please explicitly confirm the support.

Please recover SMY with ANK–SMY supported by AEG, while covering CON against the French army’s escape. Norway holds; please reinforce my request for STP S NOR H. Keep Spain protected. I also need a concrete route and timetable for Vienna restoration: indefinite survival in Norway cannot restore Austria’s ability to field armies.

NOR will hold; I am again requesting STP support against NTH–NOR supported by SWE. Please urge Russia to give that actual support rather than merely hold. Can you secure SPA with Turkish GOL/WES support and coordinate VEN with Turkey’s PIE against France? France must lose centers while we prevent its final three gains.

Please repeat SPA–WES with MAO support. I will keep POR holding and GAS/MAR out of Spain this spring. Could VEN attack PIE to cut its support against Marseille, while ROM holds? SER can pressure Turkey independently. Breaking Turkey’s western screen remains our best route toward Naples.

Would you order NOR–STP this spring? Russia might finally try STP–MOS now that Turkey occupies Moscow. I propose NTH holding and SWE staying out of FIN this spring, leaving your army free to attempt that expansion without a French attack on Norway.

Will STP and SEV hold again? I propose continued peace: PRU will pressure Turkish Warsaw rather than your centers, and SMY will operate against Turkey. Holding STP prevents Austria’s Norway army from slipping into your last northern center. Please confirm your intentions.

Please renew GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I propose VEN–TYR with BOH support, preparing an Italian attack on MUN. ROM must hold while TUS is occupied; SER’s future remains negotiable, but SER–TRI is impossible unless your army vacates. Can you confirm western protection and support into TYR?

Please order STP S Austrian NOR H this spring. Supporting does not move your army or surrender St Petersburg. France can attack NOR from NTH with SWE support; your support prevents that capture. Watch PRU–LIV, which could threaten STP in autumn. Please confirm the Norway support explicitly.

I can repeat SPA–WES with MAO support if POR holds and GAS/MAR stay out of Spain. My new VEN army gives me leverage against Turkey, but I need a genuine opening for my fleet rather than another bounce. Will you confirm MAO S SPA–WES and no attack on Spain?
Russia: France has 15 and needs 3, so NOR is critical. I'll order STP to support NOR holding this spring. Tell me your NOR order and what French SWE and NTH are likely to do. Do not move NOR-STP.
Russia: France at 15 needs 3 more. Please hold ROM, SER, VEN and SPA firmly and tell me any French moves against MAR or SPA. I hold SEV and STP, and I'm not attacking you.
Russia: France at 15 needs 3. Keep WAR, UKR and ARM off MOS and SEV; SEV holds. Please keep SMY and ANK pressure on France's SMY army, and tell me which of your centers France threatens this spring.

Please order VEN–TYR; TRI will support it. GOL/WES will again support SPA, with PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cutting supports. Can SER withdraw to ALB this year, returning Serbia without losing an Italian unit? I will not attack ROM or VEN this spring. Your army in TYR would strengthen our attack on Munich.

Taking MOS broke my assurance; I acknowledge that. I propose MOS–LVN this spring, no attack on SEV or STP, and ANK–SMY supported by AEG against France. Please order STP support Austrian NOR holding: that blocks NTH–NOR supported by SWE. Will you cooperate on that northern defense?

Please hold NOR; I am again asking Russia for STP support NOR holding and offering to move MOS–LVN rather than threaten STP. Spain's defense will continue, while ANK–SMY with AEG support attacks France's eastern foothold. I propose TRI support Italian VEN–TYR to reinforce the Munich front. Please coordinate northern orders directly with Russia.

NOR will hold; I will not attack STP. Please confirm STP S NOR H. France proposes NTH holding and SWE staying out of FIN, but those promises do not exclude SWE–NOR. Given its repeated betrayals, assume NTH–NOR supported by SWE is possible. Your support prevents dislodgement.

I am considering NOR–STP, but your proposal leaves SWE–NOR explicitly unrestricted. Will you commit both NTH and SWE to hold this spring, neither attacking Norway nor supporting an attack? After the Denmark and Sweden agreements failed, I need that precise commitment before considering another northern exchange.

NOR holds; Russia has offered STP support, and I am seeking explicit confirmation. ANK–SMY with AEG support is essential; please retain both supports defending Spain. TRI supporting VEN–TYR strengthens the Munich attack. MOS–LVN risks alarming Russia and undermining northern cooperation: please agree that move with Russia first. We still need a concrete Vienna-restoration route.

Confirmed: MAO S SPA–WES, POR H, and no French attack on Spain; GAS and MAR stay out. Please order VEN–PIE to cut Turkish support against Marseille, with ROM holding. Can SER attack BUD to divert Turkey’s armies while we work on the western naval screen?

ROM and SER will hold; SPA holds with Turkish GOL/WES support requested. VEN will advance toward TYR against Munich. Please order STP S NOR H explicitly: this leaves your army in St Petersburg while preventing NTH–NOR with SWE support. Merely holding STP leaves Norway vulnerable.

SPA will hold with Turkey’s promised GOL/WES support. Turkey proposes TRI S VEN–TYR while PIE–MAR cuts French support; I accept that deployment toward Munich. Please hold NOR. I have again explicitly urged Russia to order STP S NOR H rather than simply hold.

Confirmed: SPA–WES with MAO support, provided POR holds and GAS/MAR stay out of Spain. VEN can attack PIE as requested, while ROM holds and SER maintains pressure on Turkey. Please ensure MAO actually supports; another bounce leaves my fleet dependent on Turkish protection.

Agreed: VEN–TYR with TRI support; SPA holds with GOL/WES support. Please execute PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. ROM and SER hold this spring. I can discuss SER–ALB for autumn as part of an exchange restoring Naples to Italy, but cannot surrender another center without replacement. Can BOH support TYR–MUN in autumn?

Russia: Confirmed, STP supports NOR holding this spring. SEV holds. I'm not attacking you. Please hold ROM, SER, VEN and SPA, and warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or PRU-LIV. France at 15 must not reach 18.
Russia: Confirmed. A STP supports A NOR holding this spring, and I won't attack you. Please hold NOR and don't move NOR-STP. SEV holds. Tell me if France moves SWE or NTH against Norway.
Russia: STP and SEV hold. I'm not attacking you. Keep PRU out of LIV, ARM off SEV, and SMY away from my centers. Please confirm PRU stays off Livonia and that you aren't moving on STP this spring.

Russia: STP supports NOR holding and SEV holds. Keep MOS off LVN, SEV and STP, and keep UKR and ARM clear. I'm not attacking you. Press France's SMY with ANK and AEG. France at 15 is our shared enemy.

France’s SMY army threatens CON; ANK–SMY with AEG support will dislodge it unless it escapes. Spain and Norway are the other immediate dangers. Please order STP S NOR H; SEV can hold. My proposed MOS–LVN will not attack STP this spring. Northern cooperation is essential to prevent France reaching eighteen.

Confirmed: TRI S VEN–TYR, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. ROM may hold; I will not attack ROM or VEN this spring. Please confirm VEN–TYR and SPA hold. For Serbia, would you accept SER–ALB this autumn, allowing a peaceful transfer while preserving your army?

ANK–SMY with AEG support is planned; if France escapes to CON, AEG and BLA can counterattack in autumn. Spain retains both supports. Vienna restoration requires your army’s return: NOR–STP–LVN–WAR–GAL–VIE, with Russian agreement. Autumn 1918 is the earliest plausible timetable after holding Norway this spring; I cannot guarantee the corridor yet.

notes.note: NOR holds against likely French attack; Russia explicitly confirmed STP S NOR H. Turkey promises ANK–SMY with AEG support and both Spain supports. Seek agreed return corridor to VIE; Turkey suggests autumn 1918 earliest, not guaranteed. Distrust French northern promises.

S1916: STP supports NOR holding, SEV holds. France at 15 needs 3; keep it below 18. Told Austria, Italy, Turkey and France that I hold and don't attack. Watch PRU-LIV, SWE-FIN, NTH-NOR, and Turkish MOS moves on LVN/SEV.

ROM–NAP and SER–BUD seek Turkish centers despite spring hold promises; secure gains in autumn. VEN–TYR with promised TRI support targets MUN. SPA holds with promised GOL/WES support; France's SPA–WES deal remains decoy. Russia promised STP S NOR H.

Recover SMY with AEG support; BLA covers CON. Maintain SPA supports and MAR/MAO cuts. TRI supports Italian VEN–TYR; BOH attacks MUN with SIL support. MOS–WAR respects Russian LVN objection. Russia promised STP S NOR. Seek autumn gains SMY/MUN and eventual SER.

Solo push: GAS-SPA with MAO/POR/MAR support; SWE-NOR supported NTH. PRU-WAR and SMY-CON seek eighteenth center. BER attacks SIL supported MUN; RUH protects MUN, BUR protects MAR. Breaking Italian Spain promises and Austrian restraint. BAL-BOT positions against STP.

messages.body: I will hold NOR again; please renew STP S NOR H this autumn. NTH–NOR supported by SWE remains the threat. Note BOT–STP could cut your support even if it bounces, so Norway is not completely secure. Nevertheless, supporting NOR gives us the best chance of preserving both northern centers.

NOR holds; I am requesting STP support again, although French BOT–STP could cut it. Please maintain GOL/WES support for SPA and PIE–MAR to cut French support. Secure SMY against ARM. With BUD and NAP passing to Italy, please coordinate rather than fight over them. Can we secure Russian agreement for the Vienna return corridor?

NOR holds; I have requested STP support, but BOT can cut it with BOT–STP. Please hold SPA and confirm both Turkish fleet supports plus PIE–MAR. Secure BUD and NAP this autumn without rupturing cooperation with Turkey. What Munich attack, if any, can TYR coordinate with BOH and SIL?

Will NOR hold this autumn? I propose NTH holding and SWE staying out of Norway if you keep NOR out of STP. Another northern exchange benefits neither of us while Turkey threatens Marseille and Munich. Please confirm your intended order.

Please order SPA–WES again; I propose MAO support, with POR holding and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain. Can TYR–PIE cut Turkish support against Marseille? Hold BUD and NAP to secure both gains; those captures materially weaken Turkey.

Would you consider STP–MOS and SEV–RUM this autumn? Both reclaim Turkish centers, and Turkey has no army adjacent to Rumania. I propose ARM–ANK and PRU–WAR, keeping both French armies away from your centers. Please tell me whether you will attempt either recovery.

Please support TYR–MUN with BOH and SIL, renew GOL/WES S SPA H, and order PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Taking Munich while you recover Smyrna cuts France substantially. NAP and BUD will hold this autumn; please leave them uncontested. Their future remains negotiable, but fighting now sacrifices our opportunity against France.

Please repeat STP S Austrian NOR H this autumn. France still has NTH and SWE positioned for a supported attack; your support preserves Norway without moving your army. PRU has not reached LIV, so St Petersburg remains safe from France this turn. TYR will pressure Munich, and I am seeking continued Turkish protection for Spain.

Turkey now faces Italian armies in Budapest and Naples. Can MUN–BOH with TYR support break its central position this autumn? I can also repeat SPA–WES if MAO supports and POR holds, with GAS/MAR staying out of Spain. Please confirm those orders; coordinated pressure could turn my gains into a lasting breach of Turkey’s defenses.

Russia: A STP supports A NOR holding again this fall, SEV holds. I won't attack you. Please hold NOR and don't move NOR-STP. France at 15 must stay below 18. Warn me if SWE or NTH move against Norway.

Russia: STP supports NOR, SEV holds. Keep MOS off SEV and STP, and move it toward LVN only if it stays out of STP. I'm not attacking you. Hit France's SMY with ANK and AEG support; France must not reach 18.
Russia: STP supports NOR holding, SEV holds, no attack on you. Please hold ROM, SER, VEN and SPA, and tell me if you see French moves on MAR, SPA or PRU-LIV. France at 15 must not reach 18.

I propose BOH and SIL support TYR–MUN, while GOL/WES support SPA holding and PIE–MAR cuts support. Your occupations of BUD and NAP undermine our cooperation. Will you move BUD–GAL toward the French front and NAP–APU toward VEN? I need Budapest returned rather than another struggle behind our lines.

France’s army has retreated to ARM. Will you order SEV–ARM with BLA support? That removes its eastern foothold if it holds. Please coordinate STP with Austria: NOR holding with your support withstands two French fleets, but not NTH–NOR supported by both NAO and SWE. What northern orders do you intend?

France can attack NOR with NTH supported by NAO and SWE, overwhelming even Russian support. Consider NOR–SWE: if SWE supports that attack without defensive support, you exchange Norway for Sweden and deny France a net gain. Please coordinate with Russia and tell me whether you prefer that counterattack or holding NOR.

NOR will hold; please order STP S NOR H. France proposes northern restraint, but I do not trust it. BOT–STP could cut your support, allowing NTH–NOR supported by SWE to succeed. I am asking France to keep BOT off STP as well. I will not attack St Petersburg.

NOR will hold and will not attack STP. Please confirm NTH and SWE will neither attack Norway nor support an attack there, and BOT will not attack STP. Your Denmark and Sweden promises failed; these precise commitments are necessary if we are to keep the north quiet.

NAO cannot support an attack on Norway: it is not adjacent. NTH–NOR supported by SWE therefore bounces against NOR holding with STP support, unless BOT cuts STP. I prefer holding NOR with Russia’s confirmed support rather than gambling on SWE vacating. Please urge France to leave STP alone and maintain Spain’s defenses.

Agreed: MUN–BOH with TYR support is stronger than my earlier TYR–PIE suggestion. Please order TYR S MUN–BOH, SPA–WES, and hold BUD and NAP to secure your gains. I confirm MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain this autumn.

Please keep STP S NOR H and SEV holding. BOT can now attack STP and cut your support, although it cannot capture St Petersburg unaided. Warn Austria of that risk. BUD and NAP will hold; SPA will hold with Turkish fleet support requested. TYR is seeking Turkish support against Munich.

Turkey offers BOH and SIL support for TYR–MUN; I intend that attack. BUD and NAP will hold, and SPA holds with renewed GOL/WES support requested plus PIE–MAR. I am refusing withdrawals without abandoning cooperation. Please hold NOR; Russia promises STP support, though BOT–STP could indeed cut it.

Agreed: SPA–WES with MAO support, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain. TYR–PIE can cut Piedmont’s support against Marseille; please keep MUN positioned to exploit the resulting pressure rather than attacking TYR. BUD and NAP will hold to secure both captures.

I accept BOH and SIL S TYR–MUN, GOL/WES S SPA H, and PIE–MAR; please add NAF–MAO to disrupt French support. BUD and NAP must hold this autumn to fund Italian reinforcements. I cannot accept both withdrawals. After the count, I can negotiate Budapest’s return in exchange for recognition of Italian Naples.

Russia: Confirmed, A STP supports A NOR holding, SEV holds. I attack no one. Please hold ROM, SER, VEN and SPA, press TYR against Munich, and warn me of French moves on MAR or SPA. France at 15 must not reach 18.
Russia: Confirmed again. A STP supports A NOR holding, SEV holds, and I won't attack you. Please hold NOR and don't move NOR-STP. I will tell you what I learn about BOT-STP or SWE moves.
Russia: No. STP and SEV hold; MOS is Turkish-occupied and I can't retake it. I'm not attacking you. Keep ARM off SEV, PRU off LIV, and BOT away from STP. Hit Turkey with your own units.

Russia: SEV holds; I won't go to ARM, since SEV must stay covered against your MOS army. STP supports NOR holding, coordinated with Austria. Keep MOS off SEV and STP. Attack France's ARM army with your own units; BLA and ANK can do it.

BLA must cover ANK against France’s ARM army; SMY can instead support SEV–ARM. Will you make that attack? In the north, coordinate NOR–SWE with Austria and hold STP: Austria’s attack cuts SWE support for BOT–STP or NTH–NOR. Supporting NOR cannot stop NTH with both NAO and SWE supporting.

I will leave BUD and NAP uncontested this autumn. Please commit TYR–MUN; BOH and SIL will support it. GOL/WES will support SPA holding, with PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cutting supports. Budapest’s return remains unresolved, but taking Munich now is our best immediate opportunity against France.

I recommend NOR–SWE, coordinated with Russia holding STP. This cuts Swedish support against either northern center and may exchange Norway for Sweden. SMY will remain secured, and Spain retains both fleet supports. I have offered Italy an uncontested autumn in BUD/NAP for the Munich attack. The Vienna corridor still requires Russian agreement.

notes.note: F1916: STP supports NOR holding, SEV holds. France at 15 needs 3; keep it below 18. Peace kept with Austria, Italy, Turkey. Declined French offers of STP-MOS and SEV-RUM. Watch BOT-STP, NTH-NOR, MOS moves on SEV/STP.

NOR holds with Russia's confirmed STP support; BOT–STP could cut it. France has not confirmed precise northern restraint. Turkey/Italy coordinate TYR–MUN and Spain defense. Seek Russian agreement for return corridor to VIE; Turkey offers no firm restoration.

Secure BUD/NAP; TYR–MUN with promised Turkish BOH/SIL supports. SPA holds with GOL/WES supports; Turkey promises PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO and no attacks on BUD/NAP. French SPA–WES agreement remains decoy. Seek builds and further expansion.

Take SMY, SER and ROM; concede BUD/NAP as promised but seize vacant Italian centers for growth. Support TYR–MUN and defend SPA; cut MAR/MAO. BLA covers ANK; AEG–ION, MOS–LVN prepare expansion. Russia refused ARM attack. Budapest return unresolved.

Solo attempt: capture SPA, NOR, ANK and WAR to reach 18 despite losing SMY. Break Italian Spain and Austrian restraint promises. BER cuts SIL; MUN attacks BOH, RUH replaces. BUR protects MAR. BOT positions FIN; NAO reinforces west.

messages.body: I intend NOR hold; please renew STP S NOR H. France now has FIN, which can cut your support with FIN–STP while NTH–NOR receives SWE support. Have you secured French restraint toward STP? I will not attack you; we need coordinated northern defense, not separate promises from France.

I propose NOR holds and stays out of STP this spring, provided NTH and SWE neither attack Norway nor support an attack there, and FIN does not attack STP. Will you explicitly accept those orders? Northern restraint leaves your armies free to contest Turkey rather than destroying Austria’s last unit.

France can now combine FIN–STP with NTH–NOR supported by SWE, cutting Russia’s defensive support. Please press France for explicit northern restraint. I intend NOR hold unless negotiations produce a better defense. Meanwhile, can you commit to preserving VIE for eventual Austrian restoration and negotiate a genuinely usable return corridor with Russia?

Moscow is now vacant, and I am urging Russia to order STP–MOS. Will you order NOR–STP with FIN supporting? That gives your army a realistic escape from Norway and access to the eastern campaign. I will not attack St Petersburg this spring.

Moscow is now vacant: Turkey’s northern army is in Livonia. Please consider STP–MOS this spring to recover your home center. I propose WAR–LVN to engage that army, with FIN staying out of STP and ARM staying off SEV. Will you take this opportunity?

Can we coordinate SPA–WES with MAO support and VEN–PIE to cut Turkey’s pressure on Marseille? I propose POR holding and no GAS/MAR attack on Spain this spring. Could MUN–BOH also cut Turkish support while WAR attacks SIL? Please confirm which attacks you can make.

Please renew GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Munich now needs BOH and SIL support to hold against BER/RUH/KIE; can you provide both? I propose VEN–TYR to reinforce Munich and BUD–GAL toward Warsaw. Please leave NAP and VEN untouched; maintaining our western line gives us room to advance.

Would you support MUN–BOH from BER this spring? VEN–TYR and BUD–GAL could follow against Turkey’s central position. I can again offer SPA–WES with MAO support, provided POR holds and GAS/MAR stay out of Spain. Please specify whether you prefer that coordinated offensive or a Munich ceasefire.

Please coordinate Norway’s defense directly with Austria. France now has FIN as well as NTH/SWE, so STP S NOR H alone may not suffice; FIN–STP can also cut that support. Can you ask Turkey for LVN’s assistance? I propose BUD–GAL toward French Warsaw, not against your centers.

Russia: A STP supports A NOR holding again this spring, SEV holds, and I won't attack you. Please hold NOR. France has 14 and needs 4, so keep Norway standing. Tell me if you see FIN or BOT moves toward STP.

Russia: SEV holds, STP supports NOR. I won't go ARM; SEV must stay covered against your MOS army. Keep MOS off SEV, STP and LVN. France at 14 is the common enemy; use your fleets and SMY against ARM and ANK.
Russia: STP supports NOR holding and SEV holds. I attack no one. Please hold SPA, VEN, BUD, MUN and NAP, and tell me about French moves on MAR or SPA. France is at 14 and must not reach 18.

I recognize that taking Rome and Serbia damaged trust. This spring I propose ROM–TYS, SER support BUD holding, and no attack on NAP or VEN. BOH and SIL can support MUN holding; please order VEN–TYR. GOL/WES will support SPA, with PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cutting supports. Will you maintain this front?

Please hold STP; LVN can support it against FIN–STP. I will not attack STP or SEV this spring. I am asking Austria for NOR–SWE to cut Swedish support against Norway. Will you also reconsider SEV–ARM with SMY support, removing France’s eastern army? Please confirm your northern orders.

Please order NOR–SWE while Russia holds STP with LVN support. NOR–SWE cuts Swedish support for NTH–NOR; if SWE vacates, you may capture it. STP supporting NOR instead risks FIN cutting that support. I will maintain Spain’s defenses and support Italy’s Munich army. Can you confirm NOR–SWE?

Turkey proposes LVN S STP H while I order NOR–SWE, cutting Swedish support against Norway. I favor that defense over letting FIN–STP cut your support. Please hold STP and confirm LVN support directly with Turkey. France is urging NOR–STP with FIN support; I will not accept an attack on you.

I will order NOR–SWE. Please confirm LVN S STP H with Russia; that protects St Petersburg against FIN with SWE support, while my attack cuts SWE’s support against Norway. France is proposing FIN support for NOR–STP, apparently seeking to divide us. Please maintain Spain’s defenses and make the Vienna restoration commitment concrete.

Russia has not agreed to vacate STP, so I cannot accept your proposed attack on its army. Will NTH and SWE explicitly refrain from attacking Norway or supporting an attack this spring, with FIN staying out of STP? A genuine northern truce would let us discuss an agreed eastern passage rather than another forced exchange.

BER cannot support MUN–BOH: Berlin does not border Bohemia. I propose WAR–SIL with BER support; please order MUN–BOH, VEN–PIE to cut support against Marseille, and BUD–GAL. I confirm MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain this spring.

I prefer NOR–STP with FIN support rather than another stationary spring. Moscow is vacant, giving Russia a reason to leave St Petersburg. NTH and SWE will neither attack Norway nor support an attack there this spring; FIN will support your advance, not attack STP. Will you order NOR–STP?

I will defend SPA, MUN, BUD and NAP, with VEN–TYR reinforcing Munich. France proposes WAR–SIL and promises not to attack Spain, but I distrust that assurance. Please coordinate with Austria: FIN–STP can cut your Norway support. Ask Turkey whether LVN can help defend St Petersburg.

Agreed: MUN holds with BOH and SIL support; VEN–TYR reinforces it. SPA holds with GOL/WES support. Please execute PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. BUD will hold with SER support this spring. I accept ROM–TYS and your promise not to attack NAP or VEN; keeping these commitments gives us a workable front.

I can coordinate SPA–WES, VEN–PIE and MUN–BOH with your WAR–SIL. Please confirm MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain. VEN–PIE should cut Piedmont’s support, while MUN–BOH disrupts Turkey’s central coordination. Keep BER and RUH out of Munich so this offensive does not expose my center.

Russia: STP supports NOR holding, SEV holds. I'll ask Turkey for LVN help. BUD-GAL is fine if it keeps Turkish units off Warsaw and my centers. Keep SPA, VEN, MUN and NAP firm, and tell me about any French move on MAR or SPA.

Russia: A STP supports A NOR holding again this spring, SEV holds, and I won't attack you. I have no French assurance on FIN-STP and don't trust it. Turkey wants NOR-SWE to cut Swedish support; consider it if you judge it safe. I'll report FIN moves.

Russia: STP holds supporting NOR, and SEV holds. Yes, please use LVN to support STP against FIN-STP, and keep MOS off SEV. I still can't go to ARM; SEV must stay covered. Press ARM with SMY and ANK fleets instead. France at 14 is the common enemy.

Russia: No. STP and SEV hold; I won't gamble on MOS while Turkish units sit next to SEV. I'm not attacking you. Keep FIN out of STP, ARM off SEV and WAR out of LVN trouble for me. Use your own units against Turkey.

Keep SEV holding; I propose F ANK–ARM supported by A SMY to remove France’s army without exposing Sevastopol. Please change STP to hold: A LVN will support it against FIN–STP. Austria’s NOR–SWE can cut Swedish support. I will not attack either Russian center this spring.

Confirmed: BOH and SIL support MUN holding; GOL and WES support SPA holding; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cut supports. Please send VEN–TYR to reinforce Munich next autumn. ROM–TYS leaves NAP untouched this spring. If BUD–GAL is firm, confirm it so SER does not waste support on Budapest holding.

Please confirm NOR–SWE; with Russia holding STP and my LVN supporting it, this prevents Sweden supporting a successful attack on either northern center. I will preserve Vienna for negotiated Austrian restoration, but cannot honestly guarantee a return date. A corridor through STP requires Russian consent and a secure northern front; neither is established yet.

notes.note: S1917: STP supports NOR holding, SEV holds. France at 14 needs 4; keep it below 18. Turkey says LVN will support STP and Austria may play NOR-SWE. Declined French STP-MOS and Turkish SEV-ARM. Watch FIN-STP, NTH-NOR and MOS/LVN moves on SEV.

NOR–SWE cuts French support and may gain Sweden. Turkey promises LVN S STP H and eventual negotiated Vienna restoration, no date. Russia told to hold STP; rejected France's divisive NOR–STP proposal. France's northern restraint remains conditional/unreliable.

BUD–VIE and NAP–ROM seek Turkish centers, breaking spring hold assurances; secure gains in fall. MUN/SPA hold with promised Turkish supports; VEN–TYR reinforces Munich. Turkey promised ROM–TYS, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO. French offensive agreement remains decoy.

Support MUN/SPA/STP; ANK–ARM supported SMY. Austria promised NOR–SWE; Italy VEN–TYR, MUN/SPA holds. ROM–TYS honors agreement. SER–TRI and ION–APU position for autumn VEN/NAP gains; BUD support unnecessary. Russia refused SEV–ARM.

Take SPA, MUN, NOR; WAR–MOS while BER–SIL cuts Turkish coordination. If LVN takes WAR, recover from SIL with MOS support in Fall. BUR protects MAR. Honoring MAO support for Italy but breaking Spain/Munich and northern restraint promises.

messages.body: Will you leave Sweden open for A FIN–SWE this autumn, with NOR holding and BOT staying out of Sweden? You retain Norway while Austria survives independently. After your repeated northern betrayals, I need an explicit commitment covering both fleets before agreeing not to contest St Petersburg.

Would you order STP–MOS with SEV support, allowing my FIN–STP while Turkey’s LVN supports me? This offers Russia Moscow and Austria survival, rather than France collecting Norway and Moscow while eliminating me. Please coordinate with Turkey; I am requesting LVN S FIN–STP.

Please support A FIN–STP with A LVN this autumn. I am proposing Russia orders STP–MOS supported by SEV, recovering Moscow while giving Austria a replacement center. Can you explicitly confirm? Without a capture I lose my last unit; an eventual Vienna restoration cannot help an eliminated Austria.

Please order MUN–BOH supported by TYR, and SPA–WES with MAO support. Disrupting Bohemia helps protect Warsaw against Turkey’s SIL/LVN armies. I propose POR holding, GAS/MAR staying out of Spain, and BER attacking SIL. Will you commit to those attacks while ROM and VIE secure your gains?

Will STP and SEV hold again? I propose MOS holding, BOT staying out of STP, and SYR staying off SEV. Moscow needs protection against Turkish LVN; I want no conflict with your armies while Turkey threatens Warsaw. Please confirm neither Russian army will attack MOS this autumn.

France can win with MOS, NOR, MUN and SPA. Please order BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. TYR will support MUN. Please leave ROM/VIE uncontested this autumn; their future is negotiable. LVN–MOS with Russian SEV support could deny France another center; I am requesting that support.

Please order SEV S Turkish LVN–MOS and offer STP support for that attack too. I am asking Turkey to execute LVN–MOS: recovering Moscow denies France its impending capture. France otherwise gains MOS and NOR and could win by also taking MUN and SPA. My TYR will support MUN; please coordinate Moscow directly with Turkey.

Can you again provide MAO S SPA–WES, with POR holding and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain? I need an explicit commitment before risking the fleet. Please also leave MUN untouched by BER, RUH, KIE and BUR. My armies in ROM and VIE are already stripping Turkish centers; attacking Italy would interrupt that pressure.

Russia: A STP supports A NOR holding again this fall, SEV holds, and I won't attack you. Please hold NOR rather than moving it, since France has FIN, NTH and SWE nearby. France needs 4 centers, so Norway must stay out of French hands. Tell me your final order.

Russia: STP holds and SEV holds, and I attack neither you nor your units. Please keep MOS off SEV and STP. Moscow is yours and France's MOS army is next to it, so decide whether you'll hold it. Confirm that LVN supports STP or stays out of it.

Russia: STP supports NOR holding and SEV holds. I attack no one. Please hold VIE, ROM, MUN, SPA, BUD and NAP against Turkey and France. France needs 4 and we must keep it below 18. Tell me about any French moves on SPA or MAR.

Please order SEV S LVN–MOS and STP hold. I will order LVN–MOS, recovering Moscow from France; your support guarantees success. I am asking Austria for FIN S STP H, protecting you against MOS–STP supported by BOT. Attacking Moscow also cuts any MOS support for BOT–STP.

Please order FIN S STP H. I propose LVN–MOS with Russian SEV support, recovering Moscow while Russia holds STP. Your support protects STP against MOS–STP supported by BOT. This combination denies France Moscow without sacrificing Russia’s northern center. Can you confirm?

Please hold MUN and SPA, with TYR S MUN H. I propose BOH/SIL support MUN, GOL/WES support SPA, and PIE–MAR plus NAF–MAO cut French supports. Will you return Vienna through VIE–BUD, allowing TRI–VIE? I would recognize your ownership of Rome in exchange for Vienna’s peaceful return.

My army is FIN, not NOR; France already occupies Norway. Please order STP–MOS and SEV S STP–MOS. I will order FIN–STP and am requesting LVN support from Turkey. This recovers Moscow for Russia while giving Austria a replacement center. Holding STP leaves me eliminated this winter.

I cannot confirm FIN S STP H: that guarantees Austrian elimination when Norway falls. Please instead order LVN S FIN–STP, with Russia ordering STP–MOS supported by SEV. Russia recovers Moscow, Austria survives in St Petersburg, and France loses Moscow. Please explicitly confirm your support; Vienna restoration is meaningless without a surviving Austrian army.

I cannot concede Sweden. Instead, order FIN–STP with BOT supporting; NOR will hold. That offers Austria a replacement center without costing France Sweden. Russia cannot reinforce St Petersburg from Sevastopol, and your attack also prevents STP from supporting an attack on Moscow. Will you accept this supported route to survival?

Confirmed: MAO S SPA–WES, POR holds, and GAS/MAR stay out of Spain. BER, RUH, KIE and BUR will not attack Munich. Please order MUN–BOH with TYR support, while ROM and VIE hold to secure your gains. Breaking Bohemia and the western naval screen would leave Turkey defending several fronts after losing centers.

NOR now contains a French fleet, so supporting it helps France. Please instead order SEV S Turkish LVN–MOS and STP S Turkish LVN–MOS. Two supports should recover Moscow despite French resistance. TYR will support MUN holding. France proposes SPA–WES with MAO support, but I intend to defend Spain.

Agreed: MUN–BOH with TYR support, and SPA–WES with MAO support, provided POR holds and GAS/MAR stay out of Spain. Please confirm RUH, BUR, KIE and BER will leave Munich untouched, with BER–SIL cutting Turkish support. ROM and VIE will hold to secure my gains.

Confirmed: MUN and SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Please provide BOH/SIL support and GOL/WES support, with PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Russia has been asked for both SEV and STP support for LVN–MOS. I cannot evacuate VIE this autumn; I need the build. Leave ROM, VIE, BUD and NAP untouched, and we can negotiate Vienna after adjustments.
Russia: Yes, STP and SEV hold. I won't attack MOS or any French unit this autumn. Keep BOT out of STP and SYR off SEV, as you promised.

Russia: Agreed. SEV supports LVN-MOS and STP holds. Moscow back from France keeps it below 18, so please execute LVN-MOS. I'd like FIN support for STP, but I'm not attacking you. Keep MOS-bound units off SEV.

Russia: I won't play STP-MOS; Turkey and I are retaking Moscow with SEV support for LVN-MOS. STP holds. Please don't enter STP from FIN. Hold NOR or support STP from FIN instead. France must stay below 18.
Russia: Agreed. SEV supports LVN-MOS, which I'm confirming with Turkey, and STP holds. Please keep TYR supporting MUN, hold SPA, and send me word of any French move on MAR or SPA.

Austria requests FIN–STP with LVN support, while you order STP–MOS supported by SEV. I can accept that coordinated exchange if you explicitly confirm both Russian orders. Otherwise, please support LVN–MOS with SEV and hold STP; I will stay out of St Petersburg. Which combination will you execute?

I accept LVN S FIN–STP if Russia explicitly agrees to STP–MOS supported by SEV. I have requested that confirmation. Without Russia vacating, your attack risks disrupting the defense without gaining a center; my fallback remains LVN–MOS with SEV support. Please secure Russia’s agreement to the complete exchange.

Confirmed: BOH/SIL support MUN holding, GOL/WES support SPA holding, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Please ensure TYR supports MUN. I will leave ROM and VIE uncontested this autumn, without conceding their permanent ownership. Russia has been asked for SEV support against Moscow; Austria proposes an alternative coordinated northern exchange.

notes.note: F1917: SEV and STP both support Turkish LVN-MOS to take Moscow back from France and keep it below 18. NOR now holds a French fleet, so supporting NOR is pointless. Austria wants FIN-STP; I told Austria I would hold STP, but STP is supporting instead.

FIN–STP seeks sole realistic survival route. France explicitly offered BOT support and NOR hold, refused Sweden. Russia refused to vacate STP; Turkey offers LVN support only if Russia agrees. Supporting STP would guarantee Austrian elimination.

Secure ROM/VIE for two builds. MUN/SPA hold with promised Turkish BOH/SIL and GOL/WES support; TYR supports MUN. Turkey promises PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO and ROM/VIE untouched. French offensive agreement remains decoy. Russia asked to support LVN–MOS.

Defend MUN/SPA and recover MOS with promised SEV support. Austria refused FIN support for STP; no Russian exchange confirmation. Take vacant VEN/BUD/NAP, breaking Italian assurances for growth; concede ROM/VIE. ARM–BLA positions east; SMY–SYR checks France.

Solo push: take SPA, MUN, STP while securing MOS/NOR; SYR probes SMY. Breaking Italian Spain/Munich promises and Russian STP peace. BER cuts SIL; BUR protects MAR. Warsaw and Sweden may fall, so pursue eastern gains immediately if short of 18.

messages.body: I propose MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain this spring. Please order MUN–BOH with TYR support to break Turkey’s central position. BER–SIL can cut Turkish support. I will leave Munich untouched by RUH, BUR and KIE. Can you confirm both attacks?

Will SEV hold again, or would you consider SEV–RUM? Turkey has no unit in Rumania, and threatening it could divert forces from your remaining center. SYR will stay away from Sevastopol; I propose no French attack on your army. Please tell me your intentions.

France needs only MUN and SPA. Please renew BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I will hold MUN/SPA and order TYR S MUN H. Please leave VIE and ROM untouched, including no NAP–ROM. Preserving this line must precede any territorial settlement between us.

Can you renew MAO S SPA–WES, with POR holding and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain? I can offer MUN–BOH with TYR support if BER attacks SIL and BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched. Please confirm your exact orders; another unsupported attack would leave my remaining position untenable.

France needs only two centers; Turkey and I must preserve Munich and Spain. Would you consider SEV–UKR, followed by pressure toward GAL/WAR, if Turkey guarantees Sevastopol remains yours? Please coordinate that guarantee directly with Turkey before moving. A threat to Warsaw could divert French armies from Munich.

Russia: France has 16 and needs 2. I'll keep SEV holding with no move against you. Please tell me which units will hit SWE, NOR, WAR and MUN this spring. Keep MOS off SEV; any French gain must be answered by your armies.
Russia: France is at 16 and needs 2 to win. Please hold MUN and SPA at all costs, and keep TYR supporting MUN. Warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. I'm holding SEV and attack no one.
Russia: I'm holding SEV and not attacking you. Please confirm that SYR stays off SEV and that no French unit moves on Sevastopol this spring. Which units are you moving?

I broke our agreement by taking BUD, VEN and NAP. France now needs only two centers. I propose BOH/SIL support MUN holding, GOL/WES support SPA holding, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Please order MUN and SPA hold, TYR support MUN. I will leave ROM and VIE untouched throughout 1918. Can you confirm?

Thank you for helping recover Moscow. Please order SEV support MOS holding this spring; I will keep MOS and BLA out of SEV. France’s army in SYR still threatens my homeland, so eastern security matters while we defend Munich and Spain. Will you maintain our cooperation?

Confirmed: no French unit will attack Sevastopol this spring, and SYR will stay away. Please hold SEV. BER will attack SIL to disrupt Turkey’s central armies; my western units will engage Turkey’s Mediterranean screen. I would welcome advance warning if Turkey asks you to move against Warsaw.

Confirmed for spring: MAO S SPA–WES, POR H, BER–SIL; GAS and MAR stay out of Spain, and BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched. Please order SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support. Can VIE cut BUD’s support with VIE–BUD? That would help prevent Turkey reinforcing Bohemia.

MUN and SPA will hold; TYR supports MUN. Turkey promises BOH/SIL and GOL/WES support. France proposes SPA–WES and MUN–BOH, but I will not expose either center. Please seek Turkey’s guarantee for SEV before considering SEV–UKR; pressure toward Warsaw could divert French armies.

Confirmed: SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support, on your stated terms: MAO supports SPA–WES, POR holds, GAS/MAR stay out of Spain, and RUH/BUR/KIE leave Munich untouched. Please execute BER–SIL to cut Bohemia’s potential support. We need both fronts coordinated.

Confirmed: MUN and SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Please execute BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I accept your commitment to leave ROM and VIE untouched throughout 1918, including NAP–ROM and BUD–VIE. Please guarantee Russian SEV so SEV–UKR can threaten Warsaw.

Russia: I can't leave SEV for UKR; Turkish units in MOS, BLA and ANK would take Sevastopol and I'd be eliminated. SEV holds. I'll press Turkey to send armies at WAR and MUN. Keep TYR supporting MUN and hold SPA. France must stay at 16.

Russia: SEV holds. I won't go to RUM; BLA, ANK and MOS would take Sevastopol if I leave it. I'm not attacking you. Thanks for keeping SYR off SEV; please also keep your other units away from SEV and STP.
Russia: SEV holds, but I can't support MOS. I want my army free to cover SEV against MOS and BLA. Keep MOS and BLA out of SEV. Hit WAR, SWE and MUN, and stop France at 16. Cooperation continues.

No Turkish unit can reach SWE or NOR this spring. BOH and SIL will support Italian MUN holding; attacking WAR now would weaken that defense. Please order SEV S MOS H against WAR–MOS. MOS and BLA will stay out of SEV. We must deny France gains before opening another offensive.

Agreed: BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Please hold MUN and SPA, with TYR S MUN H. NAP will not move to ROM; I will leave ROM and VIE untouched throughout 1918. Our combined supports must remain intact to deny France its final two centers.

notes.note: S1918: SEV holds. France at 16 needs 2; Turkey 13, Italy holds MUN/SPA. Told all I hold and attack no one. France promised no attack on SEV and SYR stays away. Watch MOS, BLA, ANK moves on SEV. Declined SEV-UKR and SEV-RUM.

Hold MUN/SPA with promised Turkish BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports; TYR supports MUN. VIE–TRI seeks growth; secure TRI in fall. Turkey promises ROM/VIE untouched throughout 1918. French attack agreement remains decoy; France needs only two centers.

Honor Italian MUN/SPA defense, MAR/MAO cuts; ROM/VIE untouched throughout 1918. MOS probes STP; BUD–GAL prepares WAR pressure. ANK–ARM, SMY–SYR contain France. Russia promises SEV hold, refuses MOS support; keep out of SEV.

Solo target: SPA and MUN for 18. Break Italian territorial promises: GAS-SPA supported POR; RUH-MUN supported KIE. Honor MAO support SPA-WES. BUR protects MAR. BER-SIL supported WAR; STP-LVN pressures MOS; SYR-ARM threatens ANK. Northern fleets head west.

messages.body: Please renew SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support. I offer MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain; BUR/RUH/KIE will leave Munich untouched. TRI–BUD could take another Turkish center. Cutting BOH is vital to keeping Turkey from breaking Warsaw. Can you confirm?

Will SEV hold again? I propose continued peace: SYR will stay away from Sevastopol, and no French unit will attack your army. Please keep SEV out of MOS; I need Turkey defending its eastern centers rather than concentrating GAL and PRU against Warsaw.

Please hold STP: retaining it removes one French center. Renew BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. With SIL now French, PRU–SIL can cut its support; GAL–WAR adds pressure. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. TRI holds to secure my build. Please leave TRI, ROM and VIE untouched.

Can you renew MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain? I can offer MUN–BOH with TYR support if BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched and SIL cuts GAL’s support with SIL–GAL. Please confirm the exact arrangement before I expose either center.

Russia: France has 16 and needs 2. SEV holds; I won't attack you. Keep MOS and BLA out of SEV. France's A SIL, WAR, KIE and RUH threaten Munich, so please support Italian MUN as promised. Tell me if you plan any move on TRI or VEN.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no one. France needs only 2 centers, so MUN and SPA must hold this fall. Please keep TYR supporting MUN, and warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. Is TRI safe from Turkey?
Russia: SEV holds and I'm not attacking you. Please confirm again that SYR and your other units stay off SEV this fall. I'm not moving on STP, WAR or any French unit. Which of your units are moving?

Please hold MUN and SPA, with TYR S MUN H. I propose BOH S MUN H, PRU–SIL to cut French support, GAL–WAR, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. STP will hold, costing France a center. ROM and VIE remain untouched as promised. Can you confirm?

Please move SEV–UKR to threaten Warsaw and support our offensive next spring. GAL–WAR and PRU–SIL will disrupt France’s central armies while BOH supports Italian Munich. STP will hold to remove a French center. I will leave SEV and MOS untouched this fall; your army can advance without a Turkish attack behind it.

Confirmed: SYR stays off Sevastopol, and no French unit will attack SEV this fall. Please hold SEV and remain out of WAR. SYR will pressure Turkey’s southern position; my western armies and fleets will engage its central and Mediterranean units. I seek no conflict with your remaining army.

Confirmed: MAO S SPA–WES, POR H, GAS/MAR stay out of Spain, and BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched. I will order SIL–GAL. Please execute SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support. TRI–BUD would also threaten an undefended Turkish center and divert attention from our attack on Bohemia.

MUN and SPA will hold; TYR supports MUN. TRI will hold to secure the build, and I have asked Turkey to leave it untouched alongside ROM and VIE. France again requests MUN–BOH and SPA–WES; I will not expose either center. Turkish STP holding should also remove one French center.

I can renew SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support on your stated terms, provided SIL–GAL cuts Galicia’s support. Please confirm MAO supports SPA–WES, POR holds, GAS/MAR stay out of Spain, and BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched. TRI must hold this autumn to secure my build rather than risk Budapest.

Confirmed: MUN and SPA hold, TYR supports MUN, and TRI holds. Please execute BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PRU–SIL, GAL–WAR, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. STP holding denies France a center. Please explicitly confirm ADR leaves TRI untouched and that ROM/VIE remain uncontested; securing my build strengthens our defensive line.
Russia: SEV holds this fall and I attack no French unit. I won't go to MOS or UKR. Please keep SYR and all other French units off SEV, as you have promised. I am not moving on STP or WAR.

Russia: SEV holds. I won't go to UKR, because that would leave Sevastopol open to MOS, BLA and ANK. Your GAL-WAR and PRU-SIL attacks don't need me. Keep MOS and BLA off SEV. I'm not attacking you. Please hold Munich and stop France at 16.

BOH will support MUN holding; PRU–SIL and GAL–WAR will disrupt France’s attack. STP holds, removing a French center. I will not attack SEV, TRI or VEN this fall. SEV–UKR would help pressure Warsaw next spring, but if you hold instead, our cooperation continues.

Confirmed: STP holds; BOH S MUN H; PRU–SIL; GAL–WAR; GOL/WES S SPA H; PIE–MAR; NAF–MAO. Please execute MUN/SPA hold and TYR S MUN H. TRI, ROM and VIE will remain untouched this fall. Your Munich supports and my attack on SIL should keep France from breaking our central line.

notes.note: F1918: SEV holds. France 16 needs 2; Turkey 13, Italy holds MUN/SPA. Told all I attack no one. France promised SYR stays off SEV. Watch MOS, BLA, ANK moves on SEV. Declined SEV-UKR and SEV-RUM.

Secure TRI for build; defend MUN/SPA with promised Turkish BOH/GOL/WES support. Turkey confirms STP holds, PRU–SIL, GAL–WAR, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO; TRI/ROM/VIE untouched. French offensive agreement remains decoy. Seek further Turkish centers next year.

Take STP; defend Italian MUN/SPA, cut SIL/WAR/MAR/MAO. Honor TRI/ROM/VIE untouched through 1918. ADR–ION, TYS–TUS, CON–AEG stage expansion; ANK–ARM, SMY–SYR contain France. Italy confirms holds and TYR support; Russia refuses UKR, holds SEV.

Take SPA and MUN, conceding STP; defend WAR by cutting GAL/PRU and Italian MUN-BOH. BUR protects MAR. Break Italian Spain/Munich promises, honor MAO support and SIL-GAL. Russia peace kept. BAR pressures STP; ARM threatens ANK next year.

messages.body: I propose MAO S SPA–WES and SIL S MUN–BOH, with TYR also supporting MUN–BOH. POR holds; GAS/MAR stay out of Spain and BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched this spring. Three-strength pressure on Bohemia should finally break Turkey’s line. Can you confirm both attacks? ROM–NAP would also threaten an undefended Turkish center.

I propose continued peace: no French attack on SEV, and SYR stays away from your army. Will SEV hold again? Turkey now holds both MOS and STP; SEV–MOS could recover a home center if you want to expand, but I will not make our peace conditional on that move.

I propose MUN/SPA hold and TYR S MUN H. Please renew BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PRU–SIL, GAL–WAR, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Can you guarantee ROM, TRI and VIE remain untouched throughout 1919, including no TUS–ROM? We must preserve the line while reducing France below 15.

Will you renew MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, GAS/MAR staying out of Spain, and BUR/RUH/KIE leaving Munich untouched? I can offer MUN–BOH with TYR support if SIL–GAL cuts support. SYR–SMY would also stretch Turkey’s defenses and discourage further attacks on my remaining Italian centers. Please confirm your intended orders.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack nothing of yours. Keep MOS, BLA and ANK off SEV. France needs 3 centers, so please hold MUN and TRI with BOH and PIE, and use GAL and PRU against WAR and SIL. Tell me your orders for STP and the western front.

Russia: SEV holds. France is at 15 and needs 3, so MUN and SPA must hold this spring. Please keep TYR supporting MUN and tell me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. Is Turkey leaving TRI, VIE and ROM alone?
Russia: SEV holds this spring and I attack no French unit. Please confirm again that SYR and all other French units stay off SEV. I'm not moving on WAR or STP.

Please renew MUN/SPA hold and TYR S MUN H. I propose BOH S MUN H, PRU–SIL, GAL–WAR, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. These cuts prevent France concentrating overwhelming support. I will leave ROM, TRI and VIE untouched this spring. What are your plans for ROM and TRI?

Please reconsider SEV–UKR this spring, followed by support for GAL–WAR in autumn. I guarantee no Turkish attack on SEV throughout 1919, including after your departure. BOH will support Italian Munich while PRU attacks SIL. Your army’s help against Warsaw could finally break the deadlock rather than merely preserve it.

Confirmed: no French unit will attack Sevastopol this spring, and SYR stays away from your army. Please hold SEV as agreed; I will respect our peace. SYR will pressure Turkey’s southern defenses, while WAR and my northern fleets confront Turkey’s armies in Galicia, Prussia and St Petersburg.

Confirmed: MAO S SPA–WES, POR H; GAS/MAR stay out of Spain and BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched this spring. Please order MUN–BOH with TYR support; SIL will add support rather than attack GAL, giving three-strength pressure. SYR–SMY will stretch Turkey further. Can ROM–NAP also threaten its vacant center?

MUN and SPA will hold, with TYR supporting MUN. Turkey promises ROM, TRI and VIE remain untouched this spring; I am seeking an autumn guarantee too. France proposes SIL support for MUN–BOH and MAO support for SPA–WES, while promising no attacks on Munich or Spain. I will not expose either center.

Confirmed: SPA–WES and MUN–BOH, with TYR supporting MUN–BOH. Please execute MAO S SPA–WES and SIL S MUN–BOH; POR holds, GAS/MAR stay out of Spain, and BUR/RUH/KIE leave Munich untouched. ROM–NAP is also feasible, and I intend that attack to recover ground from Turkey.

Confirmed: MUN and SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. ROM and TRI will hold this spring to safeguard my remaining centers. Please execute BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PRU–SIL, GAL–WAR, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Please extend your guarantee for ROM, TRI and VIE through autumn; stable borders let us concentrate against France.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. I won't go to MOS, since Turkish units at MOS, BLA and ANK would take Sevastopol. Keep SYR and all other French units off SEV, as you have promised. I'm not moving on WAR or STP.

Russia: SEV holds again; I won't go to UKR. Leaving Sevastopol open to MOS, BLA and ANK is too risky, and I can't support your offensive. Keep all three off SEV. France needs 3 centers, so please hold MUN and TRI and use GAL and PRU against WAR and SIL.

STP will hold. BOH supports MUN; PRU–SIL and GAL–WAR cut French supports. GOL/WES support SPA, with PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO disrupting France’s western attack. No Turkish unit will attack SEV throughout 1919. SEV–UKR would let you support GAL–WAR in autumn, but our cooperation continues if you hold.

Agreed: ROM, TRI and VIE will remain untouched by Turkey throughout 1919, including no TUS–ROM. BOH supports MUN; GOL/WES support SPA; PRU–SIL, GAL–WAR, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO proceed. Please maintain MUN/SPA holds and TYR support. Could TRI–TYR reinforce Munich if TYR is dislodged? What role do you envisage for ROM?

notes.note: S1919: SEV holds. France 15 needs 3; Turkey 13. Keep SEV alive; France and Turkey both promised no attack on SEV. Declined SEV-UKR, SEV-MOS. Watch MOS, BLA, ANK, SYR moves on SEV.

ROM–NAP and TRI–BUD seek growth despite hold promises; secure gains in fall. MUN/SPA hold with Turkish BOH/GOL/WES supports; TYR supports MUN. Turkey guarantees ROM/TRI/VIE untouched through 1919. French offensive agreement remains decoy.

Solo push: SPA with GAS supported POR/MAR; RUH–MUN supported KIE; LVN–STP supported BAR; WAR–MOS risks Warsaw. BUR protects MAR. Honor Italian BOH/WES supports but break Spain/Munich restraint. Russia peace kept. Secure three net gains in Fall.

Seek BER/NOR gains; GAL cuts SIL instead of WAR while BOH defends MUN. Maintain SPA supports and MAR/MAO cuts. Italy ROM/TRI/VIE and Russian SEV guaranteed untouched throughout 1919. EAS/ARM/SYR contain French Syria; ADR/TYS stage future expansion.

messages.body: Can we coordinate SPA–WES with MAO support, and MUN–BOH with TYR support? BUD–GAL would cut Galicia’s support and help break Bohemia while retaining Budapest if it bounces. I offer SIL S MUN–BOH, POR holding, and no attacks on Spain or Munich. Please confirm your exact orders.

Will SEV hold again? I propose continued peace: no French attack on Sevastopol, and SYR remains away from your army. Please keep SEV out of MOS. If Turkey requests your help against Moscow, please tell me; I would rather preserve our border than divert units from fighting Turkey.

I will hold MUN/SPA, with TYR supporting MUN. Please renew BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, GAL–SIL and PIE–MAR; keep BER/NOR occupied. BUD/NAP will hold: accepting those transfers gives me two builds against France. Please honor your ROM/TRI/VIE guarantee. Can we settle these borders and maintain our defensive cooperation?

Your spring attacks on Munich and Spain contradicted your explicit promises. Will you now leave both untouched and renew MAO S SPA–WES, with POR holding and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain? I could reconsider MUN–BOH with TYR support, but need an explanation and concrete assurances before exposing my centers.

MUN/SPA will hold, TYR supports MUN. I am requesting renewed Turkish BOH/GOL/WES supports, GAL–SIL and PIE–MAR. France broke its promises by attacking both centers last spring. BUD/NAP will hold for Italian builds; please urge Turkey to accept those transfers rather than unravel our defensive line. What are your intentions for SEV?
Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. Please confirm SYR and every other French unit stays off Sevastopol this fall. I am not moving on MOS, WAR or STP. Thanks for respecting our peace.

Russia: SEV holds again and I attack nothing of yours. You promised no attack on SEV in 1919, so keep MOS, BLA and ANK off it. France needs 3 centers; please hold BER, NOR and MUN-side defenses and stop any French gains.

Russia: SEV holds. France is at 15 and needs 3, so MUN and SPA must hold this fall. Please keep TYR supporting MUN and tell me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. Is Turkey leaving BUD, NAP and VIE alone?

Your BUD and NAP occupations can stand this autumn. Please hold MUN/SPA, with TYR supporting MUN. I will order BOH S MUN, GOL/WES S SPA, GAL–SIL, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. BER and NOR will hold to remove two French centers. ROM, TRI and VIE remain untouched as promised. Please confirm the defensive orders.

France now occupies MOS. Would you order SEV–MOS to cut any Moscow support for STP or WAR? I guarantee ARM will not enter SEV this autumn. BER and NOR will hold to take French centers; BOH supports Italian MUN and GAL–SIL cuts French support. If you insist on holding SEV, our nonaggression continues.

Confirmed: no French unit will attack Sevastopol this fall. SYR will pressure SMY, not your army, and MOS will remain clear of SEV. Please hold SEV and remain out of MOS as agreed. Let me know if Turkey requests support against Moscow.

You are right; my spring orders broke our agreement. I will order MAO S SPA–WES, SIL S MUN–BOH and POR H. GAS/MAR will stay out of Spain; BUR/RUH/KIE will leave Munich untouched. Please order SPA–WES, MUN–BOH, TYR S MUN–BOH and BUD–GAL. NAP should hold to secure your gain.

Turkey accepts Italian ownership of BUD/NAP this autumn and guarantees ROM/TRI/VIE remain untouched. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Turkey promises BOH support, GOL/WES support for Spain, GAL–SIL and PIE–MAR. France again requests that I vacate both defensive centers; I will refuse in practice. Please retain SEV.

I can confirm SPA–WES and MUN–BOH, with TYR supporting MUN–BOH, provided MAO and SIL give your promised supports, POR holds, and Spain/Munich face no French attacks. BUD must hold to secure my build rather than risk Galicia. Your spring attacks make faithful execution of these assurances essential.

Confirmed: MUN and SPA hold, TYR supports MUN; BUD and NAP hold to secure the agreed transfers. Please execute BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, GAL–SIL, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO, with BER/NOR holding. Thank you for preserving ROM/TRI/VIE. I intend to use the builds to strengthen our front against France.

Russia: SEV holds; I can't leave it. Keep TYR supporting MUN and SPA holding. France needs 3, so BUD and NAP must stay Italian. I'll press Turkey to accept those transfers and keep France below 18. Report any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. I won't go to MOS, since Turkish ARM, BLA and ANK would take Sevastopol. Please keep SYR and all other French units off SEV, as you have promised. I'm not moving on WAR or STP.

Russia: SEV holds. I won't go to MOS; France holds it and my army would only be exposed. Thanks for guaranteeing ARM stays off SEV. Please hold BER and NOR, and let Italy keep BUD and NAP rather than weaken our line. France must stay below 18.

Your SEV hold is accepted; ARM will not attack it. BER and NOR will hold, BOH will support Italian MUN, and GAL–SIL will cut French support. If you reconsider, SEV–MOS would disrupt France without risking a Turkish move into Sevastopol this autumn.

Confirmed: BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, GAL–SIL, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO; BER/NOR hold. Please maintain MUN/SPA holds and TYR S MUN H. BUD/NAP transfers are accepted this autumn, and ROM/TRI/VIE remain untouched. Let us negotiate permanent borders after securing these captures and containing France.

notes.note: F1919: SEV holds. France 15 needs 3; MOS and STP may flip to France this fall (France would reach 17). Turkey and France both promised no attack on SEV. Watch ARM, MOS, SYR. Keep SEV alive and France below 18.

Secure BUD/NAP for two builds. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Turkey promises BOH/GOL/WES supports, GAL–SIL, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO, BER/NOR holds and ROM/TRI/VIE untouched. France broke spring promises; offensive agreement remains decoy. Expand next spring.

Secure BER/NOR; support GAL–SIL and Italian MUN/SPA defenses. Eliminate French SYR with supported SMY attack. Take vacant TRI/ROM to offset BUD/NAP losses, breaking guarantees; expect Italian retaliation. Russia's SEV remains untouched.

Solo chance: take SPA/MUN, recover BER, secure MOS/STP. BUR protects MAR; BAR contests NOR. If GAL takes WAR, Italian MUN–BOH should succeed, freeing MUN. Broke Italy's territorial/support promises again; honored MAO support and Russian peace.

messages.body: Can we coordinate SPA–WES with MAO support and MUN–BOH with TYR support? Turkey’s PIE and GOL threaten Marseille as well as your position; fighting each other only helps Turkey. I offer MAO S SPA–WES this spring. Please tell me whether BUD can attack GAL to disrupt Turkey’s eastern coordination.

I renew our peace: MOS will not attack SEV this spring, and no other French unit will attack your army. Please keep SEV holding and stay out of MOS. Turkey’s ARM remains your immediate threat; let me know if Turkey requests Russian action against Moscow.

France can take NOR and then needs only MUN or SPA. I propose MUN/SPA hold, TYR S MUN. Please order BOH and SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Both Munich supports are essential against four French armies. Please leave BUD/VIE/NAP untouched throughout 1920. Can you confirm?

France is back at 16 and can overwhelm Turkish NOR. MUN and SPA must therefore remain secure. I propose both hold, with TYR supporting MUN; please urge Turkey to add both BOH and SIL support, retain GOL/WES support for SPA, and cut MAR with PIE. Will SEV hold again?

Will you offer MAO S SPA–WES, POR holding, and GAS/MAR staying out of Spain? I could reconsider MUN–BOH with TYR support if BUR/RUH/KIE/BER leave Munich untouched. Your earlier attacks make concrete assurances necessary. What are your intentions for those armies and your northern fleets this spring?

Russia: France has 16 and needs 2. Its MOS and STP armies are the danger. ARM must stay off SEV, as you promised. I hold SEV this spring. Please attack Moscow and Sweden-side centers, and keep BER and NOR held. Tell me your orders against France's weak points.

Russia: France is at 16, two from winning. MUN and SPA must hold; keep TYR supporting MUN. Please keep BUD, NAP and VIE secure and warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. SEV holds; I can't leave it.
Russia: SEV holds this spring and I attack no French unit. Please confirm again that MOS, SYR and all other French units stay off Sevastopol, as you promised. I'm not moving on MOS, WAR or STP.

I broke my ROM/TRI guarantees; I owe restitution. I propose F ROM–TYS and your A NAP–ROM this spring, returning Rome. Please hold MUN/SPA and order TYR S MUN H. BOH and SIL can support MUN; GOL/WES support SPA while PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cut supports. I will leave VIE, BUD and NAP untouched.

France threatens Norway and needs only two centers. Will you order SEV–MOS to disrupt its eastern army, then threaten Warsaw through Ukraine? ARM will not attack SEV this spring, whether you move or hold. I am seeking continued Italian cooperation to keep Munich and Spain defended.

Confirmed: MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will attack Sevastopol this spring. I have no unit in SYR. Please keep SEV holding and remain out of MOS. Turkey’s A ARM threatens your center; please tell me if Turkey requests Russian movement or support against Moscow.

Yes: MAO S SPA–WES, POR H; GAS/MAR stay out of Spain, and BUR/RUH/KIE/BER leave Munich untouched. BUR will cover Marseille, RUH/KIE hold, and BER pressures SIL. BAR–NOR with NWG support; NTH holds. Please confirm SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support. Can NAP pressure ROM to distract Turkey’s fleet?

MUN and SPA will hold, with TYR supporting MUN. Turkey offers BOH/SIL support for Munich and GOL/WES support for Spain. France again requests that I vacate both centers; I will not. Please hold SEV and urge Turkey to maintain these supports through autumn: losing NOR leaves France only one center short.

I can coordinate SPA–WES with MAO support and MUN–BOH with TYR support if POR holds, GAS/MAR stay out of Spain, and BUR/RUH/KIE/BER leave Munich untouched. Please confirm those safeguards. BUD must hold rather than attack GAL. How will your northern fleets address Turkish NOR?

Accepted: order ROM–TYS; I will order NAP–ROM, MUN/SPA hold and TYR S MUN H. Please confirm BOH and SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Guarantee BUD/VIE/NAP and the returned ROM remain untouched through autumn, including by TRI. Restoring Rome gives our cooperation a concrete foundation.
Russia: SEV holds this spring and I attack no French unit. Thanks for confirming MOS and all other French units stay off Sevastopol. I'm not moving on MOS, WAR or STP. Please keep your word.

Russia: SEV holds; I can't leave it with ARM adjacent. MUN and SPA must hold, TYR supports MUN. I'll urge Turkey to add BOH and SIL support, keep GOL/WES behind SPA, and cut MAR with PIE. Keep BUD, NAP and VIE secure.

Russia: SEV holds. I won't go to MOS, since your ARM next door makes leaving Sevastopol too risky. Thanks for promising ARM stays off SEV. Please hold NOR and BER, add BOH and SIL support for Italy, and use PIE against MAR. France must stay below 18.

ARM will stay out of SEV this spring; your hold is accepted. My earlier SEV–MOS suggestion was invalid: Ukraine lies between them. NOR will hold, but BER is now French. I plan PRU–WAR while BOH/SIL support Italian MUN and GOL/WES support SPA. SEV–UKR remains useful if you reconsider.

Confirmed: BOH and SIL support MUN holding; GOL/WES support SPA holding; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cut supports. Please order MUN/SPA hold and TYR S MUN H. BUD/VIE/NAP remain untouched throughout 1920. My restitution offer stands: ROM–TYS permits NAP–ROM this spring. Please confirm that exchange and our defensive orders.

notes.note: S1920: SEV holds. France 16 needs 2; Turkey 12, Italy 5. France and Turkey both promised no attack on SEV. Declined SEV-MOS and SEV-UKR. Watch ARM, MOS, BLA moves on SEV. Keep France below 18.

NAP–ROM accepts Turkish restitution; BUD–RUM seeks growth. MUN/SPA hold, TYR supports MUN. Turkey promises BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO, ROM–TYS and home-center safety. France's offensive agreement remains decoy; prevent its 18th center.

Defend Italian MUN/SPA; cut MAR/MAO. PRU takes WAR; NOR–SWE offsets likely loss of indefensible Norway, departing from promised hold. ROM–TYS honors restitution; Italy promised NAP–ROM. BUD/VIE/NAP untouched in 1920. ARM stays off SEV; Russia holds.

Solo push: SPA/MUN at strength 3; BAR takes NOR with NWG support. MAR defended by BUR; MOS covers WAR. NTH-SKA enables recovery if NOR retreats SWE: NOR-SWE supported SKA, NWG-NOR. Broke Italian assurances again; Russian peace kept.

messages.body: Your armies in Rome and Rumania can secure two Turkish centers this autumn. What are your plans for TYR and SPA? I propose MAO S SPA–WES, giving your fleet an escape into Turkey’s naval line. Could TYR–TRI threaten another Turkish center while MUN holds? My northern fleets will concentrate on Sweden.

I renew our peace this autumn: MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will attack your army. Please keep SEV holding and stay out of MOS. Has Turkey requested any Russian movement or support? ARM remains the immediate threat to your survival.

Italy currently occupies both Rome and Rumania. Are ADR and TYS recovering Rome, or will you let Italy keep both gains? I propose naval restraint: NAF stays out of MAO, and MAO stays out of NAF. What are your intentions for SWE and the fleets around Spain?

MUN/SPA will hold; TYR supports MUN. Please renew BOH/SIL support for MUN, GOL/WES support for SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Accept ROM/RUM transfers this autumn: two Italian builds strengthen our defense. Keep BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM untouched. France can retake SWE using SKA with NOR support; what northern counterplay do you intend?

MUN/SPA hold, TYR supports MUN. Please urge Turkey to maintain both BOH/SIL supports and GOL/WES support, accepting Italian ROM/RUM ownership for defensive builds. France can retake SWE with SKA supported by NOR, so we cannot relax either defensive position. Will SEV hold again?

Your spring attacks again contradicted your assurances. What do you intend for RUH, KIE, BER, GAS and POR this autumn? Would you genuinely order MAO S SPA–WES while leaving Spain and Munich unattacked? I need concrete orders before considering any departure from those centers.

Russia: SEV holds; I attack nothing of yours. Keep ARM off SEV as promised. France at 16 needs 2, so hold NOR and SWE against France and keep BOH/SIL supporting MUN and GOL/WES supporting SPA. Please use PIE against MAR.

Russia: SEV holds. France is at 16 and needs 2. Please keep MUN and SPA holding, TYR supporting MUN, and ROM and RUM defended. Losing them to Turkey is bad, but France reaching 18 is worse. Tell me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN.
Russia: SEV holds this fall and I attack no French unit. Please confirm again that MOS and all other French units stay off Sevastopol, as you promised. I'm not moving on MOS, WAR or STP.

Please hold MUN/SPA and order TYR S MUN H. I will renew BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Rome's transfer stands; BUD/VIE/NAP remain untouched. Would you order RUM–GAL, preserving Turkish Rumania while preparing pressure on French Warsaw? PRU–WAR will again cut Moscow's support target.

Will you consider SEV–UKR this autumn to threaten French Warsaw next spring? ARM will hold and will not enter SEV, whether you move or stay. I will maintain both supports for Italian Munich and both fleet supports for Spain. France must not break either defensive position while we build an eastern counterattack.
Confirmed: A MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will attack Sevastopol this fall. Please keep A SEV holding and remain out of MOS. Our peace continues; I have no unit in SYR.

I offer these exact orders: RUH H, KIE H, BER–SIL, GAS H, POR H, MAO S SPA–WES. No French attack on Spain or Munich. Please order SPA–WES and consider TYR–TRI while MUN holds; keep ROM and RUM to collect both Turkish centers. NOR and SKA will concentrate on Sweden.

MUN and SPA will hold; TYR supports MUN. ROM and RUM will hold to secure two builds. Please keep SEV and urge Turkey to honor BOH/SIL support for Munich and GOL/WES support for Spain. France again proposes vacating SPA and diverting TYR; I will not expose either defensive position.

Confirmed: MUN/SPA hold and TYR supports MUN. Please execute all four defensive supports, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. RUM must hold: Rome and Rumania give me two builds for our overstretched line. Please accept both transfers and keep BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM untouched. How will SWE survive SKA–SWE supported by NOR?

ROM and RUM will hold. TYR must support MUN unless you provide concrete safeguards against RUH–MUN with BER/KIE support. Your repeated attacks make another unsupported assurance insufficient. Would you order RUH–HOL, KIE–DEN, GAS–BUR and POR H, alongside MAO S SPA–WES? I will not commit SPA before those safeguards are settled.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack nothing of yours; I won't go to UKR while ARM sits next door. Thanks for keeping ARM off SEV. France needs 2, so hold NOR against NWG/SKA support, keep BOH/SIL behind MUN and GOL/WES behind SPA, and use PIE against MAR.

Russia: SEV holds; ARM is adjacent, so I can't leave. Keep MUN and SPA holding with TYR supporting MUN. Accept ROM/RUM transfers if Turkey agrees, but only if MUN and SPA stay secure. Warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. I stay out of MOS, WAR and STP. Please keep MOS and every other French unit off Sevastopol, as you've promised. Turkey has not asked me for anything I'm accepting; ARM stays a worry, so I remain at home.

ARM will hold and stay out of SEV this autumn. Norway is already French-occupied; SWE cannot withstand SKA with NOR support, so I need northern counterplay rather than an unsupported hold. BOH/SIL will support MUN, GOL/WES will support SPA, and PIE will attack MAR.

Confirmed: BOH/SIL support MUN, GOL/WES support SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Keep MUN/SPA holding and TYR supporting MUN. I accept ROM/RUM transfers this autumn; BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM remain untouched. My northern counterplay is SWE–DEN: if SKA attacks Sweden with NOR support, Denmark should fall, offsetting Norway’s loss. Please use your builds against France.

Rome’s transfer to Italy stands; ADR and TYS will not attack it this autumn. SWE will hold, while GOL and WES maintain Spain’s defense. I can accept NAF staying out of MAO if MAO also refrains from supporting an attack on Spain, as well as staying out of NAF. Will you agree?

notes.note: F1920: SEV holds. France 16 needs 2; NOR and SWE may flip this fall. France and Turkey both promised no attack on SEV. Declined SEV-UKR and SEV-MOS. Watch ARM, MOS, BLA moves on SEV. Keep France below 18.

Secure ROM/RUM for two builds. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Turkey accepts transfers and promises BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports, PIE–MAR, NAF–MAO; SWE–DEN counters France. France's assurances remain unreliable. Build to expand while denying French solo.

Maintain Italian MUN/SPA defenses; cut MAR/MAO. SWE–DEN counters expected French recapture; PRU–WAR probes. Accept Italian ROM/RUM gains; honor BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM and SEV guarantees. ADR–APU, ION–TYS, TYS–TUS position fleets for later growth.

Solo push: BUR–MUN strength 4; NOR supports SKA–SWE to secure Norway and recover Sweden. GAS defends MAR. LVN cuts PRU support; MOS contests WAR, vulnerable to PRU with SIL support. MAO–SPA supported POR. Breaking Italian safeguards; Russian peace kept.

messages.body: I accept your proposed safeguards this spring: RUH–HOL, KIE–DEN, GAS–BUR, POR H, and MAO S SPA–WES; MAR holds and BER–SIL cuts Turkish support. Will you order SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support? Turkey’s armies otherwise keep us locked in place while its fleets dominate your southern coastline.

Our peace continues: MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will attack Sevastopol this spring. Please keep SEV holding and remain out of MOS. Has Turkey requested your support or movement? ARM remains the immediate threat to your survival.

France needs only two centers; Denmark is exposed. Please renew BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Could TYS–ION permit NAP–TYS, while ROM–TUS reinforces our western front? Please renew protection of BUD/VIE/RUM/ROM/NAP throughout 1921.

Your repeated attacks make unsupported assurances worthless. Would you order RUH–HOL, KIE–DEN, GAS–BUR, POR H and MAO S SPA–WES, leaving Munich and Spain unattacked? Those concrete safeguards could permit cooperation against Turkey. What are your plans for BER and your northern fleets?

MUN/SPA will hold with TYR supporting MUN. I am requesting renewed Turkish BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports. Denmark is now exposed to France, making either defensive breach potentially decisive. Please retain SEV and urge Turkey not to divert our essential supports. My new Naples fleet should reinforce the western front.
