Russia: SEV holds. France needs 2 centers, so MUN and SPA must hold, with TYR supporting MUN. Keep ROM, RUM, BUD, NAP and VIE secure and warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. I will press Turkey for BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack nothing of yours. Keep ARM off SEV as promised. France needs 2, so keep BOH/SIL behind MUN, GOL/WES behind SPA, and PIE against MAR. Hold SWE and NOR as best you can. I can't go to UKR while ARM is adjacent.
Russia: SEV holds this spring and I attack no French unit. Please confirm that MOS and all other French units stay off Sevastopol, as you have promised. I am not moving on MOS, WAR or STP.

Please hold MUN/SPA and order TYR S MUN H. I propose renewing BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. DEN can attack KIE to cut support while PRU pressures WAR. Keep ROM clear of VEN; I will leave BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM/RUM untouched this year. What are your plans for F NAP?

I offer ARM–ANK this spring, removing the army that has kept you pinned in Sevastopol. Will you answer with SEV–UKR, preparing pressure on French MOS or WAR? I will not attack SEV throughout 1921. Munich and Spain remain my defensive priorities, but we need an eastern threat to reverse France’s advantage.

Confirmed: A MOS will not attack SEV, and every French unit will stay off Sevastopol this spring. Please keep A SEV holding and remain out of MOS, WAR and STP. Tell me if Turkey asks SEV to support ARM–MOS; our peaceful border remains worth preserving.

BER–SIL will cut Turkish support. NTH and SWE can support KIE–DEN, while NOR moves toward SKA. I reaffirm RUH–HOL, GAS–BUR, POR H, MAR H and MAO S SPA–WES, with no attack on Munich or Spain. Please confirm SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support; together these moves attack Turkey’s central and western defenses.

MUN and SPA will hold; TYR supports MUN. France again requests that both defensive units advance, despite needing only two centers. I will not expose them. Please retain SEV and press Turkey to maintain BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports. I am negotiating NAP–TYS to reinforce the western front without weakening Spain.

With those exact safeguards, I can agree to SPA–WES and MUN–BOH with TYR support. MAO support is essential; please keep POR and MAR holding and execute RUH–HOL, KIE–DEN, GAS–BUR and BER–SIL. How will NTH, NOR and SWE operate? Please avoid any autumn reversal against Spain or Munich.

Confirmed: MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Please renew all four supports, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I propose NAP–TYS if you order TYS–ION, alongside ROM–TUS; neither threatens VEN. Can you confirm that fleet exchange? Your guarantees for BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM/RUM throughout 1921 are accepted. We need Italian fleets reinforcing the western line.

Russia: SEV holds. France needs 2, so MUN and SPA must hold, with TYR supporting MUN. Keep ROM, RUM, BUD, NAP and VIE secure. Use the new NAP fleet to cover the west. I'm pressing Turkey for BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports. Warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. Thanks for confirming MOS and all other French units stay off Sevastopol. Turkey has asked for nothing I'm accepting. I stay out of MOS, WAR and STP. Please keep your word.

Russia: SEV holds. Thanks for promising no attack on SEV in 1921. Move ARM-ANK if you like, but I'll decide on UKR after I see it. France needs 2, so keep BOH/SIL behind MUN, GOL/WES behind SPA, and PIE against MAR.

I will order ARM–ANK and keep SEV untouched throughout 1921. Please reconsider SEV–UKR now that Armenia will be vacated; Ukraine could pressure MOS or WAR in autumn. BOH/SIL will support MUN, GOL/WES support SPA, and PIE attack MAR. SWE and NOR are already French; DEN is my northern foothold.

Agreed: TYS–ION permits NAP–TYS; please also order ROM–TUS. BUD/VIE/RUM/ROM/NAP remain untouched throughout 1921. I confirm BOH/SIL S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Please maintain MUN/SPA holds and TYR S MUN. DEN–KIE will cut Kiel’s support, though Denmark remains vulnerable to NTH with SWE support.

notes.note: S1921: SEV holds. France 16 needs 2; Turkey 10, Italy 7. France and Turkey both promised no attack on SEV. Turkey plans ARM-ANK. Declined SEV-UKR and SEV-MOS. Watch ARM, MOS, BLA moves on SEV. Keep France below 18.

Defend Italian MUN/SPA; cut KIE/MAR/MAO; PRU takes WAR. TYS–ION enables agreed NAP–TYS; Italy ROM–TUS. ARM–ANK frees Russia, though SEV still holds. Honor SEV and Italian BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM/RUM guarantees throughout 1921. France needs two; DEN vulnerable.

Defend MUN/SPA with TYR and promised Turkish BOH/SIL/GOL/WES supports. NAP–TYS, ROM–TUS agreed; Turkey promises home-center safety in 1921. RUM–SER seeks growth; secure in fall. French offensive agreement remains decoy; deny France its 18th center.

Solo push: DEN strength 3, BUR–MUN strength 2 as Italy promises MUN–BOH/TYR support. Honor MAO support SPA–WES; POR slips into Spain if vacated. GAS protects MAR. BER cuts SIL; MOS covers WAR. Broke Italian safeguards again; Russian peace kept. Retain two gains in Fall for 18.

messages.body: I propose POR H, MAO S SPA–WES, BER–SIL, and GAS defending MAR. Would you send SPA–WES and TYR–TRI while MUN holds? Serbia is already yours if you stay; Trieste offers another gain. What defensive arrangements have you requested from Turkey around Munich and Spain?

Italy will take Serbia this autumn and threatens Trieste next. Would you consider BOH–VIE, PIE–VEN, and GOL–TYS to counter its expansion? I will not attack Vienna, Venice, or Tunis. What are your intentions for BOH, SIL, and NAF?

Our peace continues: MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will attack your army this autumn. Please keep SEV holding and remain out of MOS and WAR. Has Turkey requested any Russian action against Moscow?

Denmark leaves France one capture from victory. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Please renew BOH/SIL supports for MUN, GOL/WES supports for SPA, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. Accept SER this autumn; would you also allow TYS–TUN for another Italian fleet build? Your defensive supports remain indispensable. Please confirm your exact orders and continued protection of my centers.

Please retain SEV. France gains Denmark this autumn, so either Munich or Spain would give it victory. MUN/SPA will hold, TYR supports MUN; please press Turkey to renew BOH/SIL support for Munich, GOL/WES support for Spain, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. SER will hold for an Italian build to reinforce our overstretched defense.

Russia: SEV holds. France needs 2, and this fall your SER army would take Serbia, a gain for you. MUN and SPA must hold with TYR supporting MUN. Keep SER, ROM, RUM, BUD, NAP and VIE secure. Warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack nothing of yours. Thanks for keeping ARM off SEV through 1921. France needs 2, so BOH/SIL must back MUN and GOL/WES back SPA, with PIE against MAR. Denmark is exposed, so hold DEN against French moves if you can.
Russia: SEV holds this fall and I attack no French unit. Please confirm MOS and every other French unit stays off Sevastopol, as you've promised. I'm not moving on MOS, WAR or STP.

Please maintain MUN/SPA holds and TYR S MUN. BOH supports MUN; SIL supports PRU–WAR. GOL/WES support SPA; PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO cut supports. Please order SER–BUD: losing both Denmark and Serbia costs us a defensive unit. TYS S WES H would secure our fleets. Your BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM/RUM guarantees remain intact.

Armenia is now vacant; my army is in ANK, and SEV remains guaranteed untouched throughout 1921. Please order SEV–UKR now, preparing pressure on French MOS or WAR. I intend PRU–WAR with SIL support while maintaining Munich and Spain’s defenses. We need your army actively threatening France before its eighteenth center falls.

Confirmed: A MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will enter Sevastopol this fall. Please keep A SEV holding and remain out of MOS and WAR. Our peaceful border stands; I will direct my operations elsewhere.

MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Turkey offers BOH support for Munich, GOL/WES support for Spain, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO, with SIL supporting PRU–WAR. Please keep SEV. SER will hold for Italian ownership; additional Italian fleet builds are essential once Denmark puts France at seventeen.

MUN/SPA hold and TYR supports MUN. BOH support is indispensable if SIL supports PRU–WAR; please retain GOL/WES supports, PIE–MAR and NAF–MAO. I can order TYS S WES H, but SER must hold: Italian fleet builds strengthen our common defense. TUS will remain clear of VEN. Please preserve your guarantees.

Your spring RUH–MUN support and POR–SPA contradicted your assurances again. I will not order SPA–WES or TYR–TRI while Denmark leaves you one capture from victory. MUN and SPA must remain defended. Order RUH–HOL, BUR–PAR and POR H if you want credible negotiations; Turkish defensive details are not mine to disclose.

Russia: SEV holds. Your SER army stays put for the Serbian build; that's your gain. MUN and SPA must hold, TYR supporting MUN. Don't advance either unit, since France needs only 2 and DEN will give it one. I'm pressing Turkey for BOH/SIL and GOL/WES supports. Warn me of any French move on MAR.

Russia: SEV holds. I won't go to UKR because MOS is French and I can't risk SEV. Thanks for the ARM-ANK move and the promise of no attack. France reaches 17 with DEN, so BOH/SIL must back MUN, GOL/WES back SPA, and PIE hit MAR. Don't divert supports for PRU-WAR.

Russia: Thanks for confirming. SEV holds this fall and I attack no French unit. I stay out of MOS, WAR and STP. Turkey asked for SEV-UKR and I declined. Please keep MOS and every other French unit off Sevastopol.

ARM has withdrawn to ANK; nothing threatens SEV. Please use this opportunity for SEV–UKR. Denmark is already French-occupied, with no Turkish unit available to recover it. BOH will support MUN, SIL will support PRU–WAR, and GOL/WES will support SPA. Taking Warsaw could offset Denmark’s loss and prevent France reaching eighteen.

Confirmed: BOH S MUN H; SIL S PRU–WAR; GOL/WES S SPA H; PIE–MAR; NAF–MAO. Please keep MUN/SPA holding and TYR supporting MUN. Tunis is not available: order TYS S WES H instead. Please withdraw SER–BUD; another Turkish disband weakens our defense. BUD/VIE/NAP/ROM/RUM remain protected throughout 1921.

Serbia’s occupation makes further concessions to Italy difficult. BOH–VIE and PIE–VEN are tempting, but GOL–TYS would expose Spain without securing compensation. Would you order MAR–GOL to support that naval advance? NAF can refrain from attacking MAO if MAO neither attacks Spain nor supports an attack there. Please confirm those specific orders before expecting a southern realignment.

notes.note: F1921: SEV holds. France 16, DEN would make 17, needs 2. Turkey and France both promised no attack on SEV. Declined SEV-UKR. Watch ARM, MOS, BLA moves on SEV. Keep France below 18.

Defend MUN/SPA with TYR and promised Turkish BOH/GOL/WES supports. Secure SER; seize open VEN/TUN for Italian builds despite Turkey's objections. France likely reaches 17 with DEN. Prioritize reinforcing the defensive line; expect Turkish anger over gains.

Defend MUN/SPA; cut MAR/MAO; supported PRU–WAR offsets DEN loss. ION–APU and ANK–CON stage future growth. Italy refused SER withdrawal; promises TYS S WES. Russia still refuses UKR. Italian centers and SEV protected through 1921.

Keep DEN for 17; attack MUN and SPA with support for possible solo. BAL cuts PRU; MOS covers WAR; BUR protects MAR. Northern fleets head west toward Mediterranean. Russian peace honored; Italian territorial assurances broken again.

messages.body: Our peace continues: A MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will enter Sevastopol this spring. Please keep SEV holding and remain out of MOS. Turkey previously requested SEV–UKR; has it renewed that request or proposed support against Moscow?

Would you order BOH–VIE and PIE–VEN this spring? Italy now has ten centers against your seven, and its new fleets threaten APU. I can order MAR–PIE with GOL support as PIE advances to Venice, preventing an Italian counterattack into Piedmont. What would you require to commit?

Turkey called BOH–VIE and PIE–VEN tempting last autumn. Your new fleets could dislodge APU with NAP–APU supported by ROM, while TYR covers Vienna and VEN holds. Would you consider that deployment if I leave Munich untouched this spring? What concrete French withdrawals would make it acceptable?

France still needs two centers. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN. Please renew BOH S MUN, GOL/WES S SPA and PIE–MAR. Can WAR hold with SIL support? I propose ROM–TYS and NAP–ION; please keep APU clear of both destinations. Despite our disputes over gains, breaking this defense hands France victory. Will you renew protection of Italian centers?

Please consider SEV–MOS this spring to cut MOS support for PRU–WAR; I am asking Turkey for WAR H with SIL support. MUN/SPA hold, TYR supports MUN, and our new fleets will reinforce the Mediterranean. Can you coordinate the Moscow attack with Turkey? Preserving Warsaw prevents France from approaching eighteen.

Your repeated attacks after explicit assurances rule out my vacating Munich or Spain. Would you now order RUH–HOL, BUR–PAR, GAS H and POR H, leaving both centers unattacked? If you want a negotiated change in the Mediterranean, first demonstrate restraint on the board rather than asking me to expose two centers.

Russia: SEV holds. France has 16 and needs 2, so MUN and SPA must hold, with TYR supporting MUN. Don't advance either unit. Keep SER, ROM, RUM, BUD, VIE secure. Tell me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. I'm pressing Turkey for supports.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack nothing of yours. Thanks for keeping ARM off SEV. I won't go to UKR while MOS is French. France needs 2: BOH must back MUN and GOL/WES back SPA. PIE should hit MAR. Don't divert supports for PRU-WAR.
Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. Please confirm again that MOS and all other French units stay off Sevastopol, as promised. I stay out of MOS, WAR and STP this spring.

Please hold MUN/SPA, order TYR S MUN H, TUN S WES H, and ROM–TYS. I propose BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, and PIE–MAR. SIL must also cover Warsaw against MOS/PRU. Please move SER–BUD as a reserve, keeping Trieste Turkish. I will not attack your centers this spring.

Please order SEV–UKR this spring, then support WAR holding in autumn. Armenia is empty and no Turkish unit can attack Sevastopol this spring. France has sixteen centers; protecting Warsaw alongside Munich and Spain is essential. Your army in Ukraine could secure Warsaw and eventually threaten Moscow; holding Sevastopol contributes nothing to that defense.

Confirmed: A MOS will not attack SEV, and no French unit will enter Sevastopol this spring. Please keep A SEV holding and remain out of MOS. Our peaceful border continues. Let me know if Turkey renews its request for SEV–UKR or asks you to support an attack on Moscow.

I accept RUH–HOL, BUR–PAR, GAS H and POR H this spring, with no French attack on Munich or Spain. You need not vacate either center. Consider NAP–APU supported by ROM: that attacks Turkey without exposing Munich or Spain. I understand that only my actual orders, not another assurance, can establish credibility.

Please order SEV–MOS to threaten recapturing Moscow and distract France’s army from Warsaw. PRU is a fleet and cannot attack or support into inland Warsaw; I am requesting SIL S WAR H nonetheless. MUN/SPA hold, TYR supports MUN, and our new fleets reinforce the Mediterranean. Coordinate the Moscow move with Turkey.

I will not attack APU this spring, but neither Munich nor Spain will be vacated. Concrete restraint means RUH–HOL, BUR–PAR, GAS H and POR H, with no attack on MUN or SPA. My new fleets can move ROM–TYS and NAP–ION instead. Demonstrate those withdrawals before asking me to abandon defensive positions.

Confirmed: MUN/SPA H, TYR S MUN H, TUN S WES H, ROM–TYS and SER–BUD; Trieste remains yours. NAP–ION also reinforces our fleets: please keep APU out of ION/TYS. Renew BOH S MUN, GOL/WES S SPA, PIE–MAR and SIL S WAR H. PRU is a fleet, unable to attack Warsaw. Please extend mutual center protection through autumn.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. Thanks for confirming MOS and all French units stay off Sevastopol. I'm declining Turkey's SEV-UKR request and staying out of MOS, WAR and STP. Please keep your word.

Russia: SEV-MOS would fail, since MOS is French and any move leaves SEV open to a Turkish or French strike. SEV holds. Keep MUN and SPA holding with TYR supporting MUN, and SER, ROM, RUM, VIE and BUD secure. I'm pressing Turkey for WAR support and BOH backing MUN.

Russia: SEV holds this spring and I attack nothing of yours. I won't go to UKR, since it gains nothing and leaves SEV exposed. Please keep ARM empty. BOH must back MUN and GOL/WES back SPA. SIL should hold WAR; don't attempt PRU-WAR without support.

Warsaw is now Turkish; there is no PRU–WAR attack to support. I propose WAR holding with SIL support, BOH supporting MUN, GOL/WES supporting SPA, and PIE–MAR. Please reconsider SEV–UKR: you could support Warsaw in autumn without entering Turkish territory. I will not attack Sevastopol this year.

MAR–PIE would put another French army behind our defensive line; GOL will not support it. Before committing BOH–VIE or PIE–VEN, I would require MOS–STP, PRU–LVN, BUR–PAR and RUH–KIE, reducing your immediate threats to Warsaw and Munich. Would you make those withdrawals first and discuss a southern realignment for autumn?

Confirmed this spring: BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR, WAR H and SIL S WAR H. Please order MUN/SPA H, TYR S MUN H and TUN S WES H. ROM–TYS and NAP–ION are welcome; APU will enter neither destination. Italian centers remain untouched this spring. Please move SER–BUD and leave Trieste Turkish.

notes.note: S1922: SEV holds. France 16 needs 2; Turkey 7, Italy 10. France and Turkey both promised no attack on SEV. Declined SEV-UKR and SEV-MOS. Watch ARM, MOS, BLA moves on SEV. Keep France below 18.

Defend MUN/SPA with promised Turkish BOH/GOL/WES support. ROM–TYS, NAP–ION reinforce; TUN–NAF approaches MAO. VEN–TRI seeks growth despite promise to leave Trieste Turkish; SER–BUD covers interior. France promised withdrawals: verify before trusting.

Defend MUN/SPA; PIE cuts MAR. SIL–BER cuts French support; WAR–MOS probes growth, bouncing any MOS–WAR attack. APU–ADR positions toward VEN. Italy promised SER–BUD, TUN S WES, ROM–TYS, NAP–ION. Italian centers untouched this spring; SEV protected in 1922.

Shift fleets south: MAO–NAF, IRI–MAO, ENG–IRI, NTH–ENG; Baltic fleets follow. Seek WES then TUN/SPA. BUR protects MAR; BER cuts SIL, RUH pressures MUN. MOS–UKR threatens WAR/SEV. Russian spring promise honored; Italian restraint promises broken.

messages.body: Please order A SEV S A UKR–MOS this autumn. Together we can dislodge Turkey’s army before it turns against Sevastopol; UKR alone cannot recover Moscow. I will not attack Sevastopol this fall. Your army can remain safely at home while helping remove the Turkish army now bordering your sole center.

Please renew BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR; order SIL–BER to cut Munich support. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN, TUN supports WES, TYS supports GOL. Hold MOS: its capture offsets Trieste, preserving your seven units. Please keep ADR off my centers; our defensive line must remain intact.

Please order SEV S Turkish MOS H. Securing Moscow reduces France from sixteen centers to fifteen; UKR could otherwise return there this autumn. Munich and Spain will hold, with TYR supporting Munich. I am requesting renewed Turkish supports and SIL–BER to cut French support against Munich. Your Moscow support would strengthen the entire defense.
Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. Please confirm again that MOS and every French unit stay off Sevastopol this fall. I stay out of MOS, WAR and STP. Turkey's SEV-UKR request is declined.

Russia: SEV holds this fall and I attack nothing of yours. I decline SEV-UKR. Please keep ARM empty and no Turkish unit near SEV. France needs 2, so back MUN with BOH and SPA with GOL/WES, and keep TRI and WAR guarded.

Russia: SEV holds; SEV-MOS fails against a French army and leaves SEV open. Keep MUN and SPA holding with TYR supporting MUN. Don't advance them. Keep BUD, VIE, SER, ROM and RUM secure. Warn me of any French move on MAR.

You promised Trieste would remain Turkish. Please order TRI–VEN; ADR–TRI restores ownership without dislodging you. Hold MUN/SPA, TYR S MUN H, and TUN S WES H. I propose BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR, MOS H and SIL–WAR. Moscow’s capture reduces France to fifteen; maintaining our defenses prevents victory.

Moscow is now occupied by my army, not France’s. Please order SEV–UKR while MOS holds and SIL–WAR covers Warsaw. This either pins France’s Ukrainian army or puts your army into Ukraine if it leaves. No Turkish unit will attack Sevastopol this year. We finally have an opportunity to push France back.

Confirmed: A UKR and every other French unit will stay off Sevastopol this fall. Please change SEV hold to SEV support UKR–MOS. Your army remains in Sevastopol, defending your center while helping dislodge Turkey from Moscow. I ask for no Russian movement into MOS, WAR or STP.

MOS now contains Turkey’s army, not France’s. Please order SEV S MOS H: this protects Moscow against UKR–MOS without leaving Sevastopol. Munich and Spain hold; TYR supports Munich. Turkey proposes SIL–WAR to block a French capture there. Preserving Moscow’s transfer reduces France to fifteen and gives us room to counterattack.

I broke my Trieste promise, but request accepting its transfer: Moscow preserves your seven units, while another Italian build strengthens our front. MUN/SPA hold; TYR supports MUN, TUN supports WES, TYS supports GOL. Please maintain BOH/GOL/WES supports and PIE–MAR. SIL–WAR makes sense against UKR–WAR. I’ve asked Russia to support MOS holding.

Russia: SEV holds. I can't support Turkish MOS: France's UKR army can't dislodge a supported hold, but a SEV support order leaves it unsupported and exposed. France has 16; keep MUN, SPA, BUD, VIE, SER, ROM, RUM secure. Press Turkey for BOH-MUN and GOL/WES-SPA supports.

Russia: SEV holds and attacks nothing of yours. I'm still declining SEV-UKR, since UKR is French-held and I can't leave Sevastopol open. Keep ARM empty. I can't support MOS now. Keep BOH backing MUN and GOL/WES backing SPA, and guard MOS and TRI.

Russia: SEV holds. I won't order SEV S UKR-MOS, since I'm staying passive and no one is attacking me. Thanks for promising MOS and all French units stay off Sevastopol this fall. I stay out of MOS, WAR and STP.

Sevastopol remains protected, and Armenia stays empty. Please reconsider SEV–UKR: even an unsupported attack cuts Ukraine’s support for an attack on Moscow or Warsaw. I intend MOS H and SIL–WAR, with BOH supporting Munich and GOL/WES supporting Spain. Your intervention would help secure our eastern defense.

I will maintain BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and MOS H. SIL–WAR is necessary against UKR–WAR. Please order TRI–VEN and allow ADR–TRI; keeping Trieste plus gaining Moscow gives Turkey a defensive build. Maintain MUN/SPA H, TYR S MUN H, TUN S WES H and TYS S GOL H.

notes.note: F1922: SEV supports Turkish MOS hold to keep France from 17 and stop UKR-MOS. France 16 needs 2; Turkey MOS flips to Turkey if held. Keep SEV alive and France below 18.

Capture MOS and vacant VEN to offset Italy stealing TRI. MOS supports SIL–WAR; maintain MUN/SPA defenses and PIE–MAR cut. Italy admitted breaking Trieste promise. Russia repeatedly refuses UKR intervention; SEV untouched through 1922.

Secure TRI and seize GRE for growth; BUD–GAL, TUN–NAF, TYS–TUS prepare expansion. MUN/SPA hold with TYR and promised Turkish BOH/GOL/WES supports. Broke Turkish center promises; expect retaliation. Build to reinforce front and pursue solo.

Take vacant RUM to offset MOS loss. MAO–NAF and fleet chain south prepare supported WES attack; BAL–PRU pressures WAR. BUR protects MAR; BER supports RUH–MUN. Russia refused support against MOS; honor SEV peace. Trapped armies lack valid convoy routes.

messages.body: I will keep every French unit out of Sevastopol this spring. Please order SEV S RUM–UKR: your army stays home, while mine gains a route toward Turkish Moscow and Warsaw. This asks neither a Russian attack nor movement out of Sevastopol; would you provide that support?

France can attack Spain with MAR supported by GAS/POR/MAO, overwhelming three defenders. What exact defense do you propose? Please retain BOH support for MUN and coordinate GOL/WES/PIE with me; MUN holds, TYR supports. NAP–TYS can reinforce our fleets. I propose mutual protection of all currently owned centers this year; I will not attack Venice.

Please order SEV–UKR this spring, then support my GAL–RUM in autumn. RUM contains France’s isolated army; removing it takes France farther from eighteen and repairs our southeastern position. Turkey owns Moscow now, so this maneuver need not threaten either Turkish center. Will you help capture Rumania?

Russia: SEV will support MOS hold this spring if France's army is still in UKR, so UKR-MOS can't dislodge you. Keep ARM empty and no Turkish unit on SEV. Keep SIL/WAR guarded, BOH backing MUN, GOL/WES backing SPA. Confirm MOS holds.

Russia: SEV supports Turkish MOS hold this spring, as you asked. Keep MUN and SPA holding with TYR supporting MUN, and guard BUD, VIE, SER, ROM, RUM. Warn me of any French move on MAR, SPA or MUN. France needs only 2.
Russia: SEV holds or supports a hold; I attack no French unit. Please keep UKR and all French units off Sevastopol this spring, as you've promised. I'm staying out of STP, WAR and UKR.

I propose BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR, MOS–STP and WAR S GAL–SIL. Please order MUN/SPA H, TYR S MUN H, GAL–SIL, TUN S WES H and TUS S GOL H. Taking St Petersburg reduces France; Silesia threatens Berlin. I will not attack your centers this spring; please leave Venice Turkish.

Moscow is Turkish and Ukraine is empty: please order SEV–UKR now. I propose MOS–STP while maintaining Munich and Spain’s defenses. Your army could then support an attack on French Rumania in autumn. No Turkish unit will attack Sevastopol during 1923; Armenia will remain empty.

Confirmed: A RUM and every other French unit will stay off Sevastopol this spring. My army is now in Rumania, not Ukraine. I still request SEV support RUM–UKR; your army stays home. If you will support only a hold, please confirm SEV support RUM hold instead, so I can plan accordingly.

Please change SEV’s order to SEV–UKR. I plan GAL–RUM this spring; if bounced, your UKR support in autumn can dislodge France’s isolated army. Turkey proposes MOS–STP, so supporting Moscow’s hold would be wasted if it moves. MUN and SPA hold, with TYR supporting MUN.

Propose GOL S PIE–MAR, PIE–MAR and WES S SPA H; I order TUS S GOL H. Taking Marseilles can offset Spain if France overwhelms it. MUN H, TYR S MUN H; please retain BOH support. GAL–RUM instead, with Russia asked for SEV–UKR. NAP–TYS reinforces. I leave Venice untouched; please protect my centers throughout 1923.

Russia: SEV will not support RUM-UKR. I'm staying passive, holding Sevastopol and attacking no French unit. Please keep UKR and every French unit off SEV, as you promised. I stay out of STP, WAR and UKR.

Russia: SEV holds and supports your MOS hold this spring, so no French move can dislodge you. I'm declining SEV-UKR, since it would leave Sevastopol open. Keep ARM empty and no Turkish unit on SEV. Keep BOH backing MUN, and GOL/WES backing SPA.

Russia: SEV-UKR would abandon Sevastopol and break my promise to Turkey, so I'm declining. SEV supports Turkish MOS hold instead, which blocks France. Keep MUN and SPA holding, TYR supporting MUN. Warn me of any French move on MAR or RUM.

Ukraine is empty, so your conditional Moscow support is unnecessary. I intend MOS–STP, WAR S GAL–SIL. Please order SEV–UKR, preparing support against French RUM in autumn. Sevastopol remains untouched throughout 1923 and Armenia stays empty. We need to take French centers while defending Munich and Spain.

Agreed: mutual center protection throughout 1923. Order SPA H, TUN S WES H, TUS S GOL H, NAP–TYS; retain MUN/TYR defense and GAL–SIL. I propose GOL S PIE–MAR, WES S SPA H, BOH S MUN H, WAR S GAL–SIL, MOS–STP. Dislodging MAR cancels MAR–SPA; against GAS–SPA, taking MAR offsets Spain’s loss. This is counterplay, not guaranteed defense.

notes.note: S1923: SEV supports Turkish MOS hold. France 16 needs 2; Turkey, Italy want SEV-UKR, declined. France and Turkey promised not to attack SEV. Keep SEV alive and France below 18.

MOS–STP and supported PIE–MAR seek French centers; defend MUN/SPA, support GAL–SIL. VEN–ADR develops fleet. Mutual protection of Italian centers through 1923; Italy promises Venice untouched. SEV/ARM untouched in 1923; Russia still refuses UKR.

Defend MUN/SPA; GAL–SIL with promised WAR support. Turkey promises BOH support, WES support SPA, GOL support PIE–MAR and center peace through 1923. TUS follows PIE; TUN–NAF approaches MAO. BUD prepares RUM pressure. Russia refused UKR.

RUM–BUD seeks gain; BER–MUN with RUH support pressures second target. BUR supports MAR against PIE/GOL. Fleet chain advances toward NAF/WES; POR attacks SPA. PRU–LVN pressures MOS. Russian SEV peace honored; Russia refused support.

messages.body: With St Petersburg passing to Turkey, I fall to fifteen centers. I offer POR H, BUR–PAR and RUH–HOL, with no attack on Spain or Munich this autumn. Would you use TYS–WES, supported by SPA and TUN, to dislodge Turkey’s fleet? That gives your fleets room while preserving both your western centers.

You have secured St Petersburg; Italy still holds ten centers, including your former possessions. Would you order PIE–VEN supported by ADR, and BOH–VIE? I offer LVN–BOT, POR H, and no French attack on Spain or Munich this autumn if you undertake those attacks. This gives you concrete gains rather than another year defending Italian territory.

Moscow is vacant, and Turkey’s armies are now in St Petersburg and Warsaw. SEV–MOS could recover your second center immediately without attacking any French unit. I will keep RUM and every French unit out of Sevastopol this autumn. Will you take this opportunity rather than remain confined to one center?

Please renew BOH S MUN H, WES S SPA H, GOL S PIE–MAR and PIE–MAR; keep STP for its transfer. I will order SIL and TYR S MUN H, giving Munich four defensive strength against France’s maximum four. SPA holds; TUS supports GOL, TYS and TUN support WES. Please reaffirm our center protection through autumn.

Russia: France has 16 and STP flips to France if their army holds it. Your STP army must not be dislodged; MOS is no longer yours, so please hold STP and guard WAR. SEV holds, and I attack no Turkish unit. Keep ARM empty. Confirm.

Russia: France needs 2 and STP is the danger this fall. Keep MUN and SPA holding with TYR supporting MUN. Guard BUD, VIE, SER, ROM. Does any Italian unit threaten Rumania or MAR? Tell me what you will do about it.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. Please keep every French unit off Sevastopol this fall, as promised. I stay out of STP, WAR and UKR. I won't support RUM-UKR; I'm staying passive at home.

Please order MUN H, TYR/SIL S MUN H, SPA H, TUN S WES H, TUS S GOL H. I propose BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR, STP H. Four defenders secure Munich; PIE cuts Marseille’s support against Spain. Keep TRI covering BUD against RUM. ADR stays off your centers.

STP will hold and become Turkish this autumn, reducing France to fifteen unless it gains elsewhere. Please order SEV–UKR; Moscow and Armenia are empty, and I will not attack Sevastopol. From Ukraine you could help dislodge France’s A RUM next year. Your army can finally contribute to pushing France back.

Confirmed: A RUM and every French unit will stay off Sevastopol this fall. If you insist on holding, our peace still stands. But MOS is vacant, and neither Turkish A STP nor A WAR can attack SEV this turn. SEV–MOS would recover your second center without risking Sevastopol to any adjacent enemy unit.

MUN and SPA hold; TYR and SIL support MUN. No Italian unit can attack RUM or MAR directly; Turkish PIE will attack MAR. Please order SEV–RUM: if France moves RUM–BUD or RUM–SER, you capture Rumania and offset its gain. Turkey holding STP takes another center from France.

I decline TYS–WES: attacking Turkey while your armies threaten Munich and Spain would expose our defense. Please execute POR H, BUR–PAR and RUH–HOL, leaving both centers unattacked. Demonstrated withdrawals could open negotiations next spring; another unsupported promise cannot justify an autumn attack on Turkey.

Correction: please use your proposed GOL/WES S SPA H and PIE–MAR, not GOL supporting PIE. Against GAS–SPA supported by POR/MAO, Spain needs both fleets’ support; PIE cuts MAR’s additional support. Confirm MUN/SPA H, TYR/SIL S MUN H, TUS S GOL H, TYS/TUN S WES H. Please retain BOH support, STP H and autumn center protection.

Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. I'm declining SEV-MOS; I'd rather stay home than leave Sevastopol open. Please keep RUM and every French unit off SEV this fall, as you've repeatedly promised. I stay out of STP, WAR and UKR.

Russia: SEV holds; I won't go to UKR, since it would leave Sevastopol open. Keep ARM empty and no Turkish unit on SEV, as promised. Your STP army must hold, and France must not reach 18. Keep WAR guarded and BOH backing MUN.

Confirmed: STP holds, WAR remains guarded, Armenia stays empty, and no Turkish unit attacks Sevastopol this autumn. STP becomes Turkish if retained; Moscow is already Turkish-owned despite being empty. SEV–UKR remains welcome: it would prepare support against French Rumania without attacking any Turkish territory.

Venice is already Turkish, so PIE–VEN offers me no gain. BOH–VIE would abandon Munich’s defense for an uncertain attack; I decline that exchange. Order LVN–BOT and refrain from attacking Spain or Munich, and we can discuss a genuine territorial bargain next spring. My immediate priority is retaining St Petersburg.

Center protection through autumn reaffirmed. BOH S MUN H, WES/GOL S SPA H, PIE–MAR, STP H; ADR stays off your centers. GOL must support SPA, not PIE: GAS–SPA supported by POR/MAO otherwise wins. PIE still cuts Marseille’s support. Please keep SIL/TYR supporting MUN, TUS supporting GOL, TYS/TUN supporting WES, and TRI covering BUD against RUM.

notes.note: F1923: SEV holds. France 16, needs 2; STP flips to France if its army holds there (Turkey claims STP will hold). Declined UKR, MOS and RUM. France and Turkey both promised not to attack SEV. Keep SEV alive and France below 18.

Take STP; defend Italian MUN/SPA and cut MAR as agreed. WAR–PRU pressures BER; ADR–ALB positions toward GRE. Italy promises SIL/TYR support MUN and fleet protection. Italian centers and SEV untouched through 1923; Russia still refuses UKR.

Defend MUN with SIL/TYR and promised BOH support; SPA relies on promised GOL/WES supports. TRI–BUD blocks RUM. Take vacant VEN despite autumn pact; expect Turkish anger. Fleets advance NAF/PIE/AEG, TYS follows ION. Turkey must retain STP to reduce France.

Take vacant BUL to offset STP loss. Fleet chain advances to NAF for supported WES attack next spring. BER attacks MUN with RUH support; BUR protects MAR. LVN–BOT prepares STP recovery. Russian peace kept; Italian withdrawal offer broken after refusal to attack Turkey.

messages.body: Venice is now Italian, alongside Vienna; Italy has eleven centers to your six. Would you order PIE–VEN and BOH–VIE this spring? In exchange I offer BOT–SWE and no spring attack on Munich or Spain, leaving St Petersburg untouched. Your armies would pursue actual gains rather than continue defending Italy’s centers.

Taking Venice broke our pact; further fighting hands France victory. I propose renewed center protection through 1924: BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR. I retain MUN/SPA H, TYR/SIL S MUN H, TUS S GOL H, TUN S WES H. BUD–RUM seeks to reduce France. Can PRU–BER cut French support?

Please order SEV S Italian BUD–RUM this spring. This keeps your army in Sevastopol while helping capture France’s empty Rumania against a possible BUL–RUM. Taking Rumania reduces France’s center count if retained through autumn. Munich and Spain remain defended; your support gives us concrete counterplay without exposing your center.

Russia: SEV holds, I attack nothing of yours. France needs 2: PIE-MAR and STP are the danger. Keep A STP holding, keep WAR guarded, ARM empty, and no Turkish unit on SEV. Tell me exactly what A PIE and F GOL/WES will do.

Russia: SEV holds; leaving it to go RUM or UKR just loses my last center. France needs 2, so concentrate on guarding MUN, SPA, BUD, SER, VIE and MAR approaches. Which French moves do you expect on BUD or SER from RUM or BUL?
Russia: SEV holds and I attack no French unit. Please keep A RUM and every French unit off Sevastopol this spring, as you have promised. I stay out of MOS, STP, WAR, UKR and RUM.

Renew mutual center protection through 1924? I propose BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H, PIE–MAR and PRU–BER. Please order MUN/SPA H, TYR S MUN H, SIL S PRU–BER, TUN S WES H and TUS S GOL H. Munich retains sufficient defense while we pressure Berlin. Can BUD cover Serbia against BUL?

Please order SEV–UKR: Ukraine is empty, and from there you can threaten French Rumania this autumn. I will leave Sevastopol untouched and Armenia empty throughout 1924. STP holds; BOH supports Munich, and my western fleets defend Spain. We need counterplay against France’s sixteen centers.

Confirmed: every French unit will stay off Sevastopol this spring. My former A RUM is now in BUL; Rumania is empty. I respect your decision to hold. If you reconsider, MOS remains vacant and no Turkish unit can enter SEV this spring, so SEV–MOS offers expansion without exposing your home center.

Rumania is empty; France’s only southeastern army is BUL. BUL–SER is the immediate threat, not RUM–BUD. Please order SEV S BUD–RUM, securing Rumania against BUL–RUM without leaving Sevastopol. I plan VEN–TRI as a reserve against a Serbian incursion. Munich and Spain remain defended.

Agreed: mutual center protection throughout 1924. MUN/SPA hold, TYR supports MUN, SIL supports PRU–BER, TUN supports WES, TUS supports GOL. Please execute BOH S MUN, GOL/WES S SPA and PIE–MAR. BUD–RUM with requested Russian support reduces France; VEN–TRI positions an army to contest Serbia in autumn if BUL enters it.

Russia: SEV holds. Supporting BUD-RUM does nothing unless my army is adjacent. SEV borders RUM, so I could, but a bounce leaves BUD open to BUL-RUM or RUM-BUD. Keep BUD, SER, VIE guarded. Tell me what MAR and SPA defenses you have against France.

Russia: SEV holds and attacks nothing of yours. I'm still declining SEV-UKR, since it leaves Sevastopol open. Keep A STP holding, WAR guarded, ARM empty and BOH backing MUN. Please confirm PIE-MAR goes in with GOL/WES support, since France needs only 2.

STP holds. PIE–MAR cuts Marseille’s support; GOL and WES both support Italy’s SPA holding. BOH supports MUN. Sevastopol remains untouched and Armenia empty throughout 1924. Please reconsider SEV–UKR: no enemy unit can enter Sevastopol this spring, and Ukraine would let you support an autumn attack on French Rumania.

Agreed to center protection through 1924. PRU–BER cuts Berlin’s support; please order SIL S PRU–BER, TYR S MUN H, MUN/SPA H, TUS S GOL H and TUN S WES H. BOH supports MUN; GOL/WES support SPA; PIE–MAR. Combine BUD–RUM with AEG–BUL: if BUL takes Serbia, you can capture both vacated French centers.

I decline PIE–VEN and BOH–VIE this spring. Those attacks would expose Munich and Spain while offering no assured Turkish gain. BOT–SWE would be welcome, but meaningful negotiations require reduced pressure on our western line. Would you order BUR–PAR and GAS–BRE alongside BOT–SWE? I would then discuss an autumn territorial bargain.

notes.note: S1924: SEV holds. France 16 needs 2; Turkey 6, Italy 11. France and Turkey both promised no attack on SEV. Declined UKR, MOS, RUM. Watch STP, PIE-MAR, BUL moves. Keep SEV alive and France below 18.

Defend MUN/SPA as agreed; PIE cuts MAR, PRU attacks BER with promised SIL support. STP advances to vacant NOR rather than promised hold; assess BOT and protect STP in fall. Italy promises center protection through 1924. SEV/ARM untouched; Russia refuses UKR.

1924 pact with Turkey: BOH supports MUN, GOL/WES support SPA, PIE–MAR, PRU–BER; SIL supports PRU. Russia asked to support BUD–RUM. AEG attacks BUL; ION–GRE prepares support. Advance TUN–NAF, TUS–TYS instead of unnecessary fleet supports. VEN–TRI covers Balkans.

BUL takes CON; retain in Fall if possible. BOT–FIN and NTH–NOR prepare supported STP attack via BAR. Western fleet chain approaches WES; BUR protects MAR, BER attacks MUN with RUH support. Stranded armies lack valid convoys. Russia peace kept; Turkey refused bargain.

messages.body: Italy stands to reach thirteen centers; your Berlin gain merely offsets Constantinople. I propose BOH–VIE and PIE–VEN. In exchange, I will leave Berlin and St Petersburg unattacked and order CON H, foregoing attacks on Ankara or Smyrna. Will you pursue Italian centers rather than keep defending Munich and Spain while Italy grows?

Please retain BOH S MUN H, GOL/WES S SPA H and PIE–MAR; BER and STP hold to secure both northern centers. I propose MUN/SPA H, TYR/SIL S MUN H, TYS S GOL H, TUN S WES H. BUL/RUM hold to secure their transfers. Renew mutual center protection through 1925 so we can continue reducing France together.

Russia: France needs 2 and BUL, RUM and BER flip this fall. SEV-RUM could take Rumania only if France leaves it empty; it is empty now. I'll consider it if you attack BUL from GRE and SER-supported moves. Tell me exactly which Italian units hit BUL and RUM.

Russia: France gets BER if A BER holds... your BER army must avoid losing. Please confirm A STP holds and no Turkish unit enters SEV. I may move SEV-RUM to block France's gain; Ukraine stays untouched. Tell me your CON and BER plans.
Russia: SEV holds and attacks no French unit. Please confirm again that no French unit enters Sevastopol this fall. I stay out of MOS, UKR and STP.

Confirm autumn protection: BOH S MUN H, BER H, PIE–MAR, GOL/WES S SPA H, STP H. Please order MUN/SPA/BUL/RUM H, TYR S MUN H, SIL S BER H, TYS S GOL H, TUN S WES H, GRE S BUL H. Holding Berlin, Bulgaria and Rumania strips France of three centers while conceding only Constantinople.

Please order SEV S Italian A RUM H; your army can contribute without leaving Sevastopol. Italy should hold Bulgaria and Rumania while I retain Berlin, offsetting France’s occupation of Constantinople. STP holds this autumn; BOH supports Munich, GOL/WES support Spain, and PIE attacks Marseille. Sevastopol remains untouched and Armenia empty throughout 1924.

Confirmed: no French unit will enter or attack Sevastopol this fall. A CON will operate away from your center, and our peace continues. I respect your decision to hold A SEV and remain out of MOS, UKR and STP.

Italian A RUM and F BUL/south already occupy Rumania and Bulgaria; neither is empty or needs attacking. Both will hold to take ownership from France. GRE supports BUL holding. Please order SEV S RUM H, remaining safely in Sevastopol. Munich and Spain hold with Turkish defensive support.

Confirmed: MUN/SPA/BUL/RUM hold; TYR S MUN H, SIL S BER H, GRE S BUL H, TYS S GOL H, TUN S WES H. Please execute your listed orders, especially BOH’s Munich support and both Spain supports. These transfers reduce France to fourteen if no other centers change. Will you extend mutual center protection through 1925?

Russia: I'll order SEV S Italian A RUM H, so SEV stays put and attacks nothing of yours. France gets 18 if RUM, BUL, BER or CON flips, so Italy must hold RUM and BUL. Keep A STP holding, ARM empty, no Turkish unit entering SEV. Make BOH and PIE moves count.

A BER is Turkish: BER H secures Berlin for us this autumn. A STP holds. France occupies Constantinople; I have no unit there to issue orders. No Turkish unit enters SEV, and Armenia remains empty. Please order SEV S Italian A RUM H, not SEV–RUM: Italy’s capture reduces France’s center count.

I decline BOH–VIE and PIE–VEN this autumn: neither promises a capture, while abandoning the western defenses. A BER and A STP will hold. If you order CON H, FIN–BOT and BUR–PAR, we can discuss a concrete territorial bargain for 1925 rather than unsupported attacks on Italian centers.

Autumn orders confirmed: BOH S MUN H, BER H, STP H, PIE–MAR, GOL/WES S SPA H. Please use SIL S BER H and TYR S MUN H; retain TYS S GOL H, TUN S WES H, GRE S BUL H, and BUL/RUM H. I favor continued cooperation; let’s settle 1925 guarantees after adjustments.

notes.note: F1924: SEV supports Italian RUM hold. France 16 needs 2; BUL, RUM, BER flip this fall and CON goes to France. Keep SEV alive and France below 18. France and Turkey promised no attack on SEV.

Take BER and opportunistic VIE; BER replaces BOH supporting MUN, with TYR support sufficient against France. Broke Italian protection promise for Vienna; expect retaliation. PIE cuts MAR; fleets defend SPA. Russia promised SEV S RUM; Italy SIL S BER.

Secure BUL/RUM; seize empty WAR, breaking Turkish protection pact to reach 14. MUN/SPA rely on promised BOH and GOL/WES supports. Advance AEG/NAF/TUS/VIE toward further gains. Expect Turkish anger; negotiate renewed cooperation against France.

Secure CON; BUR supports threatened MAR. MAO–NAF prepares supported WES attack; fleet chain follows. NTH–NWG heads toward BAR; FIN–BOT prepares STP support. POR probes SPA, RUH probes MUN. Stranded armies lack valid convoys. Russian peace kept; Turkey refused bargain.

messages.body: Italy now has fourteen centers. I offer a concrete gain: order F GOL–SPA(sc), and I will support it with F POR and A GAS this spring. Your F WES can hold or advance toward TYS. I will not attack Berlin or St Petersburg this spring. Will you accept Spain and begin pursuing Italian centers?

I recognize taking Warsaw breached our agreement. Further fighting benefits France. Can we renew protection through 1925: BOH supports MUN, GOL/WES support SPA, BER holds? I propose WAR–SIL, TYR supports MUN, TUS supports GOL, TUN supports WES. With PIE gone, Marseille can now provide decisive support against Spain; how should we counter that?

Would you consider AEG supporting CON–SMY this spring in exchange for MAR–PIE, GAS–MAR, POR holding, and no attacks on Spain or Munich throughout 1925? This gives your isolated army a supported advance and opens a different front. I would retain Bulgaria and Rumania. Please confirm exact orders before treating this as agreed.

France now has fourteen centers, and I hold Bulgaria and Rumania. Will you support RUM holding from SEV this spring? That protects against CON–BUL followed by pressure on Rumania without exposing Sevastopol. What arrangement would persuade you to help remove France’s army from Constantinople?

Russia: France holds 14 and Italy 14, so only you can stop a French 18. SEV holds this spring and keeps Sevastopol. Keep RUM and BUL held, guard MUN and SPA, and tell me which French units threaten MAR, SPA or MUN.

Russia: SEV holds and attacks nothing of yours. France has 14, so keep A STP holding and A BER defended, with A BOH backing MUN and GOL/WES covering SPA. Confirm no Turkish unit enters SEV and ARM stays empty.
Russia: SEV holds and attacks no French unit. Please confirm again that no French unit enters Sevastopol this spring. I stay out of MOS, UKR, RUM and STP.

I propose exchanging Italian centers: order RUH and KIE to support BOH–MUN; I order GOL and WES to support MAR–SPA. You gain Spain, I gain Munich, and Italy loses two. Berlin and St Petersburg remain untouched. Will you agree to these specific orders and refrain from attacking Ankara or Smyrna through 1925?

With PIE gone, Spain’s defense needs a new plan: France can concentrate GAS, MAR, POR and MAO against it. What moves will your fleets make? I propose continued GOL/WES support for SPA and BOH support for MUN this spring, provided you support BOH–VIE in autumn as compensation. Will you accept and keep Berlin untouched?
Confirmed: no French unit will enter or attack Sevastopol this spring. A CON will remain away from your center. Our peace continues, and I respect your decision to hold A SEV.

Agreed: MAR–PIE, GAS–MAR, POR H, and CON–SMY with AEG support. I will make no attacks on Spain or Munich throughout 1925; Bulgaria and Rumania remain yours. Please order AEG S CON–SMY and keep BUL from attacking Constantinople, preserving my army’s retreat if necessary.

Agreed: RUH and KIE support BOH–MUN; MAR–SPA, supported by your GOL and WES. I will add POR S MAR–SPA and order GAS–MAR. Berlin and St Petersburg remain unattacked this spring, and I will not attack Ankara or Smyrna throughout 1925. Let us execute both captures together.

GAS, MAR, POR and MAO can combine against Spain; BUR, RUH and KIE threaten Munich. Please keep SEV secure. I propose AEG–CON supported by BUL to remove France’s isolated army; RUM holds. Would you support RUM holding while our fleets concentrate on Constantinople?

Agreed: Berlin untouched, and TRI will support BOH–VIE in autumn as compensation. Please order BOH S MUN H and GOL/WES S SPA H. SPA holds, TYR supports MUN, TUN supports WES; TUS–PIE and NAP–TYS reinforce. Spain cannot withstand all four French attackers this spring; PIE threatens Marseille for autumn counterplay.

No Turkish unit will enter Sevastopol this spring; Armenia remains empty. STP will hold. Berlin’s defense and BOH’s assignment depend on negotiations with France and Italy. Italy has taken Warsaw, so I cannot simply continue underwriting its expansion without compensation. Your SEV holding is understood.

With PIE gone, our existing supports cannot guarantee Spain against four French attackers. I need a firm answer on compensation: will TYR support BOH–VIE in autumn, with TRI leaving Vienna untouched? Will WAR–SIL support BER holding thereafter? Confirm those commitments before expecting another year of Turkish units defending your centers.

My counteroffer stands: RUH and KIE support BOH–MUN; GOL and WES support MAR–SPA. This gives each of us an Italian center rather than leaving me dependent on defending your new Spanish possession. Confirm those exact orders, plus no attacks on Berlin, St Petersburg, Ankara or Smyrna through autumn 1925, and we have an agreement.

Russia: SEV supports RUM hold this spring; I stay in Sevastopol. Keep BUL and RUM held, and guard MUN, SPA, BUD, SER and VIE. For CON, attack from BUL with GRE and AEG support; I'll back RUM if CON-BUL comes. Tell me which units will hit CON.

notes.note: S1925: SEV supports Italian RUM hold, as promised to Italy. France 14, Italy 14, needs 18. Keep SEV alive and France below 18. France and Turkey promised no attack on SEV. Declined UKR, MOS, ARM.

Take SPA with Turkish supports and SMY with Italian AEG support; support BOH–MUN. Conflicting Italian/Turkish promises broken for gains. BOT–FIN/NWG–BAR prepare fall STP attack; fleets advance south. Russia SEV peace kept.

France promises RUH/KIE S BOH–MUN in exchange for GOL/WES S MAR–SPA; execute, adding BER support. STP probes NOR. France promises BER/STP safe this spring, ANK/SMY through 1925. Italy offered autumn Vienna compensation but previously stole WAR.

Solo push: take CON/MOS; fall UKR–SEV supported MOS and EAS–SMY supported AEG/CON could reach 18. France promised CON–SMY and no SPA/MUN attacks; omitted unnecessary AEG support. VEN–PIE supported TUS contests MAR. Turkey likely angry over MOS; protect western centers.

messages.body: I propose RUH S MUN H this autumn, helping secure your capture against SIL and TYR. In exchange, order GOL S SPA H and keep NOR holding, without attacks on Sweden or Finland. Please also keep WES out of Spain. You secure Munich; I secure Spain. Will you confirm?

Our spring arrangement was broken; I recognize that. There is still a concrete eastern bargain: CON S SMY–ANK gives me Ankara while your fleet remains in Constantinople to claim it. I would leave Munich unattacked this autumn. Would you agree to that support?

Can we redirect the fighting against Turkey? I propose MAR–GAS and SMY–ANK, with CON supporting SMY–ANK. PIE would enter Marseille as compensation for Spain, while your army gains Ankara. I would leave Spain uncontested this autumn. Please confirm those exact moves; they separate our armies and give both sides concrete gains.

Our fighting is handing France Spain and Smyrna. Please order GOL S PIE–MAR, BER–KIE and MUN–RUH; TYR–MUN with SIL support would secure Munich against France. In exchange, I offer to return Moscow next spring and leave Berlin untouched. This recovers our western position rather than letting French armies dictate the settlement.

Would you consider SEV–ARM this autumn? You retain Sevastopol’s ownership while gaining pressure on Ankara and France’s army in Smyrna. I would leave Sevastopol untouched and keep MOS in place this turn. Remaining isolated in SEV gives you no route back; Armenia creates bargaining power against both larger western powers.

Russia: SEV holds this fall and stays home. France is at 14 and you are at 14, so you must keep MUN and SPA from flipping; both are threatened. Tell me which units support MUN and SPA. I'll back anything defensive that doesn't require SEV to move.

Russia: SEV holds and attacks nothing of yours. Please confirm no Turkish unit enters SEV and ARM stays empty. If A NOR and A MUN hold, you gain two centers. Italy's MOS gain only happens if its A MOS holds, so tell me your plan for it.
Russia: SEV holds this fall and attacks no French unit. Please confirm again that no French unit enters Sevastopol. I stay out of MOS, UKR, RUM and STP, as before.

Your occupation of Smyrna contradicts our explicit 1925 guarantee. Will you withdraw SMY–SYR and order RUH S MUN H? I propose GOL/WES defend against Italy while NOR holds; please leave Berlin and St Petersburg untouched. Alternatively, arrange SPA–GAS and POR S WES–SPA, with GOL supporting, as compensation for retaining Smyrna.

Our fighting has benefited France, now occupying Spain and Smyrna. Can we agree an autumn ceasefire: Munich and Berlin untouched, MOS–WAR, TUN S WES H, and no attack on GOL? In return my fleets will not attack Italian territory this autumn. What are your plans for CON and AEG against French Smyrna?

Italy now occupies Turkish Moscow and has fourteen centers. Would you consider SEV–MOS this autumn? If MOS advances toward St Petersburg, you could regain a Russian home center. I have no unit capable of threatening Sevastopol and will not assist any attack on it. Do you expect Italy to keep UKR supporting MOS?

Agreed: MAR–GAS, GAS–BRE and SMY–ANK, with CON supporting SMY–ANK and PIE–MAR. Spain remains uncontested. Please order EAS–SYR and AEG H so Smyrna remains French; otherwise Ankara merely exchanges one eastern center for another. I will leave Munich unattacked this autumn.
Confirmed: no French unit will enter or attack Sevastopol this autumn. Our peace continues, and I respect your decision to hold A SEV and remain outside Moscow, Ukraine, Rumania and St Petersburg.

I offer RUH S MUN H and no attacks on Berlin or St Petersburg in exchange for GOL S SPA H, WES H and NOR H. I cannot safely accept SMY–SYR while Italy’s EAS threatens Smyrna. Your captures of Munich and Norway already provide substantial compensation; let us secure our gains rather than reopen Spain.

I agree to CON S SMY–ANK provided MAR–GAS lets PIE–MAR compensate for Spain. GAS must vacate successfully; GAS–BUR with BUR–PAR would accomplish that. Please confirm these orders and no attack on Munich. Spain will remain uncontested by Italy this autumn.

France already occupies Spain; I cannot defend it this autumn. TYR–MUN with SIL support is my proposed recovery of Munich, contingent on Turkish cooperation. Please keep SEV holding. Constantinople will remain occupied to secure its transfer, while my eastern fleets address France’s army in Smyrna.

I can accept MOS–WAR and leave Berlin untouched if MUN–RUH permits TYR–MUN, supported by SIL. Please add GOL S PIE–MAR; recovering Marseille offsets Spain. I can provide TUN S WES H and leave GOL unattacked. CON holds to claim Constantinople; AEG and EAS can pressure French Smyrna. Will you confirm that exchange?

I offer GOL S SPA H, WES H and NOR H in exchange for RUH S MUN H, SMY–SYR, and no attacks on Berlin or St Petersburg this autumn. Smyrna’s withdrawal repairs your broken guarantee without jeopardizing Spain. Please confirm all three commitments; retaining Smyrna while also threatening St Petersburg leaves me no reason to cooperate.

Returning Moscow next spring is too late: order MOS–WAR now. Leave Munich and Berlin untouched, order TUN S WES H, and keep TYS out of GOL; my fleets will not attack Italian territory this autumn. Please use CON S AEG–SMY to expel France rather than taking Ankara. Can you confirm these orders?

Confirmed: no Turkish unit enters Sevastopol, and Armenia stays empty. I am asking Italy for MOS–WAR now, not a delayed return next spring. Please order SEV–MOS: if Italy vacates, you regain Moscow and prevent its Italian capture. My NOR and MUN will remain in place; I cannot directly attack Moscow.
